job.description: The way companies innovate is broken.  The systems built to create and protect ideas can’t keep up with the pace of change. Today,  90% of S&P 500 company value is intangible (e.g., in intellectual property)  - yet R&D and IP teams spend  half their time buried in manual work , sifting through patents and paperwork instead of pushing the frontier forward. The tools of creating and protecting are stuck in the past.  We’re here to fix that.    Ankar is building the R&D tools for the AI era and defining what applied research will look like in the next 20 years . We’re building infrastructure and product experiences our customers rely on every day. You’ll translate messy, ambiguous problems into clean, dependable software—and you’ll do it at the cutting-edge of AI.  We’re at an inflection point:     We’ve raised >$24M to date from Tier-1 VCs  like Atomico, Index Ventures, Norrsken, Daphni, and angels like the Founder of Hugging Face, CEO from Datadog, and Leaders from DeepMind and OpenAI. We’re just getting started.       What you’ll be doing  We’re looking for a patent professional with deep large-molecule life sciences expertise who can bridge product development, engineering and IP protection. You’ll work hands-on with pharmaceutical and biotech customers to design AI-powered patent solutions that understand the nuances of biologics—including antibodies, proteins, peptides, nucleic acids, vaccines and cell and gene therapies—and the conventions that govern their patent protection.     Build life sciences-specific patent products:  Partner with product and engineering teams to develop AI tools tailored to large-molecule patents—from protein and antibody sequence analysis to biologics claim generation, sequence-listing support and prior-art searching across life sciences databases.     Embed with pharmaceutical and biotech customers:  Work directly with in-house patent counsel and prosecution teams to design, prototype and deploy high-value proofs of concept for large-molecule patent workflows.     Shape product development with biologics expertise:  Translate complex large-molecule patent challenges into product requirements, ensuring our AI understands sequence data, CDR and epitope definitions, functional claim language, sequence variants, experimental data and biologics drafting conventions.     Drive customer success in large-molecule patents:  Lead technical sessions with patent professionals to ensure our products deliver measurable value across biologics patent portfolios.     Identify emerging biologics patent opportunities:  Recognize evolving needs across therapeutic antibodies, recombinant proteins, vaccines, nucleic acid technologies, cell and gene therapies, biologics formulations and regulatory IP strategy.     What we’re looking for      Large-molecule patent expertise:  At least two years of experience in biologics patent prosecution, pharmaceutical or biotech IP, or other large-molecule-focused patent work, with a strong understanding of the patent lifecycle from invention disclosure through prosecution, grant and enforcement.     Technical life sciences foundation:  Strong knowledge of molecular biology, biochemistry, immunology or a related discipline, including an understanding of protein and nucleic acid sequences, antibody structure and function, biologics development, and how these translate into patentable subject matter.     Strong biologics drafting skills:  Experience developing claim strategies for antibodies, proteins, nucleic acids or other biologic modalities, with an understanding of written-description, enablement, sequence-listing and functional-claiming requirements.     Builder’s mindset:  You thrive in ambiguity, iterate quickly on prototypes and enjoy creating order from complexity. We're building the AI operating system that absorbs IT complexity and unlocks entirely new levels of speed, output, and ambition. We believe this is a generation-defining mission.  Major enterprises already trust us with their most critical systems, we just closed a $60M+ Series A from top-tier funds, and we're still early enough that what you build here defines the company.  We're a small, talent-dense team doing our life's work at Conduct - we value ownership, high velocity, and low-ego collaboration. If you bring that same drive, we will make sure this is the place you do yours too.     WHO WE HIRE  We are relentless builders, and we're looking for people who share that obsession with shipping to customers.  As our founding Platform Engineer, your role is to build and scale a reliable, resilient, observable, performant and secure platform that makes our product engineers faster. We care about outcomes: you should be excited by building the foundations that let us ship a killer product fast, not by hard infrastructure problems for their own sake (though you'll have plenty of those).    You'll stand out if you:    Have owned infrastructure - networks, databases, deployments - through a period of real scale at a fast-growing startup or scale-up.    Treat infrastructure as code by default (Terraform or similar) and stay on top of the latest platform tooling    Simple, well-reasoned system design. Solutions that solve the problem and ship fast, rather than the perfect setup on a six-month roadmap    Have informed, strong opinions on the big calls - like whether to stay on Postgres or move to something like Supabase or PlanetScale    Understand how AI changes infrastructure - LLM gateways, caching, flaky providers, agent sandboxes, durable execution. You don't need to be an AI researcher, but you've played with the tools and have a point of view    Build clean abstractions and paved paths that other engineers actually want to use      We look for exceptional talent, regardless where you spike. Experience level matters less than the quality of your thinking and the evidence of what you've shipped; building and scaling platforms with modern tooling, rather than just maintaining them.  We hire the best to join our team in London, wherever they come from (we sponsor visas and provide relocation support!). We're convinced diverse teams ship better products and especially encourage underrepresented groups in tech to reach out.     WHAT YOU'LL OWN  Everything that sits below the product code. Today that work is shared across the team; you'll own it, with the autonomy to set the direction, decide what matters most, as well as scope and prioritise work yourself with the backing of the broader engineering team. As our engineering team grows fast, every improvement you make compounds across everyone building Conduct.     Deployment:  fully automated, repeatable deployments of the whole platform, so we can stand up new regions - starting with the US.     Enterprise-grade security:  customer-provided encryption keys, network boundaries and tenant isolation that hold up to the scrutiny of the world's largest companies     Bringing core services in-house:  running durable execution, vector search and agent sandboxes inside our own infrastructure rather than renting them as a service     Data:  scaling and tuning our databases, and owning where our data layer goes next     Developer experience:  a fast, reliable local setup, preview environments from any branch, and build tooling and CI that keep up with a growing team     Observability:  end-to-end tracing, structured logging and alerting that product engineers can self-serve     AI infrastructure:  our LLM gateway, model routing, cost monitoring and resilience to flaky providers       OUR STACK  Our stack prioritises what matters: shipping to customers—fast—without compromising on quality and engineering.  Fundamentals are more important to us than familiarity with any technology or tool: if you're strong, we're sure you'll pick it up fast.    Here's our setup:    Azure, managed with Terraform: everything as code, with multi-cloud integrations for LLM providers across AWS, GCP and others    Kotlin and TypeScript services in a containerised monorepo, with CI/CD on GitHub Actions    Temporal and PortKey: durable execution and enterprise-compliant LLM routing at the core of our platform    Postgres for our data layer, with TurboPuffer for vector search    Agent sandboxes running on Daytona and other providers    OpenTelemetry and Honeycomb for observability    Find more  English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom  on Arbeitnow

job.description: We started building Marshmallow in 2017. Since then, we’ve grown from 3 to 700+ people, gained unicorn status, raised ~£140M over three funding rounds, turned profitable, insured millions of drivers and lent millions in car loans.    But we’re only just getting started. Our goal is to become one of the largest financial services providers in the world. Over the next 10 years we’ll grow exponentially, not only by scaling our existing products, but also by building new ones.    To achieve our goals we need incredibly ambitious, commercially driven people who never settle for ‘good enough’. Marshmallowers are hungry for autonomy and ownership, and would rather improve than coast. Everyone raises standards and has an impact, with a focus on collective success over self-interest.    We’ve created an environment where curious, tenacious people win and grow together. If that sounds motivating, this could be the place for you.      London (hybrid, 3 days in office)        Pricing at Marshmallow   This role will sit in the Pricing Team, reporting into the Pricing Data Science Manager. The team is responsible for managing our loss ratio, underwriting footprint, broker optimisation and growth targets, proving integral to driving the business forwards. But you’ve probably read that all before! So what’s new?  We work in a very different way to most pricing teams that you might be familiar with. Everyone in Pricing has the potential to make significant contribution to the business, taking ownership, moving fast, innovating and delivering changes to our rates at high frequency.  We don’t just churn out GLMs all day. We build & deploy exceptional in-house pricing data science models using the latest modelling techniques. You’ll work alongside other Pricing Data Scientists & Analysts pushing innovative pricing projects, whilst also being able to work with the wider Data Science community on modelling customer behaviour, fraud & MLENG enhancements.  We work alongside a bunch of amazing engineers who ensure we can implement our decisions quickly. We also have access to huge amounts of data. We don’t just mean your standard policy, claims and quote data. Our engineers spend their lives building APIs to third parties so that we know more about our customers than any of our competitors.  All of this means that you’ll have access to as much data as you can handle, the freedom to be creative, the backing of senior leaders to make decisions, and the ability to see your ideas implemented rapidly. And on top of all of that, we’re a pretty fun group to hang around with!      What you’ll be doing     Developing a deep understanding of Marshmallow’s quote, policy and claims data and use this to derive insights that can be used to enhance our pricing.    Own one of the strategic initiatives of the pricing team, such as supporting our expansion plans or protecting our renewing customers.    Conducting claims analysis and claims modelling using SQL and Python.    Conducting price optimisation analysis/modelling using Python.    Building and deploying models in APIs for use in real time pricing.    Identify new sources of external data that enable us to refine our view of claims risk, and conduct analysis to quantify their value.    Working directly with our Engineering & MLENG functions to implement pricing proposals.    Providing pricing support for the launch of multiple new products.     Who are you? Ability to interrogate data and conduct pricing analysis within SQL & Python/R    Ability to build GLMs, GBMs and other claims models within Python/R    Experience working in a data driven (ideally commercial) role (quant, credit, fraud etc)        Perks of the job     Bonus scheme designed to reward high performance    Private medical insurance with Vitality, mental health support with Oliva    Personal learning budget and 2 dedicated L&D days a year    Monthly flexible benefits budget to spend as you choose    25 days holiday plus bank holidays    4 weeks Work From Anywhere per year        We are not able to offer visa sponsorship for this position.       Our process     Initial call with a member from our Talent Team (30 mins)    Combined Past Experience & Technical interview (90 mins)    Onsite Culture interviews (90 mins)     Diversity of thought   We know the best ideas come from having different perspectives in the room - and we're committed to hiring fairly, regardless of background, identity or experience. job.description: About Allica Bank   Allica is the UK’s fastest growing company - and the fastest-growing financial technology (Fintech) firm ever. Our purpose is to help established SMEs, one of the last major underserved opportunities in Fintech.  Established SMEs are the backbone of local communities - representing over a third of our economy - yet have been largely neglected both by traditional high street banks and modern fintech providers. We’ve built an award-winning business current account for established SMEs that pairs genuinely great technology with bestin-class customer experience – and goes beyond payments to make running a business’s finances simple and painless.   You’ll be part of the Payments Tribe, supporting the squads that together cover the full product. Product, engineering, design and data work side by side, in close partnership with Distribution, Operations, Compliance and Risk. Our job is to take the complex problems SMEs face, the ones the big banks have neglected for years, and solve them with simple, elegant products. If you want to see your work ship quickly and make a real difference to UK SMEs, this is the place to do it. You’ll turn data, customer feedback and business requirements into clear insight and well-defined user stories, so the squads build the right things – and builds them well. Nieuwe concepten verkennen en testen:    Je vertaalt inzichten naar kansen en ideeën. Bijdragen aan implementatie:    Je werkt ontwerpen samen met Engineering uit tot werkende productervaringen. Waar passend kun je zelf vibecoden om wijzigingen in de productcode te maken, met review door Engineering.       Leren van resultaten:    Je gebruikt feedback, tests en gebruiksdata om te beoordelen of je ontwerp werkt en wat beter kan.       Je werkt samen met collega’s uit Product, Engineering, Educatie, Data, Marketing en Design. Je wordt ook onderdeel van de design guild binnen Futurewhiz: een plek om design werk te bespreken, kennis te delen en elkaar te helpen groeien.        🔥 Wie ben jij?     Je bent een Product Designer die graag uitzoekt waarom mensen iets nodig hebben en hoe een ontwerp daarop kan aansluiten. Je voelt je prettig wanneer een vraagstuk nog open is en weet onderzoek om te zetten in concrete vervolgstappen.      Daarnaast:      Je hebt 3+ jaar ervaring als Product Designer, UX Designer of UX/UI Designer en hebt digitale producten ontworpen en opgeleverd in een multidisciplinair team.      Je kunt zelfstandig onderzoek doen: onderzoeksvragen formuleren, passende onderzoeksmethoden kiezen, uitvoering en bevindingen vertalen naar ontwerpkeuzes.      Je begrijpt het verschil tussen wat gebruikers zeggen, wat ze doen en wat je daaruit kunt concluderen.      Je verkent meerdere ideeën voordat je een richting kiest en gebruikt prototypes om snel te leren.      Je hebt goede vaardigheden in UI design, visueel ontwerp en prototyping, bij voorkeur met Figma.      Je kunt gebruikersbehoeften afwegen tegen leerdoelen, productdoelen en technische mogelijkheden.      Je legt je keuzes helder uit, staat open voor feedback en neemt verantwoordelijkheid voor de kwaliteit van je werk. job.description:
About CreativeX

CreativeX is B2B SaaS technology platform that helps global marketing teams make smarter creative decisions and elevate creative expression through the clarity of data. Our technology powers creative decision-making at some of the biggest brands in the world, including Google, Unilever, Pepsi, Bayer, Mondelez, Heineken, and more.

We use computer vision and other machine learning techniques to extract creative data from our client's digital advertising copy and transform those previously dark signals into a standardised data model at industrial scale. This creates a new, unique and powerful first party data set that represents the last and most impactful untapped reservoir of advertising performance.

That's because multiple studies have shown that the "Creative" itself is responsible for half of sales lift online, higher than reach, targeting, brand, & recency combined. But creative impact has always been the least analysed and least understood component of a complex set of marketing variables.

This is the problem CreativeX is focussed on solving. We're an end-to-end solution to ingest, process, and analyse content at scale. We help brands isolate creative elements so they can be analysed against downstream ad impact metrics, from clickthrough rates to brand lift.

Our objective is to help marketing organisations power every creative decision with data.

Product Design Team

As a Product Designer, you'll help shape the next generation of the CreativeX platform, taking problems from discovery through to shipped experiences across defined areas of the product. You'll be the design lead in a product trio alongside a Product Manager and an Engineering Lead, owning whether users want what we build and whether they can figure out how to use it, while sharing discovery, outcomes and trade-offs with your partners. CreativeX is a complex product with rich data, multiple user types and increasingly sophisticated AI capabilities, and as AI increases the volume and speed of creative production, you'll make that complexity work for marketers, helping them measure performance fast, find the patterns behind what's working and see whether their full set of ads is delivering the strategy. Our roadmap is framed as problems to solve, not screens to make, so we expect you to bring a point of view. Product Design is a small, hands-on team in a scale-up: you'll be trusted with real ownership early, and this hire is an important step in growing the team.

What you will do

  • Own design for defined product areas, from understanding the problem through to working with Product and Engineering to ship the right experience
  • Get close to marketers and creative teams through customer conversations, research and usability testing, using what you learn to inform design decisions
  • Partner with Product and Engineering in discovery

job.description: We started building Marshmallow in 2017. Since then, we’ve grown from 3 to 700+ people, gained unicorn status, raised ~£140M over three funding rounds, turned profitable, insured millions of drivers and lent millions in car loans.    But we’re only just getting started. Our goal is to become one of the largest financial services providers in the world. Over the next 10 years we’ll grow exponentially, not only by scaling our existing products, but also by building new ones.    To achieve our goals we need incredibly ambitious, commercially driven people who never settle for ‘good enough’. Marshmallowers are hungry for autonomy and ownership, and would rather improve than coast. Everyone raises standards and has an impact, with a focus on collective success over self-interest.    We’ve created an environment where curious, tenacious people win and grow together. If that sounds motivating, this could be the place for you.      London (hybrid, 3 days in office)      We are not able to offer visa sponsorship for this position.      Marshmallow makes insurance work for everyone, including people the industry has overlooked. Your difference makes the difference, and we design for it.  We’re looking for a Product Designer to join our Telematics team. Telematics is a key part of Marshmallow’s future that sits within Acquisition and how we grow our user base.  In a nutshell, you’ll help more people get onboarded into Marshmallow by reducing friction in our sign up and activation flow. Longer term, you’ll be part of the team that build customer stickiness by working out how to reward and engage customers for being good drivers. You’ll work with a team that will back you up, and you’ll own problems from day one.     What you’ll be doing      Starting with the problem.  You’ll shape what we’re solving by doing research with customers, spotting patterns, and turning what you hear into clear themes and needs the team can act on.     Designing the whole journey.  Wireframes, prototypes, flow to polished screens. You’ll be translating complex concepts into clear, benefit-led experiences. You’ll be thinking about the content on the screen and edge cases too. It’s primarily customer facing, web and app but if your work touches our internal tools, you’ll be thinking about that too.     Letting data point the way.  You’ll use funnel and analytics data to find where customers get stuck and where we could be causing harm. Then you’ll work with your team to fix it.     Building with engineers.  You’ll work alongside them from the first idea to what’s shipped. Clear specs and smooth handoffs. If a design tweak is quicker to ship yourself, you can raise the PR.     Working in a cross-functional team.  Product managers, engineers, operations, data and other designers. You’ll continuously challenge and learn from each other.     Bringing stakeholders with you.  Acquisition gets a lot of attention here. You’ll form your own opinions, explain your thinking, and keep people in the loop. You won’t be doing it alone, and we’ll help you build the skill.     Looking after the design system.  Contribute to it, keep things consistent with our brand, and flag anything that doesn’t fit so we can sort it.     Using AI every day.  For research, analysis and production. Try tools, keep what works, and share it with the team.     You should apply if      You have a commercial instinct.  You have good gut instinct on what makes a product work and a portfolio that backs up what you’ve shipped having good business impact.     You have a proactive mind-set.  You look to make continuous improvement to the products that you are working on. You find issues and features, write up tickets and ship them when they’re ready.     You are actively using AI.  You’ve used AI to optimise your workflow and create efficiency gains whether that’s building prototypes,  shipping to production, analysing data or conducting research.     You prefer to ship quickly and learn.  We like to move quickly and learn from real data. This means being able to spot when good is good enough and iterating. job.description: Scope   automates the data collection that's slowing down the physical world.  Standards are vital for the safety of our infrastructure. Spending hours manually documenting them is not.  Dave is an inspector. Today he's climbing through one of Europe's biggest chemical plants, looking for the corrosion that could shut the whole site down, with a notebook and pen in hand. Tomorrow, he'll spend even longer on the part of the job he hates: turning those scribbles into a report.  We're building the best AI-native data collection layer for the 2 billion field workers like Dave. Scope radically simplifies how inspectors collect data in the field, make decisions, and produce reports. Along the way, we're building the world's largest dataset on the condition of the built world and the decisions experts make about it.  It's a $2T market and we're just getting started, with ambitions. We work with 6 of the top 10 companies in the space. Our customers inspect facilities and products for companies including AstraZeneca and SpaceX.  We've assembled a best-in-class team: acquired and future founders, people from institutions like Imperial, Carnegie Mellon and Oxford, and from firms like Goldman Sachs, Flexport and Amazon.  Since launching from Entrepreneurs First in 2024, we've raised an oversubscribed $20m round led by   Index Ventures  , the firm behind Figma, Revolut and Wiz, with 100+ unicorns backed to date.     About the role   We're hiring our first Product Designer.  Every engineer at Scope is a product engineer: they talk to users, decide what to build and ship it themselves. You'll work the same way, with design as your edge, and help the engineers around you to build a better product. That covers the whole experience, not just the surface: which problem we solve, how the flow works, what happens when things go wrong, and how it all looks. You'll work closely with the engineers, with Ish our Product Manager, and with Jakob the CTO.  We work in person five days a week from our office in Farringdon.     What you'll work on   Some examples of surfaces in our product that will need your help:    Our mobile app gets used inside tanks and on top of pressure vessels. People wear thick gloves, there's usually no signal, and one hand is often holding on to something. Most of what makes a normal app pleasant doesn't apply there, so a big part of the job is figuring out what does.    Then there's the report. How AI and the inspector will work together to produce 40 page reports and review them is something nobody has designed well yet.    Inspectors but also decision makers should be able to ask things like "Which tanks were over the corrosion limit last year?". Sometimes the right interface will be a chat but often it isn't. job.description: Akur8 is one of the leading providers of insurance pricing and rating technology. Our mission is to modernize how insurers assess, price, and manage risk.    Our SaaS platform combines transparent machine learning, predictive analytics, and rating technology to turn complex insurance workflows into scalable, data-driven systems. Insurers use it to model and rate risk up to 10x faster while keeping transparency, explainability, and regulatory trust.    As the product suite expands, we are building an end-to-end platform for pricing, reserving, and forward-looking risk decisions.    Recognized globally, Akur8 has been featured in:      CB Insights' Insurtech 50 (2025)    CNBC's InsurTech Top 150 (2025)    InsurTech100 Global Insurtech Top 100 (2025)    Professional Equality Index 97/100 (2025)     Akur8 has 50+ nationalities across 8 global offices and serves 420+ clients across 4 continents. We’re an equal opportunities employer, and we value the different perspectives that help shape better products and decisions.            Insurance companies use Akur8 to decide the price of millions of policies. We are looking for a talented Product Engineer to build the features they rely on to do it.     You will join the Pricing team, which builds the part of the Akur8 platform that Actuaries, Underwriters and Product Owners use to design, test and deploy their rates. Your mission is to scope, design and implement features that automate the rating process at insurance companies, from the first discussion of a client need to the feature running in production.    Much of the work is deciding what to build, not only building it. You will work with Product Managers, Designers, Actuaries and other Engineers to understand how insurers price risk, why they work the way they do, and where software can make them faster and more accurate. A good understanding of modelling, maths and logic is needed for this.    At its core, this is a hands-on software engineering role. You will spend significant time writing code, designing data models, building backend and frontend services, and ensuring the systems you ship are scalable, tested, and maintainable.    With AI being a reliable support for implementation, your main value will come from understanding the business context, the architecture and the data models as these will determine the quality of your deliveries. Our platform runs on AWS with Rust, Java, Python, and Angular. Prior experience with them is a plus.    You will work on the core of the platform from your first weeks and see the impact of your work on real clients.     In this role, you will:       Own product features end to end: clarify the need with the product team, scope it, design the solution, build it and follow it in production.    Turn requests from Actuaries, Underwriters and Product Owners into a clear scope, and challenge a requirement when a simpler solution meets the need.    Work in an AI native-engineering team: delegate implementation to deliver quickly, reviewing, test and own responsibility for everything you ship.    Balance delivery speed and robustness according to the client’s priorities.      Your work will help insurers price risk faster and more accurately, and will expand what Akur8 can offer its clients.             We’re looking for someone driven by outcomes: things done fast, done well, and useful to our clients.       You have completed or are finishing a PhD in Computer Science, Applied Mathematics, Physics, or another quantitative field. No professional experience is required.        You have written code during your research and want to grow in software engineering practices such as testing, code review and system design, using AI coding assistants as part of your daily work.        You are comfortable with ambiguity: you can take a loosely defined problem, structure it and move it forward without waiting for a step-by-step brief.        You take a pragmatic approach to writing code: you care about solving the actual problem rather than chasing perfection, and you can explain the trade-offs behind your technical choices.        You care about results more than about technology: you want to understand why a feature matters to the end user before deciding how to build it.       Prior experience with our tech stack (Rust, Java, Python, Angular, AWS) or the insurance space is welcome, but not required. We invest heavily in onboarding; what matters most is your curiosity and appetite to learn.      Important : You must possess an employment status: French or Schengen area nationality or a ‘carte de séjour’ that will allow you to work from our Paris office. We are equally open to the visa sponsorship of non-EU candidates as long as they are already in possession of their final diploma / attestation of their final academic results.             As a newcomer, you'll be joining a diverse, highly skilled and motivated team, with a strong Tech DNA, colleagues that are eager to share their knowledge and passion.     But it’s not all work, you’ll also be part of a dynamic team that enjoys spending time together and having fun, including karaoke, team lunches, playing sports as well as the occasional ‘happy hour’. These checks may include verification of employment history, education, and, where legally authorized, criminal records. Any background checks will be performed lawfully before formal employment contracts are signed, with the candidate’s consent, and all information collected will be handled confidentially.    We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to assist with certain stages of the recruitment process. These tools are used to support our recruitment team and do not replace human decision-making. job.description:
Product Manager - Agent Experience 

Location: Paris, France preferred, open to London applicants (hybrid, three days a week in the office)
Team: Customer care
Salary: €46,000 – €55,000 / £47,000 – £59,000
Language: Fluency in French & English
Contract: Permanent 
Reporting To: Lead Product Manager

Please note: This role requires an existing right to work in the EU. We can’t offer visa sponsorship, but we review sponsorship role by role, so keep an eye on our careers site for future opportunities.

About Kaluza

Kaluza is the Energy Intelligence Platform, turning energy complexity into seamless coordination. We help energy companies overcome today’s challenges while accelerating the shift to a clean, electrified future.

Our platform orchestrates millions of real-time decisions across homes, devices, markets and grids. By combining predictive algorithms with human-centred design, Kaluza makes clean energy dependable, affordable and adaptive to everyday life.

With teams across Europe, Asia and Australia, and a joint venture with Mitsubishi Corporation in Japan, we power leading companies including OVO, AGL and ENGIE, as well as innovators like Volvo and Volkswagen.

What you’ll do

  • Own the Roadmap: Lead the end-to-end strategy for Kaluza Agent Experience (KAE) within the European market—grounded in global product goals but sharpened by local client needs and agent behaviors. Driving core operational metrics (AHT, FCR, CSAT, AI adoption, onboarding)ensuring capabilities improve agent/customer outcomes.
  • Drive Journey Design & UX Consistency: Act as guardian of agent UX across KAE to ensure coherence across the experience. Partnering with UX and domain teams to apply shared patterns consistently, reduce agent cognitive load, and maintain alignment and compliance with the design system as new automation and assistive/AI capabilities are introduced.
  • Lead Integrations & Client Onboarding: Drive technical and product integrations with third-party platforms and oversee spinning up new KAE instances end-to-end for incoming clients from discovery through go-live.
  • Ensure Accessibility & Compliance: Champion EU accessibility regulations by design, translating regulatory and market-specific needs into actionable engineering requirements.
  • Engage Clients & Drive Value: Serve as the trusted expert for clients on agent experience, advocating for platform-first configuration over bespoke builds
  • Hands-on Delivery & Enablement: Maintain active involvement across the entire Product Development Life Cycle (PDLC)—from agent discovery sessions to feedback loops—and produce materials to support successful client adoption.

    (Note: Travel to client sites e.g., Brussels, is expected at roughly 1–3 trips a month initially, tapering to 1–2 times a quarter.)

What you’ll bring

Ideally, you’ll have:

  • Contact Centre & UX Expertise: Deep experience owning end-to-end user journeys for high-frequency operational tools (e.g., agent desktops), with hands-on craft in user research, journey mapping, and usability testing with agents and supervisors.
  • EU Accessibility & Platform Integration: Strong working knowledge of EU accessibility standards alongside proven experience integrating products with complex third-party platforms and vendor ecosystems.
  • Client Delivery & Market Expansion: Successful track record implementing or localizing a product for external enterprise clients, taking solutions from zero to live through discovery, configuration, and change management.
  • Data-Informed Judgement & Influence: Demonstrated ability using operational metrics (AHT, FCR, CSAT, agent effort) to defend product decisions, coupled with a platform-first mindset that prioritizes existing capabilities over custom code.
  • Bilingual Capability: Full professional bilingual fluency (written and spoken) in both English and French.

What will set you apart 

  • Experience leveraging AI tools, machine learning capabilities, or LLM integrations within product workflows to enhance platform intelligence and automation directly into customer service desktop environments.
  • Prior experience within SaaS platforms, the energy sector, or large-scale utility migrations.
  • Hands-on experience to scale UI consistency across different product teams.
  • Hands-on experience to scale UI consistency across different product teams.

Where you'll work
We offer flexible working, with an expectation of 3 days a week in the office. This gives us the best of both: real time together to collaborate and build relationships, with the flexibility to work in the way that suits you best the rest of the week.

Our Values

Five values guide how we work at Kaluza:

  • Play to win: Collective pride in decarbonising energy at scale.
  • Solve the real problem: Cutting through complexity to focus on real-world outcomes.
  • Build trust every day: Consistency, transparency and doing what we say.
  • Own the outcome: Full accountability, wins and setbacks, without ego.
    Go further together: Collaboration, respect and different perspectives.

Our Perks

  • Financial & Insurance: Discretionary bonus, Alan Mutuelle Health Insurance, x3 Life & Death insurance (Prévoyance) via Alan, and standard Sécurité Sociale contributions (pension, family allowance, unemployment insurance)
  • Allowances: 50% commuting expense reimbursement, €200 Home Working Allowance, and €150 Learning Fund
  • Time Off & Flexibility: 25 days holiday + bank holidays + RTT days, Moments That Matter Leave, Compassionate Leave, two paid Volunteering Days, Flexible Working, and Career Break eligibility

We want the best people
We’re keen to meet people from all walks of life — our view is that the more inclusive we are, the better our work will be. We want to build teams which represent a variety of experiences, perspectives and skills, and we recognise talent on the basis of merit and potential.

Come as you are

We want to meet people from all walks of life. The more inclusive we are, the better our work will be, and we recognise talent on merit and potential. If you’re excited about the role but don’t tick every box, we’d still love to hear from you.

Find out more on our careers page and LinkedIn. Our Applicant Data Protection Policy is here.

job.description: Few people get to build a bank from scratch. Even fewer get to build one at a moment when banking itself is being reinvented.    The Dollar is the best product in the history of the world - there is infinite global demand. But international fintechs and banks are left with two unsatisfying options to choose from: Either build on legacy correspondent banks that are slow and unreliable, or interface with middleware providers that neither move nor hold the dollars directly, but instead rely on underlying legacy banks themselves. At Augustus, we collapse the stack by combining two things: A real, national bank charter (in organization), and Marble, our proprietary core banking system, built around intelligence, made of code.   We are a group of ex-founders, founding employees of unicorns, and people who dropped out of university because they believe this is an industry and career defining opportunity. We are backed with more than $200M from Peter Thiel's Valar Ventures, Tiger Global, Hummingbird, QED, Creandum, and the founders of Nubank, Ramp, Deel, Circle, Fluidstack, Fuse, and Etched.   We are regulated in Europe and live with Euro and Stablecoin clearing today. Now, we are building the US team from the ground up, while continuing to grow rapidly in Europe.     The Role   You own Banking Experience: the accounts at the center of customer's relationship with the bank, and the  API and dashboards they use to manage them.  In this role you’re responsible for redefining what beautiful software in banking looks like. You'll define account structures that give customers powerful building blocks for their products, and craft intuitive interfaces grounded in a deep understanding of their use cases and workflows.  You report to Will, Head of Product, and work closely with Simon, our CTO. You're expected to operate with full autonomy on your team's roadmap, collaborating with design and engineering.     Your First Six Months      Months 1-2:  Take over day-to-day ownership of the Banking Experience team - the roadmap, the ways of working, the hard decisions. Establish yourself with customers and how they use our accounts. You define and ship your first project.     Months 3-4:  Execution mode. You're unblocking engineering daily, making hard prioritization calls, and shipping your roadmap to customers. You're proactively raising the bar across accounts, API, and dashboard by feeding what you learn from customers into the product.     Months 5-6:  You're working with live customers on the products you've built. Deposits and number of account holders are scaling. You've moved from execution to platform mode - evolving the roadmap based on what our customers are building on top of Augustus.       Who Will Thrive At Augustus   We believe that throwing smart people with high agency at big problems produces the best outcomes. We’re building a modern correspondent bank, and we win by having a better team. The people who succeed here share the following traits:     American Dream:  You’d rather shoot for gold than settle for mediocrity. You pick the harder goal and stay optimistic when the odds are against you. If it feels easy, we aimed too low.     Live Player:  You don’t need permission. You rebuild what’s broken without being asked, challenge how things are done, and move before the perfect moment.     Ever to Excel:  You can’t accept good enough and you take your work personally. When it matters, you do what it takes and keep raising the bar for yourself and your team.     Genuine:  You play for the company, not your title or turf. Low ego, low drama, no politics. You say it straight, also upwards and always assume good intent.     This role is for you if:     You want to spend time with customers to intimately understand and then innovate on their workflows.    You’re a structured and relentless problem solver.    You combine first-principles thinking with deep domain knowledge to make complex processes simple.    You have taste and care deeply about the quality of what you build.    You leverage AI to push the boundaries of what a PM can do.    You’re excited about building a programmable bank and helping shape what that means.       Hard Requirements     Experience end-to-end owning and building banking, fintech, or developer platform products.    Technical enough to spar on architectural decisions with engineers - you're comfortable in API design discussions, not just UI reviews.    You have strong opinions on information architecture and how to organize complex products so they feel simple.    Comfortable in customer-facing roles - you've pitched, demoed, and can close early adopters.    Based in Berlin or New York, or willing to relocate.       Pay transparency   Compensation packages at Augustus include base salary, equity, and benefits. New hire offers are made based on a candidate's experience, expertise and geographic location. The annual US base salary range for this role is €90,000-€120,000 + equity.     What We Offer      Career Growth:  You will be given more responsibility and pushed to grow faster than ever before.     Network:  Your peers are brilliant, highly motivated people. These people will be foundational in your future opportunities.     Real Participation:  Employees are shareholders. You will think and act like an owner.     Perks & Benefits:  Relocation support, visa support, the latest Apple gear (MacBook + AirPods), lunch benefit, gym benefit, a beautiful office in the heart of the city, 4x on-/offsites per year, and an annual development budget.    Additional to the global benefits above, we offer localized benefits such as comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance and a 401(k) retirement plan for our US team.     Augustus is committed to creating an inclusive environment where people from all backgrounds can thrive and where different viewpoints and experiences are valued and respected. Augustus will consider all applications for employment without regard to race, ethnicity, national origin, religious beliefs, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, neurodiversity, disability, age, parental or veteran status.    Compensation: €90K – €120K • Offers Equity    • €90K – €120K • Offers Equity   Find more  English Speaking Jobs in Germany  on Arbeitnow

At this time, we are not able to offer visa sponsorship for this role. We are committed to building a diverse, global team and our sponsorship policy is evaluated on a role-by-role basis. We encourage you to keep an eye on our careers site to stay informed about future opportunities where we are able to offer visa sponsorship     Fluent French and English (spoken and written) are essential for this position. Please submit your profile in English.      Kaluza is the Energy Intelligence Platform, turning energy complexity into seamless coordination. We help energy companies overcome today's challenges while accelerating the shift to a clean, electrified future. Leveraging Data, AI, and real-time decision-making we turn energy complexity into growth opportunities for our partners.  By combining predictive algorithms with human-centred design, Kaluza makes clean energy dependable and affordable.  With teams across Europe, North America, Asia and Australia, and a joint venture with Mitsubishi Corporation in Japan, we power leading companies including OVO, AGL and ENGIE, as well as innovators like Volvo and Volkswagen.   Where in the world of Kaluza will I be working   You will be specifically working with the team building out our contact centre solution and the  Kaluza Agent Experience (KAE).  Our Customer Care platform powers AI-driven, cost-efficient service operations for global energy retailers, enabling personalised customer experiences across contact centres, digital channels, and case management.  This role is mission-critical to Kaluza’s vision. You will lead the product strategy, delivery, and client outcomes for Kaluza’s Customer Care solutions for  ENGIE France , while contributing to the evolution of our Global Core capabilities.   What will I be doing?   As the Customer Care Product Manager, you are accountable for the outcomes delivered by your product. You will ensure design and engineering teams have absolute clarity on priorities and scope to drive meaningful results for end users and commercial value.   You will:      Lead Product Strategy:  Own the Customer Care product strategy and roadmap for Kaluza clients in France, balancing Global Core reuse with specific French localisation requirements.     Build High-Value Solutions:  Develop our suite of tools for the Contact Centre Solution, including CCaaS (Contact Centre as a Service) and Case Management, to enable efficient, high-value conversations.     Drive AI Innovation:  Utilise the latest AI technology to automate and personalise the customer experience and champion agent productivity tools.     Foster Client Partnerships:  Act as the senior product counterpart to client stakeholders (such as ENGIE), leading workshops and translating their needs into scalable capabilities.     Execute & Optimise:  Lead cross-functional teams (engineering, design, data, and commercial) to ensure efficient delivery, removing blockers and resolving cross-team dependencies.     Deliver Operational Excellence:  Define and track key contact centre metrics such as AHT, FCR, CSAT, and NPS to ensure solutions deliver measurable cost-to-serve improvements.     Is this the job for me?   You are the right person for us if you:    Have significant  product leadership experience in enterprise SaaS  and have worked in agile product organisations.    Possess deep knowledge of  contact centre operations  and agent workflows.    Have experience working with  French enterprise clients  and a strong understanding of localisation requirements, including language and regulation.    Are skilled at  stakeholder management at the executive level , with the ability to manage trade-offs between speed and long-term value.    Are data-oriented, with an adeptness for using  operational metrics  to assess product performance and drive continuous improvement.    Have a background in  energy retail or utilities  (this will set you apart!).    Are excited by  AI-driven automation , including voice bots and agent assist technology.     Kaluza Values   Here at Kaluza we have five core values that guide us as a business:   Play to win, Solve the real problem, Build trust every day, Own the outcome, Go further together       We want the best people   We’re keen to meet people from all walks of life — our view is that the more inclusive we are, the better our work will be. We want to build teams which represent a variety of experiences, perspectives and skills, and we recognise talent on the basis of merit and potential.  We understand some people may not apply for jobs unless they tick every box. But if you're excited about joining us and think you have some of what we're looking for, even if you're not 100% sure, we'd still love to hear from you.   • Build, don't just specify. Go from idea to working prototype yourself — query data, sketch API contracts, and stand up proofs of concept. We expect you to use AI tooling (e.g. Claude Code) as a daily multiplier to prototype, investigate, and unblock, not just to draft documents.
  • Align global and local teams across all functions — partner closely with engineering, UX, QA and more, with full-stack influence, keeping everyone pointed at the right outcomes. Be the go-to person for this product area in France, and act as the link between our global and local teams to inform priorities and strategy.

  • Proven experience as a Product Manager, Business Analyst, or equivalent role in software companies, with a strong track record of successfully localising complex software products for international markets
  • Previous experience in the French energy industry — you know how the market works and its key players (e.g. Enedis / GRDF), especially around device data and market flows. Experience with energy management or utility platforms in the French market is a strong plus.
  • Fluent in French and very comfortable in English — our platform and many of our teams operate in English, so you move easily between both.
  • Confident working directly with clients — you can run a working session with client stakeholders, draw out the real requirement behind the ask, and keep senior people aligned and brought in.

  • A clear, sharp communicator — able to cut through noise and articulate technical and market complexity to a range of stakeholders, including clients.

job.description:
Product Manager - Products and Pricing

Location: London, UK (hybrid, three days a week in the office)
Salary: £50,000 – £60,000
Team: Energy Commerce
Contract: Permanent 

Please note: This role requires an existing right to work in the UK. We can’t offer visa sponsorship, but we review sponsorship role by role, so keep an eye on our careers site for future opportunities.

About Kaluza

Kaluza is the Energy Intelligence Platform, turning energy complexity into seamless coordination. We help energy companies overcome today’s challenges while accelerating the shift to a clean, electrified future.

Our platform orchestrates millions of real-time decisions across homes, devices, markets and grids. By combining predictive algorithms with human-centred design, Kaluza makes clean energy dependable, affordable and adaptive to everyday life.

With teams across Europe, Asia and Australia, and a joint venture with Mitsubishi Corporation in Japan, we power leading companies including OVO, AGL and ENGIE, as well as innovators like Volvo and Volkswagen.

What you’ll do

  • Lead the localisation efforts for our products and pricing capabilities, ensuring they meet the specific commercial, regulatory, market, and cultural requirements of retailers in Europe.  This will include European localisations such as indexation and unbundled energy products as well as broader market promotions and discounts.
  • Deep dive into European energy market structures and regulations for designated countries, translating complex needs into detailed product specifications.  Understand the broader context of piercing and selling products in Europe and the required tooling, workflows and models to accelerate our retailers
  • Collaborate intensely with clients and in-country experts to understand their unique needs and requirements. You will be the first point of contact with the client for all domain specific needs.
  • Coordinate cross domain discovery and delivery for features that support key journeys, aligning requirements where needed (eg. billing, quoting and energy insights).
  • Define and manage detailed product requirements for features related to country-specific needs to support energy products and pricing.
  • Contribute to the Global Energy Commerce roadmap, when new acceleration opportunities are identified.
  • Work closely with engineering, UX, and QA teams to ensure the successful implementation and testing of localised billing functionalities.
  • Act as the go-to expert for global teams on specific European market nuances related to energy products and pricing and related customer journeys.

    (Note: Travel to client sites e.g., Brussels, is expected at roughly 1–3 trips a month initially, tapering to 1–2 times a quarter.)

What you’ll bring

Ideally, you’ll have:

  • Proven experience as a Product Manager with a strong track record of successfully localising complex software products for international markets.
  • Able to establish and maintain great relationships with B2B clients, throughout the entire product lifecycle.
  • Solid understanding of the end-to-end energy lifecycle within a European context, with a particular focus on retailer commercial operations.
  • Direct experience with specific European energy markets, understanding their unique regulatory frameworks and requirements
  • Exceptional ability to translate abstract regulatory text or client requirements into clear, actionable requirements for development teams.
  • Experience collaborating with cross-functional teams (engineering, legal, operations, client success) to deliver localised solutions.
  • Experience working alongside multiple services/domains to deliver complex journeys.
  • Excellent communication skills, able to articulate technical and market complexities to various stakeholders, including clients.

What will set you apart 

  • Deep, hands-on experience with the French or Belgian energy retail markets, particularly concerning their energy products and pricing specificities.
  • Proficiency in a second European language relevant to key target markets (e.g., French).
  • Experience with large-scale data migration and integration projects involving legacy billing systems.
  • A background in energy commercial operations or regulatory affairs within a European energy retailer.

Where you'll work
We offer flexible working, with an expectation of 3 days a week in the office. This gives us the best of both: real time together to collaborate and build relationships, with the flexibility to work in the way that suits you best the rest of the week.

Our Values

Five values guide how we work at Kaluza:

  • Play to win: Collective pride in decarbonising energy at scale.
  • Solve the real problem: Cutting through complexity to focus on real-world outcomes.
  • Build trust every day: Consistency, transparency and doing what we say.
  • Own the outcome: Full accountability, wins and setbacks, without ego.
    Go further together: Collaboration, respect and different perspectives.

Our Perks

  • Time off and family: 26 days’ holiday, plus 26 weeks’ full pay for new parents with no qualifying service period
  • Health and security: Private medical insurance with virtual GP, life assurance, pension scheme, free mortgage advice and eye tests
  • Pay and flexibility: Discretionary bonus, a Flex Fund of 5% [of salary] to spend on the benefits you want most, retail discounts through Perks at Work
  • Growth and setup: Personal learning budget, home office budget
  • Climate: Furthr, our climate action app

We want the best people
We’re keen to meet people from all walks of life — our view is that the more inclusive we are, the better our work will be. We want to build teams which represent a variety of experiences, perspectives and skills, and we recognise talent on the basis of merit and potential.

Come as you are

We want to meet people from all walks of life. The more inclusive we are, the better our work will be, and we recognise talent on merit and potential. If you’re excited about the role but don’t tick every box, we’d still love to hear from you.

Find out more on our careers page and LinkedIn. Our Applicant Data Protection Policy is here.

job.description: About us   Founded in 2019 and part of Y Combinator's 2020 cohort,   Photoroom   is the leading visual solution for e-commerce.  We've raised Series B funding and reached 300+ million users worldwide, processing over 5 billion images annually and serving both small businesses and major enterprises like Amazon, DoorDash, and Decathlon through our mobile app, web platform, and API.  We're a team of 100+ passionate builders giving e-commerce businesses superpowers to create visuals that help them grow, making the hardest parts of selling online disappear. We focus on craft, innovation, and collaboration to create exceptional impact for e-commerce businesses worldwide.    Role Summary  We're looking for a  Product ML Engineer  to join one of our product experience teams — SMB, Scaler or Enterprise — and own the ML side of short, high-impact projects.  You'll work on focused ML problems with a clear product outcome, sometimes fine-tuning one of our models, sometimes integrating the best externally available model, but always choosing the fastest and most effective path to customer value.  You'll bring the technical depth of an Applied Scientist while operating with the pace and pragmatism of a product engineer. You'll own the journey from framing the problem through to shipping, measuring and iterating on the feature in production.   This is not a research role.  Your time horizon is weeks rather than quarters, and success is measured by what reaches users and the impact it creates.   About the role     Embed directly within a product team.  Work closely with the SMB, Scaler or Enterprise team on focused ML problems tied to clear customer and business outcomes.     Own ML projects end to end.  Frame the problem, choose the approach, execute the plan, ship the feature and monitor its performance in production.     Make the build vs. buy decision.  Determine when to fine-tune or build a model yourself versus integrating an external model, API or existing library.     Move from idea to production quickly.  Work on projects scoped in weeks rather than quarters, prioritising rapid iteration and customer impact.     Work closely with the ML team.  Leverage shared infrastructure, evaluation tooling and expertise while remaining embedded in the product team's priorities and cadence.     Stay close to users.  Get rapid feedback from customers, monitor how people use what you've shipped and use those insights to drive the next iteration.     Balance technical depth with pragmatism.  Know when deeper modelling work is necessary and when an existing solution is already good enough to ship.     Write production code.  Work directly in the product team's codebase rather than operating primarily through research notebooks and experiments.     Own quality in production.  Build sound evaluations, monitor performance and investigate failures once the feature is live.     About You     You've shipped ML into production.  You have 2+ years of hands-on experience building and shipping ML-powered products, with strong experience in PyTorch or equivalent frameworks such as TensorFlow or JAX.     You have applied-science depth.  You can fine-tune vision or diffusion models, design meaningful evaluations and debug training runs when necessary.     You're a pragmatic builder.  You care about solving the customer's problem rather than proving that your own model is the best approach. You'll happily use an external model, API or existing library when that's the fastest route to value.     You're product-minded.  You measure success through shipped features, user behaviour and business outcomes rather than papers or benchmarks alone.     You're comfortable in production codebases.  You can move between experimentation and production engineering, writing maintainable code that lives inside a real product.     You have strong ownership.  You're comfortable taking an ambiguous ML problem, deciding what matters, choosing an approach and driving it through to production.     You iterate quickly.  You enjoy short feedback loops and would rather ship something useful, learn from users and improve it than spend months optimising something that hasn't reached production.     You're curious and collaborative.  You can both explain your expertise and learn from the deep technical expertise around you. You value knowledge sharing and humility.     You're fluent in English.  French isn't required.     Nice to have:  experience shipping generative image models or diffusion models into production; experience evaluating third-party AI APIs against internal alternatives; experience working in a fast-growing startup or directly within a product team.   Benefits    Competitive salary + meaningful equity    Hybrid working from our Paris headquarters    Visa sponsorship and relocation support up to €10,000    MacBook Pro and full home office setup    30 days annual leave    Private healthcare    Regular company off-sites and team retreats    International English-speaking team    Language lessons in English and French     Hiring Process    Screening with an ML Researcher / Engineer    Home technical assignment and review with the team    Culture fit interview and meet the team    Reference check and offer    Support: We value diversity and aim to create an inclusive experience for all applicants. Please let us know if there's anything we can do to make the process more accessible for you.  Diversity, Equity, Inclusion, and Belonging  We're committed to enabling everyone to feel included and valued at work. We believe our company and culture are strongest when composed of diverse experiences and backgrounds.  That's also why we have flexible working hours, trust people to work in a hybrid environment, and extended parental leave.  All qualified applicants receive consideration for employment without regard to age, color, family, gender identity, marital status, national origin, physical or mental disability, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by applicable laws. job.description: About the Role   There are over 5 billion users using basic applications today such email, notes, tasks, calendar and they're not AI-native. Our mission is to build proactive applications for anyone in the world, who are not used to complex prompting. We aim to bring intelligence to conversations, errands, organising and workflows, with minimal to no prompting.  Our product focuses on achieving high reliability for long-running workflows, persistent context, and real-world task completion. We believe products will greatly reduce hallucinations.  Our objective is to organise anyone's life, allowing us all to spend time on valuable and meaningful things.  As Product Owner, AI Email App, you work at the intersection of user needs, model capability, and engineering constraints. You will work directly with ML and engineering teams to define how the system should behave, how we measure it, and how we continuously improve it.  This is a deeply technical, hands-on role. You are expected to understand the system and challenge technical decisions.     What You'll Own     Define end-to-end requirements for AI capabilities, from model behavior to system behavior to user experience.    Translate model capabilities, evaluation results, and technical constraints into clear product and system decisions.    Make trade-offs across quality, latency, cost, reliability, safety, and UX.    Work closely with ML, backend, and client engineers on system design, evaluation, and iteration.    Define and evolve evaluation frameworks across offline metrics, online experiments, and human feedback.    Establish clear quality bars and feedback loops for AI-powered experiences.    Drive execution through clear specifications, prioritization, and strong technical judgment.    Identify failure modes and ensure AI systems behave predictably and recover gracefully.    Own product quality end-to-end, correctness, reliability, usefulness, and user trust.       What We're Looking For      Technical     Strong computer science fundamentals and system design skills.    Solid understanding of modern ML and how AI systems behave in production.    Comfortable reading technical designs, understanding architectures, and engaging deeply with engineers.    Strong intuition for model limitations, hallucinations, evaluation, and failure modes.       Product & AI     Significant experience owning complex, technical products end-to-end.    Hands-on experience with AI-powered products, particularly LLM-based systems.    Experience with model evaluation, experimentation, prompting, or AI system iteration.    Ability to turn ambiguous problems into clear requirements, measurable outcomes, and executable plans.    Strong judgment and the ability to make decisions when the right answer is not obvious. The Avionics, Guidance, Navigation and Control (GNC), and Flight Software (FSW) functions are central to the safe and reliable operation of the vehicle. Together, they provide the electronic systems, control capabilities and software that guide Nyx through its mission - from launch and on-orbit operations to docking, re-entry and recovery. We are looking for a motivated and experienced Project Manager — Avionics, GNC & Flight Software to coordinate the development and delivery of these critical domains within the Nyx program. Your Mission As Project Manager for Avionics, GNC and Flight Software, you will be responsible for coordinating the execution of these work packages and ensuring that their development remains aligned with the overall Nyx program objectives. You will work closely with Avionics, GNC and FSW technical leads, systems engineering, propulsion, mission operations, verification and integration teams. Your role will be to create transparency on scope, schedule, interfaces, risks and decisions, while supporting the teams in delivering robust and well-verified capabilities for the vehicle. This is a highly cross-functional role for someone who enjoys working at the interface between technical teams, program management and mission execution. Key Responsibilities Own and coordinate the project planning for the Avionics, GNC and FSW work packages within the Nyx program. Translate program objectives and major milestones into clear plans, priorities and deliverables for the relevant teams. Coordinate the development lifecycle from requirements definition and architecture through implementation, integration, verification and release across Avionics, GNC and FSW. Maintain visibility of scope, schedule, dependencies, risks, opportunities and resource needs across the Avionics, GNC and FSW activities. Coordinate closely with the Avionics, GNC and FSW technical leads to monitor progress, identify blockers and support timely decisions. Ensure that technical, program and interface dependencies between Avionics, GNC, FSW, systems engineering, propulsion and mission operations are identified and actively managed. Support the planning and execution of avionics integration, software and hardware-in-the-loop activities, simulations, system integration and mission rehearsals. Coordinate inputs to design reviews, development reviews, qualification activities and other program milestones. Track the preparation and closure of requirements, verification activities, test results, documentation and technical actions. Identify schedule and delivery risks early, define mitigation actions with the relevant owners and escalate unresolved issues when required. Support the management of changes to scope, requirements, interfaces and priorities, ensuring that their impacts are understood. Prepare clear progress updates, decision material and status reports for program and project reviews. Facilitate regular coordination meetings and ensure that actions, decisions and commitments are recorded and followed through. Contribute to resource and capacity planning for the GNC and FSW activities. Support coordination with external partners, suppliers and customers when relevant to the project scope. Contribute to the continuous improvement of project-management processes, planning practices and reporting routines within the Nyx program. What You Bring Experience in project or program management within aerospace, space systems, aviation, automotive, robotics, embedded systems or another safety and reliability critical environment. Practical experience managing plans, milestones, dependencies, risks, actions and technical deliverables. The ability to understand technical topics sufficiently to ask the right questions, identify impacts and support informed decisions. Experience working across requirements, design, implementation, integration, testing and verification activities. Strong organizational and communication skills, with the ability to bring structure and transparency to complex projects. A proactive approach to identifying risks, raising issues early and driving actions to closure. The ability to work effectively with technical experts while maintaining focus on program objectives and delivery commitments. Experience with project-management, planning, requirements-management or engineering tools. A degree or equivalent experience in aerospace engineering, software engineering, systems engineering, project management or a related field. Professional fluency in English. Additional European languages are a plus. What Makes You Special You are technically curious and comfortable working with experts in avionics, GNC, flight software and other disciplines. You can move between detailed technical discussions and program-level decision-making without losing sight of the overall objective. You bring structure without creating unnecessary bureaucracy. You are proactive in identifying dependencies and risks, clear in your communication and persistent in following actions through to closure. You know how to challenge constructively, support technical teams and escalate decisions when the program needs clarity. You are motivated by the opportunity to contribute to a complex space vehicle and understand that reliable GNC and flight software are built through close collaboration, disciplined engineering and continuous verification.
