job.description: Our Mission:  Omnea is the agentic operating system for procurement.  Procurement touches every pound a business spends, yet requests still stall for weeks and approvals get lost in inboxes. Our AI-first platform changes that: our agents capture requests, route approvals, onboard suppliers, flag risk and track every renewal, while anyone in the business can ask a question and get an answer grounded in their own company’s data. Buying becomes painless for everyone, procurement gets a seat at the table, and our customers have saved more than 100,000 hours of manual work so far.  Companies like Spotify, PayPal, T. Rowe Price, JustEat, Adyen and S&P Global run procurement on Omnea. We’re backed by $75M from Khosla Ventures, Insight Partners and Accel, and we’ve been named the UK’s number one startup in the Startups 100, ranked 11th on Sifted’s 2026 list of Europe’s fastest-growing companies, and recognised as one of Fast Company’s Most Innovative Companies.  Talent density matters more to us than almost anything else. We keep the bar high in every team, so everyone here has real ownership and real impact. Our team is full of former founders and operators who’ve scaled unicorns, and we’re looking for people who want to do the best work of their careers alongside them.    Find out more about the team and life at Omnea  here .    The Jump:   The Jump is Omnea's 12-month programme for ambitious engineers who want to make the jump to senior, faster than they could elsewhere. You'll join one of our product teams as a Product Engineer and take on progressively bigger, harder work, with the support to grow into it.  Plenty of companies promise fast progression. We back it with structure:     Real scope.  Ship from week one, own a feature end to end in your first quarter, and lead a project with one or two other engineers by months 6–9.     A buddy for the year.  An experienced engineer from another team, not your manager, who meets you every month for the full 12 months and talks you through how they make decisions.     Six practical sessions in your first six months.  Live, in-person sessions across two Jump Day afternoons, covering impact, autonomy, product and design, customers, commercial and influence. Each is built around a real Omnea project and applied straight to your own work. No bootcamp.     Honest feedback.  A monthly self-review talked through with your buddy, and a quarterly progression review with your team lead, so you always know where you stand.     Promotion when you're ready.  As soon as you're consistently operating at the next level, judged against the same bar as everyone else. Not held for an annual review.     What Success Looks Like:  We expect you to be operating at the next level within about 12 months. We'll give you the scope, the buddy and the feedback, so you can drive your progression as fast and as far as you can. We'll track your progress together through structured checkpoints across the year, so you always know where you stand.  Our bar is high. Our levels mean more here than at most companies, and promotion is judged on how you operate, not on finishing a programme.   What We're Looking For:  We're looking for product-minded engineers with real drive to join our engineering team. We're a tight-knit group of ambitious builders who hold the bar high. It took over 10,000 interviews to hire our first 50 Omneans. Over the next year, our engineering team will double in size, our enterprise customer base will grow from ~220 to 400+, and revenue will triple. In this role, you'll build high-quality product features and systems using the latest in AI, both as a developer tool and embedded directly into our product, owning meaningful problem spaces end-to-end and having a direct impact on customers as we scale.   What Can You Expect On Our Engineering Team?     Join a Skilled Team.  Become part of one of Europe's fastest-growing software companies, working alongside experienced full-stack product engineers from top technology businesses and startups.     Direct Product Impact.  Help shape key product decisions, including roadmap prioritisation, project scoping, technical direction, user experience, and implementation strategy.     Work with Modern Technology.  Our stack is TypeScript across the stack (frontend and backend), React, Postgres, and AWS serverless infrastructure (Lambda, DynamoDB, and EventBridge), managed through Pulumi and deployed via GitHub Actions. We use Datadog for observability, Meticulous for automated visual regression testing, and Incident.io for incident management.     AI-Native Development.  AI is core to how we build. Engineers use Claude Code and agentic workflows every day to write, review, and ship code faster, and our product is itself built on AI agents that automate complex procurement workflows.     End-to-End Ownership.  Own projects from initial idea through design, implementation, deployment, monitoring, and iteration. You'll work across the stack and be trusted to make decisions that drive meaningful outcomes.     Continuous Delivery.  We deploy small, incremental changes to production multiple times per day, enabling rapid iteration and fast customer feedback loops.     Tackle Scalability Challenges.  As we grow, you'll help scale our systems, architecture, and engineering practices while maintaining performance, reliability, and developer velocity.     Collaboration and Autonomy.  We operate as a high-trust team where individuals are expected to take ownership while collaborating closely to solve difficult problems.     Customers at the Center.  We regularly engage directly with customers to understand their problems, gather feedback, and ensure we're building products that create genuine value.     About You:     You're a strong engineer on a fast trajectory.  Around 3–5 years of professional software engineering in a well-respected engineering environment, shipping features end to end, full-stack in TypeScript (AWS serverless is a plus). If your trajectory is exceptional, we'll look past the years.     You're proactive.  You spot problems and fix them, or get them to the right person, without being asked. You keep people updated rather than waiting to be chased.     You're ready for more scope.  You've owned well-defined work and want the next step: vague briefs, bigger projects and more people to work with.     You're coachable.  You ask for feedback, act on it and learn fast from mistakes.     You're driven and ambitious.  You want to progress quickly, own your growth and push for harder problems. If there's a chance to take on something bigger, you take it.     You've got grit.  You work hard and keep going when things get difficult.     You're curious about the product and the customer.  You want to know why something is being built, not just how.     You lift others.  You help teammates, share what you know and make the team better.     Nice-to-Haves:      You've performed exceptionally  at something else, be it academics, sport, or work. You've gone above and beyond the norm.     You've grown fast before.  Your scope or responsibilities grew quickly in a previous role.     You love engineering.  It's more than a job. You've contributed to open source or worked on side projects just because you enjoy it. You're confident tackling ambiguous problems and shipping quality code.     Interview Process:   Before applying, we strongly encourage you to spend a few minutes in our R&D Candidate Hub. It covers our engineering culture, ways of working, interview process, tech environment, and what it's like to build at Omnea.   >> R&D Candidate Hub:   R&D Candidate Hub   The process varies slightly by level but generally includes:     Initial screening call  with the Talent team (30 mins - remote)     AI Product Eng Challenge  - language agnostic (1 hour - remote)     Onsite interviews:  Engineering culture interview, System design and Engineering leadership interviews (3 hours - in-person)    For The Jump, we look for trajectory as much as experience: how fast you've learned and how quickly your scope has grown. job.description: Company   NewOrbit builds satellites that fly in very low Earth orbit, below 300 km, along with the electric propulsion that keeps them there.  Flying closer to Earth means sharper imagery from smaller optics, and an orbit that cleans itself: our satellites de-orbit within a month at end of life, leaving no debris.  Our AURA family of RF gridded ion thrusters powers our own NEO-1 satellite, with first flight planned for Q3 2028, and is also offered to other operators.  Electric propulsion is what lets our satellites hold very low orbits, and our AURA RF gridded ion thruster is at the centre of it.     Role   We are looking for a skilled Thermal Engineer with experience in spacecraft thermal management at both the subsystem and spacecraft level.  You’ll work closely with a cross-functional team - including mechanical, propulsion, electronics, and mission planning - to ensure reliable thermal performance of our satellite throughout all mission phases: from launch to operation in orbit and end-of-life.  You should be capable of delivering a thermal control system from scratch and taking full ownership of it, ensuring the success of our mission.     Key Responsibilities     Perform steady-state and transient thermal analysis of the spacecraft across all mission phases (TVAC testing, launch, orbit).    Model and validate heat management strategies in the harsh environment of vacuum, where conduction and radiation are dominant    Identify and manage worst-case scenarios in extreme thermal conditions (both hot and cold), accounting for on-orbit environmental factors and internal power dissipation    Design and implement thermal control solutions such as multilayer insulation (MLI), radiators, heaters, thermo-optical coatings, thermistors, and thermal straps    Develop and support thermal vacuum (TVAC) test procedures, instrumentation setup, and post-test data analysis.    Be hands on in hardware testing for validation of processes, instrumentation, and materials and components chosen for in house developments       Fundamental Requirements     Solid understanding of thermal engineering principles in the context of spacecraft systems.    Hands-on experience with thermal simulation tools such as Systema, Thermal Desktop, ESATAN, or equivalent.    Experience with environmental and lab testing (TVAC, thermal cycling, AIT process validation).    Comfortable working in a fast-paced, iterative development environment.       Nice-to-Haves     Experience designing or testing spacecraft thermal systems.    Exposure to multidisciplinary space system development or mission analysis.       Why NewOrbit Space?      Pioneering space technology  - Your work on our RF gridded ion thrusters and VLEO satellite platform will redefine satellite operations and challenge traditional LEO.     Ownership and impact  - You'll have a level of ownership that's rare in the space industry, and you'll take part in the full lifecycle of satellite technology.     Equity and competitive salary  - Alongside a competitive salary you receive a company ownership stake, so you share in the technology you help build and in our collective success.     Comprehensive benefits  - Private health insurance with dental and optical cover, and annual health check-ups.     Hybrid working  - One dedicated remote day per week.     Visa sponsorship and relocation support  - We sponsor visas and provide relocation support for candidates moving to join us.    Find more  English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom  on Arbeitnow

job.description:
UX Researcher 

  • Location: Bristol/London, UK (hybrid, three days a week in the office)
  • Team: UX
  • Salary: £58,000 - £70,000
  • Contract: Permanent
  • Reporting To: UX Lead

Please note: This role requires an existing right to work in the UK. We can’t offer visa sponsorship, but we review sponsorship role by role, so keep an eye on our careers site for future opportunities.

About Kaluza

Kaluza is the Energy Intelligence Platform, turning energy complexity into seamless coordination. We help energy companies overcome today’s challenges while accelerating the shift to a clean, electrified future.

Our platform orchestrates millions of real-time decisions across homes, devices, markets and grids. By combining predictive algorithms with human-centred design, Kaluza makes clean energy dependable, affordable and adaptive to everyday life.

With teams across Europe, Asia and Australia, and a joint venture with Mitsubishi Corporation in Japan, we power leading companies including OVO, AGL and ENGIE, as well as innovators like Volvo and Volkswagen.

What you’ll do

Hands-on research

  • Run mixed-methods research in a B2B2C setting, combining qualitative studies with behavioural data in Mixpanel, that sets the standard for good research and shapes team roadmaps and client conversations
  • Research the whole chain, from client teams and subject matter experts to their end customers and the developers using our SDKs and APIs, and look for patterns that hold across clients so we build once and reuse
  • Make sure research has impact: track whether it changed a decision and what result followed, and use that to make the case for research investment

Research enablement and operations

  • Democratise research: coach and mentor colleagues in Product, Design and Engineering to run their own studies with rigour, through workshops, guidance and lightweight methods
  • Make insight easy to find and trust, through our insights agents, knowledge bases and journey management artefacts, backed by data you can rely on (quality, privacy, bias), so people can find and question evidence themselves
  • Help run research operations: improve how we recruit participants (frameworks, lead times, consent and data protection), and set clear guardrails so teams run ethical, compliant research
  • Assess and recommend research tools, deciding when to build and when to buy, trial them, and support procurement; use AI-assisted development such as Claude Code to build working tools where that is the right call

What you’ll bring

Ideally you’ll have/be

  • A track record of running research end to end that other teams used in product or roadmap decisions, with strong data literacy: you combine qualitative methods with behavioural data and know what the numbers can and can’t tell us
  • Experience researching in B2B or B2B2C or enterprise contexts, including technical users such as developers (eg SDKs, APIs or documentation), or a strong appetite to learn how
  • Experience coaching non-researchers in research fundamentals (interviewing, bias mitigation, ethical handling of user data) so they can self-serve
  • Experience on a platform or multi-client product, spotting patterns across customers, and familiarity with journey mapping or service design methods
  • Experience in research operations or enablement, such as participant recruitment, consent and data governance, repositories or tool selection, with judgement on when to build and when to buy
  • Confidence working with some autonomy across a distributed, international team

What will set you apart 

  • You’ve built a tool, repository or pipeline that measurably cut the time from research signal to team-wide insight
  • You’ve found a way to measure developer experience where there was no playbook (eg time to first successful call, or where developers drop off)
  • You’ve made the case for research with real numbers, and followed your research after the readout to see what happened

Where you'll work
We offer flexible working, with an expectation of 3 days a week in the office. This gives us the best of both: real time together to collaborate and build relationships, with the flexibility to work in the way that suits you best the rest of the week.

Our Values

  • Play to win: Collective pride in decarbonising energy at scale.
  • Solve the real problem: Cutting through complexity to focus on real-world outcomes.
  • Build trust every day: Consistency, transparency and doing what we say.
  • Own the outcome: Full accountability, wins and setbacks, without ego.
  • Go further together: Collaboration, respect and different perspectives.

Our Perks

  • Time off and family: 26 days’ holiday, plus 26 weeks’ full pay for new parents with no qualifying service period
  • Health and security: Private medical insurance with virtual GP, life assurance, pension scheme, free mortgage advice and eye tests
  • Pay and flexibility: Discretionary bonus, a Flex Fund of 5% [of salary] to spend on the benefits you want most, retail discounts through Perks at Work
  • Growth and setup: Personal learning budget, home office budget
  • Climate: Furthr, our climate action app

Come as you are

We want to meet people from all walks of life. The more inclusive we are, the better our work will be, and we recognise talent on merit and potential. If you’re excited about the role but don’t tick every box, we’d still love to hear from you.

Find out more on our careers page and LinkedIn. Our Applicant Data Protection Policy is here.

job.description: Role:  VLA Pre-training Engineer / Deep Learning Engineer – World Models (2 openings)  Company:   Humanoid   Location:  London, UK (King’s Cross) – on-site, five days a week  Job Type:  Full-time   About Humanoid   Humanoid is building the world’s most capable, commercially scalable and safe humanoid robots. Its platform, HMND-01, is already deployed in real industrial environments, which makes Humanoid the most serious humanoid robotics company in Europe.    300+ people, 34+ nationalities, flat structure: your decisions ship directly into real robots.    Offices in London (HQ, King’s Cross), Boston, Vancouver and San Diego.    Values: Speed, Ambition, Passion, Trust.     About the role   The VLA Core team builds the base vision-language-action model that the entire manipulation pipeline depends on. This is deep learning at scale: training models from scratch on multi-embodiment trajectory corpora and internet-scale video, with real deployment constraints. The model has to fit and run on a real robot.  Robotics experience is not required. If you come from LLMs, VLMs or video generation, be ready to get up to speed on a new domain quickly.  This is a senior individual contributor role with no management track. The team is research-adjacent, but the output is models that run on robots. Results are shared as blog posts, not papers.  There are two tracks in one team. They are the same role with a different focus, so you can lean into either.   Track 1: VLA Pre-training     Pre-train base models on a diverse multi-embodiment corpus of trajectories, fine-tune policies to excel at specific tasks and explore synthetic data.    Post-train policies with behaviour cloning and RL, and own the full loop from data to deployment.    Partner with the Data Collection team: specify what good data looks like, identify failure modes, ensure diversity and coverage.    Run pre-, mid- and post-training on the VLA stack; explore new modalities and architecture changes.    Build and maintain continuous pipelines: ingest synthetic data and teleop logs, version them, apply weak-supervision labelling, curate balanced datasets and automatically surface fresh failure cases into retraining.    Work with the MLOps and Data Platform teams to scale distributed training and optimize models for real-time edge inference on the robot.     Track 2: World Models     Design and train multimodal, action-conditioned world models (video, state, action and language) using diffusion-based and transformer architectures.    Build video prediction and dynamics models that stay physically consistent over long horizons, including contact-rich manipulation, and serve as pretrained priors for VLA policies.    Develop learned-simulator evaluation: score candidate policies offline, predict real-world success rates before deployment, roll out policy futures for safety review and planning.    Generate synthetic rollouts and counterfactual experience (rare events, cross-platform and sim-to-real transfer) and measure their effect on downstream task performance.    Build data pipelines that turn fleet telemetry, teleoperation logs and internet-scale video into training corpora.    Run scaling and ablation studies on architecture, data mixture and context length.     What you need to succeed     3+ years building deep learning systems in industry or research, with shipped models or published work to show for it.    Deep hands-on experience with at least one of: LLMs, VLMs, image or video generative models (architecture, training and inference). For the World Models track: diffusion models, autoregressive transformers, latent-variable models or video prediction.    You have actually trained models yourself: pre-training runs, distributed infrastructure, the works. Connecting APIs, building agents or a quick fine-tune is not enough.    Experience with deep learning infrastructure: streaming datasets, checkpointing and state management, distributed training strategies, debugging numerics and training instabilities.    Strong Python and PyTorch or JAX. You can profile, optimize data loaders and write maintainable research code.    Strong coding fundamentals. The process includes a LeetCode-style coding round, so come prepared.    Empirical rigor: careful evaluations, honest baselines, clear experiment docs, crisp communication of trade-offs.    You are proactive: you can take an open, messy problem and drive it without waiting for a spec.    Working English.     Nice to have     Robotics or autonomous driving experience; familiarity with simulators (Isaac Sim, MuJoCo) and sim-to-real.    Experience applying RL to LLMs or robotics.    Experience with VLA models; familiarity with OpenVLA, Physical Intelligence (π) models or similar open-source frameworks.    Experience with world models for robotics or autonomous driving (action-conditioned video models, learned simulators, model-based RL).    Proven productization of deep nets: latency and throughput constraints, on-device optimization, fast inference for generative models.    Publications at top-tier DL conferences (NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR, CoRL, CVPR) or equivalent open-source contributions.     Interview process     Intro call with Igor, hirehire’s AI researcher.    HR screen with Humanoid.    Coding round (LeetCode-style).    Specialization interview (pre-training or world models).    Technical execution interview: how you work, collaborate and drive problems.    Optional chat with a tech leader.     What you get     Salary: a wide range, set by the level you show in the interviews.    Equity: stock options with meaningful upside as Humanoid scales.    30+ paid days off: 23 days annual leave, all UK bank holidays and a company shutdown between Christmas and New Year.    Private healthcare: fully funded, including virtual and in-person care.    Pension: 8% total contribution (5% employee, 3% employer) on full earnings.    Daily food: free breakfast, catered lunch and snacks in the office.    Real ownership: direct access to founding leadership, real input on product direction and room to drive key initiatives from day one.    Visa sponsorship and relocation to London. About the role As a Partnership lead, you’ll help drive our strategic growth with Google Cloud. You'll play a critical role in managing the relationship, generate large-scale revenue opportunities, and work with leadership across both organizations to accelerate Anthropic's AI adoption through GCP's global ecosystem. You’ll be a part of a small team with an outsized scope - setting the strategy and rolling up your sleeves to execute it. You'll help shape how frontier AI technology is commercialized at scale and develop the blueprint for successful AI-cloud provider partnerships. build pipeline, and set revenue targets for the partnership Build and maintain cross-functional relationships across GCP Drive strategic planning and execution of joint marketing and sales initiatives, including major customer engagements Create and implement scalable processes for partnership operations, including escalation management and reporting Provide strategic market intelligence and competitive insights to inform product and business strategy Design and execute sales plays and enablement programs Participate in monthly business reviews with key stakeholders Identify and develop strategic opportunities to expand partnership scope and impact You may be a good fit if you have: 8+ years of experience, ideally including 2-4 years in a high-intensity, analytical role (investment banking, management consulting, or similar) and 4+ years in GTM at fast-growing technology companies Deep understanding of enterprise cloud services and AI/ML market dynamics Exceptional communication and relationship-building skills with both technical and business stakeholders Proven ability to develop and execute successful co-selling strategies at scale Excellence in strategy, business operations, and program management Ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment, adapt to changing priorities, and balance strategic thinking with tactical execution Experience working with technical products and translating complex capabilities into business value Strong candidates may also have: Direct experience scaling GTM at a high-growth startup or leading technology partnerships Technical background in computer science, software engineering, data science, or related field MBA or advanced degree in relevant discipline The annual compensation range for And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems. About the role Anthropic is seeking a strategic Go-To-Market Recruiter specializing in Applied AI to join our GTM recruiting organization. In this role, you'll focus specifically on building and scaling our Applied AI team - the Pre-Sales architects and technical advisors who help large enterprises successfully integrate and deploy Claude. Working within our broader GTM recruiting team, you'll drive full-cycle recruiting for these critical customer-facing technical roles that bridge our cutting-edge AI technology with real-world business applications. This specialized role requires deep technical recruiting expertise combined with a strong understanding of enterprise SaaS and AI landscapes. You'll collaborate closely with GTM recruiting colleagues while developing targeted strategies for the unique talent needs of our Applied AI organization. You'll help shape how enterprises work with AI systems by building teams that directly influence the safe and beneficial deployment of Claude across industries. Key responsibilities Lead end-to-end recruiting for Applied AI team roles, including Solutions Architects, Pre-Sales Engineers, front-line managers and other customer-facing technical positions Partner with Applied AI leadership and GTM recruiting colleagues to develop comprehensive hiring strategies that align with overall GTM objectives Execute sophisticated sourcing strategies to identify candidates with rare combinations of technical depth, customer empathy, and business acumen Create exceptional candidate experiences that showcase Anthropic's mission and the unique opportunity to shape enterprise AI adoption Build pipelines of talent with expertise in LLMs, cloud architecture, enterprise software integration, and technical consulting Collaborate with GTM recruiting team members to share best practices, market insights, and cross-functional candidate leads Leverage Claude and other AI tools to enhance recruiting efficiency while maintaining high-touch, personalized engagement Provide data-driven insights on compensation trends and talent availability specific to the Applied AI market Minimum qualifications Excel at recruiting for customer-facing technical roles that require both deep technical knowledge and exceptional communication skills Understand the technical requirements of roles working with LLMs, APIs, cloud architectures, and enterprise system integration Thrive in collaborative environments, working seamlessly with GTM recruiting colleagues while managing specialized searches Can effectively assess candidates' abilities to translate complex technical concepts for diverse stakeholders Have a track record of building trusted advisor relationships with technical hiring managers Are passionate about using AI to transform recruiting practices while maintaining a human-centered approach Preferred qualifications Have 5+ years of technical or technical sales recruiting experience, ideally within GTM organizations at enterprise software or AI/ML companies Direct experience recruiting for pre-sales/solutions engineering roles in the AI/ML space Demonstrated success working within GTM recruiting organizations during periods of hypergrowth Expertise in developing specialized recruiting practices within broader team structures Familiarity with the challenges of deploying AI systems in enterprise environments Experience collaborating across recruiting teams to share resources and best practices A technical background or successful track record recruiting for highly specialized technical positions The annual compensation range for this role is listed below. For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role. Annual Salary: $175,000 - $240,000 USD Logistics Minimum education: Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience Required field of study: A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices. Visa sponsorship: We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this. We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed.  Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills. The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. Back to jobs New Lead Project Manager Redwood City, US, California Apply Celonis is the trusted platform to industrialize Enterprise AI. At our core is the Celonis Context Model — which combines process data, business knowledge, and intelligence into a living digital twin of the enterprise that AI can actually understand, turning AI's operational blind spots into operational clarity. World's leading companies trust Celonis and its global ecosystem of partners to make their AI agents, people, systems, and processes work together, achieving transformational outcomes. We believe there's a massive opportunity to unlock global productivity and sustainability by giving AI the context to understand how every business process really works. Join our mission to make processes work for people, companies, and the planet. The Team Celonis Services is the delivery engine of our Celonis Customer Organization, responsible for turning the Celonis platform into measurable, business-critical outcomes for our customers. In the AI era, our role has elevated: as AI agents like our own Apollo take on more of the technical build, our people focus on the work that drives real impact—understanding our customers' business-critical problems, designing the solutions that solve them, and quantifying the value delivered. Our Deployment Engineers and Deployment Architects pair deep domain and industry expertise with serious platform mastery and AI-augmented delivery, directing agentic systems while owning the judgment, architecture, and customer relationships that AI cannot replace. We deliver faster and smarter than ever, and we own the outcome: solution go-live, solution adoption, initial value realization support and the long-term success of our customers. The Role: As a Lead Project Manager , you will support end-to-end implementations of Celonis’ technology across our largest and most strategic customers. You will articulate Celonis’ product positioning to customers and collaborate with Sales, Partners and Value Engineering to establish Celonis’ Services Value proposition and create statements of work with customers during the pre-sales phase. In this role, you will assist customers in understanding how to build best practice and enduring capabilities, are responsible for identifying further Services needs by the customer whilst engaged and responsible for customer satisfaction throughout a customer's engagement with Celonis. The work you’ll do: Lead complex transformational customer programs, shape and define the project outcome and then steer towards it. Planning, scheduling, and management of project timelines and activities from project kick-off through to training, ensuring each project is delivered on time and meets the customers' requirements. Manage resources, schedule, scope and budget on multiple projects by creating and maintaining detailed project plans that emphasize speed to delivery and maximise the efficient use of resources needed to meet the requirements. Collaboration with senior executives, process owners and technical teams within each customer to understand their goals, objectives and requirements and to ensure their successful implementation. You will be their primary point of contact for product feature requests and escalation of support issues. Regularly communicate project status, covering key discussion items, action items, risks and issues. Keep projects up to date in the Celonis Professional Services Automation System to enable accurate and timely project and portfolio reporting. Proactively manage and escalate risks and issues internally to Celonis management and externally to customer project sponsors to minimize impact to project success. Provide guidance and mentoring to the implementation team, including partner resources, to ensure Celonis methodology is being followed. Use your experience to contribute to the continual improvement of Celonis Services methods as well as the maturing field expertise and best practices. The qualifications you need: 10+ years of client-facing Project Management experience in enterprise software implementations, managing multiple projects concurrently. Extensive experience in project management disciplines, including documenting and maintaining project plans, risk/issue/action logs, and driving problem resolution in partnership with customers and Celonis executives. Strong communication skills and a background in consulting with a proven ability to manage stakeholders and project timelines. Experience in people managing consulting teams both onshore and offshore. Experience in positioning Services, writing proposals and “statement of works” within a complete ecosystem (customers and partners). A history of working with an ecosystem of partners and managed co-delivery. Ability to effectively set and manage customer expectations. Strong analytical skills, especially in applying technology solutions to core business problems. Ability and willingness to be certified in Celonis products. Project management certifications (PMP, Prince2, or Safe/Agile). Bachelors or Masters in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics or other related field. Visa Sponsorship is not offered for this role The base salary range below is for the role in the specified location, based on a Full Time Schedule. Total compensation package will include base salary + bonus/commission + equity + benefits (health, dental, life, 401k, and paid time off). Please note that the base salary range is a guideline, and that the actual total compensation offer will be determined based on various factors, including, but not limited to, applicant's qualifications, skills, experiences, and location. The base salary range below is for the role in California, based on a Full Time Schedule. $195,000 - $215,000 USD What Celonis can offer you: Pioneer Innovation: Work with the global leader in Process Mining and the Process Intelligence Graph to shape the future of AI-driven business operations. Ownership from Day 1: Every full-time "Celonaut" is an owner, receiving Restricted Stock Units (RSUs) and merit-based refresh grants. Unrivaled Family Support: Benefit from our inclusive parental leave policy—24 weeks of fully paid leave for primary carers and 12 weeks for supporting carers, available from your first day of employment. Work-Life Integration: Enjoy Unlimited PTO (in applicable regions) and generous PTO globally, as well as a flexible hybrid work model that balances remote focus with vibrant office collaboration. Continuous Growth: Elevate your skills through our 70-20-10 learning framework, mentorship programs, and access to a dedicated learning platform. Holistic Well-being: Prioritize your health with subsidized Wellhub memberships, mental health counseling, and dedicated "Wellness Weeks" that prioritize work/life balance. Drive Sustainability: Participate in annual Impact Days, where you receive paid time off to volunteer for community and environmental causes with your local office, or virtually. Global Inclusion & Belonging: Find community through our Inclusion Think Tank and participate in our annual Inclusion Days, ensuring every voice is heard and valued. Value-Driven Impact: Join a mission-led organization where our core values—Live for Customer Value, The Best Team Wins, We Own It, and Earth Is Our Future—drive every decision. About Us: Celonis is the trusted platform to industrialize Enterprise AI, empowering organizations to analyze, design, and operate AI-driven processes. The Celonis Platform is powered by the Celonis Context Model, which combines process data, business knowledge, and intelligence to create a living digital twin of the enterprise that AI can understand — turning AI’s operational blind spots into operational clarity. Industry-leading companies around the world trust Celonis and its global ecosystem of partners to make their AI agents, people, systems, and processes work together, achieving transformational outcomes. Celonis is headquartered in Munich, Germany, and New York City, USA, with more than 20 offices worldwide. Get familiar with the Celonis Process Intelligence Platform by watching this video . Celonis Inclusion Statement: At Celonis, we believe our people make us who we are and that “The Best Team Wins”. We know that the best teams are made up of people who bring different perspectives to the table. And when everyone feels included, able to speak up and knows their voice is heard - that's when creativity and innovation happen. Your Privacy: Any information you submit to Celonis as part of your application will be processed in accordance with Celonis’ Accessibility and Candidate Notices By submitting this application, you confirm that you agree to the storing and processing of your personal data by Celonis as described in our Privacy Notice for the Application and Hiring Process . Use of Artificial Intelligence Tools We rely on an artificial intelligence tool to match the information from your resume to the relevant Celonis job descriptions. This processing is limited to the information provided in your resume or in your candidate profile. The tool produces a match score per candidate for a role, suggests preliminary ranking, and provides recommendations. The tool is only used for support in parts of the job application process, including to facilitate the identification of the relevant Celonis Jobs for candidates and recruiters. All final decisions are made by hiring managers and the Celonis talent acquisition team. Hiring managers and HR specialists use this tool responsibly, are aware of the risk of potential bias, and are equipped to mitigate it. Please be aware of common job offer scams, impersonators and frauds. Learn more here . job.description: About Stripe Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and open up new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a lot of work ahead. That gives you an unusual opportunity to help put the global economy within everyone’s reach while doing the most important work of your career. About the team The Startup SaaS Platforms team works with European startups in one of Stripe’s must-win segments. SaaS platforms are companies that use Stripe to embed payments and make financial services a core part of their products, such as Shopify, Mindbody, and Lightspeed. For these companies, their partnership with Stripe is vital to the success of their businesses. SaaS platforms are a global priority for Stripe, and our team finds and wins Stripe’s future strategic accounts in Europe. We partner with high-potential companies early and help them use Stripe’s solutions to better support their users, scale globally, and create new revenue streams by monetising payments and financial services. What you’ll do We’re hiring an Account Executive to win new business with pre-revenue and early-stage SaaS platform startups across the United Kingdom and Ireland. This is a new-logo role. Your job is to find the most promising founders building platforms today, win their business for Stripe before they choose another provider, and get them live with the right integration from day one. You’ll work alongside our SaaS Platform Account Executives as the team’s dedicated hunter for the earliest stage of the market. You’ll own the pre-revenue and early-revenue segment end to end, from generating pipeline and handling inbound demand to closing deals and getting each new platform activated. Early-stage platforms make their payments decisions early and rarely revisit them. They also often need several products from the start, including embedded payments, connected-account onboarding, payouts, and monetisation. Winning them early and selling the right solution gives Stripe a lasting position with the platforms that will scale fastest. This is a high-velocity sales role with short cycles, a high volume of opportunities, and plenty of competitive deals. Responsibilities Build and run your own pipeline. Prospect high-potential pre-revenue and early-stage SaaS platforms across the United Kingdom and Ireland, and turn inbound interest from early-stage platforms into qualified opportunities. Win new logos. Run fast, consultative sales cycles from discovery to close and win competitive evaluations against other payments providers. Sell the right solution from the start. Understand each founder’s business model and position the right Stripe Connect integration and payments monetisation strategy so that new platforms are set up to scale. Close and activate. Negotiate and close deals, then work with Solutions Architects, Product, Risk, and Operations to get new platforms live quickly. You’ll be measured on new business won and activated. Source new business through the ecosystem. Build relationships with founders, venture capital firms, accelerators, and startup communities across the United Kingdom and Ireland to create pipeline and grow Stripe’s presence among early-stage founders. Work with the SaaS Platform Account Executive team. Share market intelligence on emerging platforms and pass on accounts that have moved beyond the early stage so that each seller can focus on the opportunities where they can have the greatest impact. Bring what you learn from the market back to Product and go-to-market teams to sharpen how Stripe wins early-stage platforms. Who you are You’re a self-starting hunter who enjoys finding and winning new business. You like working with founders, you’re comfortable leading technical conversations, and you can run many deals at once without compromising quality. You know how to qualify quickly, create urgency, and close. You’re competitive, resilient, and keen to build your skills in a fast-changing environment. We’re looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement. Minimum requirements 2+ years of experience in a new-business sales role, such as a closing Account Executive role or a Sales or Business Development Representative role, with a track record of progression and pipeline generation A proven record of meeting or exceeding new-business targets Strong prospecting skills, with experience building your own pipeline through outbound and inbound channels Experience running high-velocity sales cycles from the first conversation through to close The ability to understand technical products and explain their value clearly to technical and non-technical buyers Comfort with rejection, competitive deals, and ambiguous, fast-moving environments A bias towards team success, collaboration, and knowledge sharing Proficiency in written and spoken English Preferred qualifications Experience selling to early-stage or venture-backed startups, ideally in the United Kingdom and Ireland An established network in the United Kingdom and Ireland startup ecosystem, including founders, venture capital firms, and accelerators Experience selling at a high-growth technology company Comfort with API-first products and technical sales conversations Experience in payments, fintech, or SaaS platform sales

job.description: Overview Susquehanna is looking for highly motivated full-time students for our 10-week quantitative strategy development summer internship program based at our EU Headquarters in Dublin, Ireland. This is a computationally intensive role that will allow you to use your strong technical skills to solve problems at the intersection of trading, quant and technology. Throughout the summer, you will receive education about how markets work by going through a deep dive into financial markets and Susquehanna's approach to trading. You will also work on challenging projects for our trading strategy development teams in spaces such as signal creation and detection, quantitative strategy analysis, and low latency C++ strategy development. Additionally, you'll have the opportunity to work on projects side by side with senior developers who understand the nuances of building complex tr ading strategies. Our quantitative strategy developers are part of our high-performing team s that build some of the most powerful trading systems in the finance industry. This is a computationally intensive role that will allow you to utilize both your data analysis and technology skills. What we're looking for Class of 202 8 : You are a master’s or bachelor’s student in their penultimate year of study, majoring in a quantitative and/or STEM discipline such as computer science, computer engineering, mathematics or data science for example. You intend to graduate and begin full time employment by August 2028. Clear Communicator: You enjoy building relationships with those you work closely with and are comfortable sharing ideas, expressing your thoughts, and listening to the views of others . Ambitious: You’re someone that enjoys setting personal goals and giving your all to achieve them. Be it in Arts, Sports, Academics, or another passion; you’re not afraid to put in the effort to reach your full potential. Technically Proficient: Strong software development skills in (Python and a compiled language). Experience and comfort working with data using libraries such as Pandas, Polars, or NumPy. You will have exceptional quantitative, logical reasoning, and analytical skills. Problem Solver: When it comes to solving problems, you use clear and sound reasoning. You’re rational and like to use numbers and data to come up with sensible solutions. What's in it for you: Education: We are renowned for our market-leading education and training programmes . You will attend classes covering a vast range of topics (Options Pricing, Machine Learning, Data Analysis Techniques, Game Theory, Trader Talks, In-house trading games… the list goes on!) from some of the most experienced employees in Susquehanna . Collaboration : You will get to work with a wide range of people in the classroom and through your project work; people who share a passion for mathematics, problem-solving, game theory, and technology. Culture : O ur non-hierarchical, casual, and collaborative culture allows employees of every level to thrive, and we focus on continuous development, no matter how long you’ve been in Susquehanna. Perks : We offer a highly competitive compensation package to our interns . Located in Ireland's Financial Services Centre, in the heart of Dublin's city centre , our office features free onsite catering, a games room, and a fully equipped in-house gym. Throughout the summer, interns enjoy weekly social events. For those joining us from outside Dublin, we also provide accommodation for the duration of the internship. About Susquehanna Susquehanna is a global quantitative trading firm powered by scientific rigor, curiosity, and innovation. Our culture is intellectually driven and highly collaborative, bringing together researchers, engineers, and traders to design and deploy impactful strategies in our systematic trading environment. To meet the unique challenges of global markets, Susquehanna applies machine learning and advanced quantitative research to vast datasets in order to uncover actionable insights and build effective strategies. By uniting deep market expertise with cutting-edge technology, we excel in solving complex problems and pushing boundaries together. Additional details ** We hire for our QSD internship on a rolling basis. There are limited places on our 2027 QSD internship, therefore interested candidates are strongly encouraged to apply early.* * The interview process for this role will be a series of interviews including coding, mathematics, system design and behavioural interviews. Our summer internship is 10 weeks and runs from late June to late August. Applicants for our summer internship must legally eligible to work in Ireland. Susquehanna is an equal opportunity employer, and we are committed to diversity and inclusion throughout our recruitment process. If you need assistance and/or a reasonable accommodation due to a disability during the application or recruitment process, please contact us. If you're a recruiting agency and want to partner with us, please reach out to recruiting@sig.com . Any resume or referral submitted in the absence of a signed agreement will not be eligible for an agency fee.

Job Type: Permanent

Location: Letterkenny GDC, Co. Donegal (Hybrid – minimum 3 days onsite per week)


Do you have a proven track record as an Azure Data Engineer with strong exposure to Fabric?

Are you keen to drive your career in the Data Engineering space with a leading global IT organisation?


Make your mark at TCS as an Azure Data Engineer!


Join a global tech leader right here in Donegal. With over 850 employees and a state-of-the-art global delivery centre, we’re proud to offer world-class career opportunities without having to leave the Northwest. Recognised as Workplace of the Year by the Letterkenny Chamber, we foster a culture of continuous learning, innovation, and respect. Our people are at the heart of everything we do – collaborating across teams, geographies, and disciplines to drive real change for clients around the world. Be part of something global, grounded in Donegal.

TCS is a purpose-led transformation company, built on belief. We do not just help businesses to transform through technology. We support them in making a meaningful difference to the people and communities they serve - our clients include some of the biggest brands in the UK and worldwide. For you, it means more to make an impact that matters, through challenging projects which demand ambitious innovation and thought leadership.

  • Join a leading global IT services organization
  • Be part of an exciting team where you will be challenged every day
  • Gain exposure to innovative technology


The Role

We are seeking an Azure Data Engineer to play a key role in modernizing the firm’s data platform and advancing its data and analytics capabilities.


The Data Engineer will be responsible for supporting and enhancing existing ETL processes for the on- prem data lake (PostgreSQL) while leading the evolution and migration of these processes to Microsoft Fabric. This role will focus heavily on developing and maintaining SQL-based transformation logic to ensure high quality, trusted, and analytics ready data.


Working closely with the Data Management team, the Data Engineer will help identify, remediate, and prevent data quality issues by encoding validation rules and controls directly into data pipelines. The role will also contribute to the evaluation and implementation of tools and frameworks supporting data governance, architecture, and data quality as the platform continues to evolve.


Duties & Responsibilities:


  • Support and enhance existing ETL pipelines for an on‑premises data lake environment, primarily backed by PostgreSQL.
  • Refactor and migrate data ingestion, transformation, and orchestration processes to Microsoft Fabric using modern cloud-native patterns.
  • Design, develop, and maintain complex SQL-based transformation logic, including views, functions, and analytical datasets.
  • Build and optimize data models to support analytics and reporting use cases, including Power BI semantic models.
  • Perform aggregations and transformations across multiple data models (e.g., normalized, dimensional, lakehouse) to enable reliable insights.
  • Partner closely with data analytics and reporting teams to understand consumption needs and ensure data is structured for performance, usability, and scalability.
  • Implement and enforce data quality rules, validation checks, and automated error detection within ETL and transformation workflows.
  • Support master and reference data processes, including defining data quality criteria, uniqueness rules, and remediation approaches.
  • Collaborate with domain owners and data stewards to analyze root causes of data quality issues and drive corrective actions.
  • Monitor cross-domain data provisioning to ensure data is sourced from approved and governed systems.
  • Contribute to the evaluation and implementation of data governance, architecture, and quality tools in partnership with Global Technology teams.
  • Document data pipelines, transformation logic, and architectural decisions to support maintainability and knowledge sharing.


Your Profile

Essential skills/knowledge/experience:


The successful candidate brings a structured, detail-oriented approach and a hands-on mindset toward advancing the organization’s data platform modernization.

  • Bachelor’s degree required.
  • Solid years of experience in a data engineering or analytics engineering role.
  • Strong hands-on experience with SQL, including complex transformations, performance tuning, and data modeling.
  • Experience supporting ETL pipelines in an on‑prem or hybrid data lake environment; exposure to PostgreSQL strongly preferred.
  • Experience migrating or modernizing data platforms to Azure and/or Microsoft Fabric (Lakehouse, Pipelines, or related services).
  • Solid understanding of modern data lake and warehousing architectures.
  • Working knowledge of data engineering tools and languages such as SQL, Python, Spark, or similar technologies.
  • Experience with at least one relational database platform (PostgreSQL, SQL Server, MySQL).
  • Familiarity with data governance, data quality, or MDM concepts and tooling.
  • Experience working in an agile, collaborative, cross-functional environment.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills; able to translate business requirements into technical solutions.
  • Highly analytical, detail-oriented problem solver with a proactive, self‑starter mentality.
  • Comfortable working in evolving environments and translating conceptual requirements into pragmatic, scalable solutions.

Desirable skills/knowledge/experience:

  • MS Fabric experience and or certification (DP600 / DP700)
  • Knowledge of the Finance / investments industry


Rewards & Benefits

TCS is consistently voted a Top Employer in the UK and globally. Our competitive salary packages feature pension, health care, life assurance, laptop, phone, access to extensive training resources and discounts within the larger Tata network.

We offer health & wellness initiatives and sports events; we are the proud sponsor of the London Marathon.


Diversity, Inclusion and Wellbeing

Tata Consultancy Services UK&I is committed to meeting the accessibility needs of all individuals in accordance with the UK Equality Act 2010 and the UK Human Rights Act 1998.


We welcome and embrace diversity in race, nationality, ethnicity, disability, neurodiversity, gender identity, age, physical ability, gender reassignment, sexual orientation. We are a disability inclusive employer and encourage disabled people to apply for this role.

As a Disability Confident Employer, we offer an interview to applicants with disabilities or long-term conditions who meet the minimum criteria for the role. Please email us at UKI.recruitment@tcs.com if you would like to opt in.


If you are an applicant who needs any adjustments to the application process or interview, please contact us at UKI.recruitment@tcs.com with the subject line: “Adjustment Request”. We welcome requests prior to you completing the application and at any stage of the recruitment process.


Beware of Fraudulent offers

This is to notify you that TCS does not ask for any sort of payment or security deposit from candidates at any stage of the recruitment process. The firm never sends out job offers from free internet email services like Gmail, Yahoo Mail, and so on. TCS has not authorised any third-party company to collect money on their behalf. As a vigilant job seeker, beware of fraudulent recruitment activity and protect your interests!

You can write to UKI.Recruitment@tcs.com to report any fraudulent activity.


Due to the high volume of applications, we will be unable to contact each applicant individually on the status of their application. If you have not received a direct response within 30 days, then it should be deemed unsuccessful on this occasion.


Join us and do more of what matters. Apply online now.

Description

Developers all over the world rely on AWS Load Balancing services to ensure their applications and services are highly available. The success of AWS depends on our world-class network and server infrastructure; we’re handling massive scale and rapid integration of emerging technologies. We’re looking for an experienced Software Engineer to join the Internal DNS team in support the onboarding of customer to AWS Load Balancing.

The People Technology Integration Engineer, Workday is responsible for designing, building, and evolving integration and data solutions across SIE’s global Workday platform and broader HR technology ecosystem.

This role operates as an independent contributor within People Technology Services, owning the design and delivery of scalable, secure, and reliable system integrations. The role focuses on enabling seamless data movement, system connectivity, and interoperability across platforms, ensuring that integrations are maintainable, performant, and aligned with architectural standards.

A key focus of this role is the design, delivery, and ongoing support of payroll integrations, ensuring accurate, secure, and timely movement of employee and payroll data between Workday, global payroll providers, and downstream systems.

Working within an Agile product delivery model, this role contributes to both the continuous evolution of integration capabilities and the stability of core data flows. The Integration Engineer partners closely with Platform Engineers, Product Managers, and Data teams to deliver cohesive, end-to-end technology solutions.

This role is suited for individuals with strong technical depth who are motivated to build and improve integration architecture and data pipelines within an enterprise environment.

What you'll be doing:

Integration Engineering & Solution Design

  • Design, build, and implement scalable integration solutions across the Workday platform and connected systems, including:
  • Workday Studio
  • Core Connectors and EIBs
  • API-based integrations (REST/SOAP)
  • Define and apply integration design patterns that promote scalability, reusability, and maintainability
  • Design secure and reliable data flows, including transformation logic, orchestration, and error handling
  • Evaluate integration approaches and make informed design decisions, balancing business needs, system constraints, and long-term sustainability
  • Own end-to-end delivery of integration solutions, including design, build, testing, and deployment readiness
  • Design, build, and maintain payroll integrations between Workday and external payroll providers, financial institutions, and related downstream systems.
  • Partner with Payroll, HR, and external vendors to translate payroll requirements into secure and reliable integration solutions, including reconciliation, error handling, and issue resolution across time-sensitive payroll cycles.

Integration Architecture & Platform Connectivity

  • Contribute to the design and evolution of integration architecture across the People Technology ecosystem
  • Ensure consistent patterns for system connectivity, data exchange, and interface design
  • Document integration designs, data flows, and technical architecture to support maintainability and governance

Data Engineering & Reporting Solutions

  • Design and deliver data extracts, reporting solutions, and document generation capabilities (e.g., BIRT, Docs for Layouts) as part of the broader People data ecosystem
  • Develop and maintain calculated fields and data structures to support integration and reporting use cases
  • Ensure data accuracy, integrity, and consistency across integrations and downstream systems

Platform Reliability & Operations

  • Maintain reliability of integration pipelines through proactive monitoring, issue diagnosis, and resolution
  • Identify root causes of failures and implement structural improvements to enhance stability and performance
  • Optimize integrations for performance, scalability, and fault tolerance
  • Partner with stakeholders to prioritize enhancements and manage competing demands

Delivery & Agile Execution

  • Translate business and technical requirements into well-defined integration solutions
  • Participate actively in Agile delivery, including sprint planning, backlog refinement, and retrospectives
  • Own and deliver assigned workstreams within sprint cycles
  • Execute and support testing activities (unit, integration, UAT), ensuring end-to-end data validation
  • Collaborate with Platform Engineers and functional partners to deliver integrated, cross-domain solutions

Governance, Security & Quality

  • Ensure all integration solutions meet data privacy, security, and audit requirements
  • Implement secure data exchange practices, including encryption, authentication, and secure file transfer (e.g., SFTP)
  • Follow established governance, release management, and change control practices
  • Ensure integration solutions align with platform architecture and engineering standards
  • Contribute to improving integration standards, documentation, and engineering practices

  • 5+ years of hands-on experience with enterprise platforms, including design and delivery of Workday integrations
  • Demonstrated experience building and deploying integrations using:
  • Workday Studio
  • Core Connectors and EIBs
  • API-based integrations (REST/SOAP)
  • Proven ability to design and troubleshoot integration solutions, including data transformation, interface logic, and failure handling
  • Experience implementing secure data exchange mechanisms, including encryption and secure file transfer
  • Hands-on experience developing Workday reports (Advanced, Matrix, Composite) and calculated fields
  • Solid understanding of the Workday Core HCM data model and data flows across integrations and business processes
  • Experience translating requirements into scalable technical solutions, including evaluating trade-offs between speed, complexity, and maintainability
  • Experience working in Agile delivery environments, with ownership of defined workstreams or sub-projects
  • Ability to clearly articulate personal contributions to delivered solutions, including specific integrations and technical components
  • Demonstrated hands-on experience designing, building, and supporting Workday integrations for payroll processes and external payroll providers.
  • Experience troubleshooting payroll integration failures and data discrepancies, with a strong understanding of payroll-related data flows, validation, reconciliation, and time-sensitive processing requirements.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Familiarity with Workday Security model
  • Exposure to Workday functional domains (e.g., Absence, Compensation, Talent)
  • Experience working within global enterprise environments across multiple regions

  • Experience supporting global payroll integrations across multiple countries, regions, or third-party payroll providers.

Profile

At Optiver, we’re looking for a Software Engineer to join our Global Talent Assessment Tooling Team (GTAT), the cornerstone of our global recruitment, engaging 100,000+ users annually. You'll be instrumental in ensuring scalability and reliability of our in house built platforms. With expertise in server-side platforms and a genuine interest in UI/UX, you'll contribute to the full software development lifecycle of our global platforms, serving as the central hub for all talent assessments, training and education activities, and test authorization. Join us in shaping the future of global talent acquisition at Optiver.

Who We Are

Optiver’s story began over 30 years ago, when we started business as a single trader on the floor of Amsterdam’s options exchange. Today, we are at the forefront of trading and technology as a leading global electronic market maker, focused on pricing, execution and risk management.

What You’ll Do

As a Software Engineer, you’ll be responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining our talent assessment tooling platform and our assessments. This critical infrastructure is key to our ability to hire at scale and speed, representing one of the first interactions individuals have with Optiver during their recruitment journey. You’ll work within a dynamic team to ensure the platform's scalability and reliability, contributing to the success of our global talent assessment initiatives. You’ll work closely with our recruitment teams globally on a day to day basis to ensure that the platform is scalable, reliable, and user-friendly.

Some of what you’ll do day to day:


  • Design, develop and maintain our assessment tooling platform and features supporting recruitment
  • Collaborate with recruitment teams on a global scale to ensure that the platform is scalable, reliable, and user-friendly
  • Write clean, maintainable code that is easy to understand and modify and participate in code reviews to ensure that code meets quality standards
  • Utilize frontend technologies (React/Angular) to enhance user interfaces and experiences.


Who You Are


  • Strong technical background consisting of 3+ years of experience in full stack development
  • Proficiency in server-side development utilizing C# .NET or Python
  • Experience with relational databases (e.g. PostgreSQL or SQL Server)
  • Experience with frontend technologies including HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and modern frontend frameworks
  • A proactive approach to problem solving and an entrepreneurial attitude

Nice to Haves

What You'll Get

You’ll join a culture of collaboration and excellence, where you’ll be surrounded by curious thinkers and creative problem solvers. Motivated by a passion for continuous improvement, you’ll thrive in a supportive, high-performing environment alongside talented colleagues, working collectively to tackle the toughest problems in the financial markets.

In addition, you’ll receive:

  • The opportunity to work alongside best-in-class professionals from over 50 different countries.

  • Training opportunities, discounts on health insurance, and fully paid first-class commuting expenses.

At Optiver, our mission is to constantly improve the market by injecting liquidity, providing accurate pricing, increasing transparency and acting as a stabilizing force no matter the market conditions.
