General Information

Location: Ireland - Dublin

Available for Work Visa Sponsorship: NO

Business Area: Technology Consulting (ServiceNow)

Contract Type: Full-Time – Permanent

The Team and the opportunity

ServiceNow is changing how organisations deliver services and manage work. In this role, you will help EY clients build practical ServiceNow solutions that improve service, simplify processes and support technology-enabled change. You will join a growing Technology Consulting team in Dublin, working with experienced colleagues while building your own technical, delivery and client-facing skills.

Your Key Responsibilities

  • Supporting ServiceNow reviews, implementations and change projects from planning through to delivery.
  • Building and configuring ServiceNow solutions with guidance from project leads and senior team members.
  • Preparing clear project materials, updates and analysis for EY teams and client stakeholders.
  • Managing your own work, tracking actions and escalating risks or dependencies early.
  • Supporting engagement activities such as quality, risk, resourcing, project reporting and bid materials.
  • Coaching more junior colleagues where relevant and contributing to a supportive team culture.

Skills And Attributes For Success

You will bring ServiceNow implementation experience and a strong interest in IT Service Management. We will focus on your ServiceNow capability, problem-solving skills, communication style and ability to work independently while contributing to a wider project team.

To qualify for the role, you must have

  • Around 3+ years’ experience implementing ServiceNow.
  • A deep technical and functional knowledge of IT Service Management.
  • Additional mainline certifications from ServiceNow, such as Certified System Administrator, Certified Implementation Specialist, Certified Architect (Technical or Architect) or willingness to gain them.
  • Certification and/or knowledge of ITIL.
  • Knowledge of the ITSM Market including other ITSM type products and platforms.
  • Experience working in a client facing role for a leading consulting or professional services company in delivery of technical projects or systems integration projects.
  • Experience in one or more of our focus industries including Energy & Assets, Financial Services, Government & Public Sector, Health & Wellness, Consumer Product & Retail, Telecommunications Media & Technology, Advanced Manufacturing.
  • Experience in the establishment, training and management of teams comprised of client, contractors and client’s strategic partners.
  • Excellent communication skills – tailoring communications to suit various audiences, with the ability to translate IT strategy into measurable business benefits.

Ideally, you will also have

  • Experience across Configuration Management, Service Request Management or Service Level Management.
  • Exposure to IT Asset Management, Software Asset Management, IT Operations Management, Discovery, Configuration Management Database, Governance, Risk and Compliance, or Integrated Risk Management.
  • Experience preparing project updates, tracking actions and supporting delivery governance.
  • Confidence working with clients, contractors, partners and internal EY teams.
  • A business or technology-related qualification, or equivalent practical experience.
  • Curiosity about new technology and a desire to keep learning.

What We Look For

We look for people who are curious, inclusive and comfortable learning in a fast-moving environment. You will be organised, collaborative and confident asking good questions. You will care about quality, communicate clearly and bring energy to solving client problems in a practical way.

What Working At EY Offers

We offer a competitive remuneration package. Our comprehensive benefits package includes support for flexible working and career development, and with FlexEY you can select benefits that suit your needs: covering holidays, health and well-being, insurance, savings and a wide range of discounts, offers and promotions. Plus, we offer:

  • Support and coaching from some of the most engaging colleagues around.
  • Opportunities to develop new skills and progress your career.
  • The freedom and flexibility to handle your role in a way that’s right for you.

 

All our employees are given a benefits package which they can tailor to suit their individual preferences. Our range of benefits include:

  • Pension
  • Discounted health insurance
  • Web Doctor – Free unlimited online GP consultations for you and your family
  • The purchase of additional annual leave
  • Hybrid Working
  • Free Gym membership
  • Travel Pass
  • Maternity & Paternity leave
  • Bike to work Scheme
  • Recognition Awards
  • Cash incentives for referrals
  • Work Mobile
  • Tech MBA paid by EY
  • Wellness rooms available in some offices

EY is committed to being an inclusive employer and we are happy to consider flexible working arrangements. We strive to achieve the right balance for our people, enabling us to deliver excellent client service whilst allowing you to build your career without sacrificing your personal priorities. While our client-facing professionals can be required to travel regularly, and at times be based at client sites, our flexible working arrangements can help you to achieve a lifestyle balance.

 

Career Progression

  • When you join EY, you will be supported to ensure that you are enhancing your skills from day one.
  • Continuous learning, where you can develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next.
  • As you grow and develop here, you’ll discover opportunities to help customise your career journey, so that it’s as unique as you are - success is defined by you, we will provide the tools and flexibility, so you can make a meaningful impact, your way.
  • Transformative leadership, we will give you the insights, coaching and confidence to be the leader the world needs.
  • Diverse and inclusive culture, you will be embraced for who you are and empowered to use your voice to help others find theirs.
  • We have embraced Hybrid working at EY adding greater flexibility and autonomy to the roles of our employees.

About EY

As a global leader in assurance, tax, transaction and advisory services, we’re using the finance products, expertise and systems we’ve developed to build a better working world. That starts with a culture that believes in giving you the training, opportunities and creative freedom to make things better. Whenever you join, however long you stay, the exceptional EY experience lasts a lifetime.

Inclusion & Diversity

We hold a collective commitment to foster an environment where all differences are valued and respected, practices are equitable and everyone experiences a sense of belonging: Inclusion, diversity, and equity are part of who we are at EY. We believe that the highest-performing teams maximize the power of different perspectives and backgrounds. These teams are both diverse and inclusive and are willing to invite and learn from other perspectives. Our ability to include various viewpoints into our mindsets, behaviours and operations is fundamental to driving innovation, building strong relationships, and delivering the best solutions for our clients.

We recognise the strength that comes from having a diverse workforce and building a culture where we support all our people to achieve their potential. You’ll be embraced for who you are and empowered to use your voice to help others find theirs.

As an equal opportunities’ employer, we welcome applications from people of all backgrounds. Reasonable accommodations are offered at every stage of our recruitment process.

Are you ready to shape your future with confidence? Apply today.

To help create the best experience during the recruitment process, please describe any disability-related adjustments or accommodations you may need.

If you can confidently demonstrate that you meet the criteria above, please contact us as soon as possible.

 

IMPORTANT: Where Agency assistance is required, our Talent Team will engage directly with suppliers. CVs / Profiles should not be shared directly with Hiring Managers. Unsolicited CVs / Profiles supplied to EY by Recruitment Agencies will not be accepted for this role.

EY | Building a better working world

EY is building a better working world by creating new value for clients, people, society and the planet, while building trust in capital markets.

Enabled by data, AI and advanced technology, EY teams help clients shape the future with confidence and develop answers for the most pressing issues of today and tomorrow.

EY teams work across a full spectrum of services in assurance, consulting, tax, strategy and transactions. Fueled by sector insights, a globally connected, multi-disciplinary network and diverse ecosystem partners, EY teams can provide services in more than 150 countries and territories.

General Summary

About The Role

We are looking for a Junior DevOps Engineer (Jenkins) to join our CI/CD infrastructure team supporting large‑scale machine learning verification.

This role focuses on the operation and administration of Jenkins infrastructure that underpins software validation across our group. You will work as part of a growing team responsible for running Jenkins as a production service - ensuring reliability, scalability, and consistent CI signal for engineering teams.

You will contribute to the ongoing operation and continuous improvement of CI systems that support high‑volume automated workloads and distributed test environments.

Responsibilities

  • Support the operation of Jenkins as a production CI service, ensuring availability, stability, and responsiveness.
  • Contribute to Jenkins administration, including job and pipeline configuration, plugin management, and system updates.
  • Oversee continuous integration systems and address infrastructure concerns by systematically triaging failures and determining root causes in coordination with the team.
  • Assist with scaling and capacity management, including Jenkins agents, node lifecycle, and resource utilization.
  • Maintain and improve system reliability and CI signal quality, including identifying and addressing infrastructure-related issues.
  • Contribute to automation and tooling to reduce operational overhead and improve repeatability.
  • Work cross-functionally with engineering teams to support CI/CD workflows and improve pipeline stability.


What are we looking for? (Minimum Qualifications)

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related discipline (or equivalent practical experience).
  • 1–2 years of relevant experience in DevOps, CI/CD, or software engineering environments.
  • Strong understanding of CI/CD concepts and workflows, including build, test, and pipeline execution.
  • Experience with Jenkins administration, including pipelines, job configuration, or plugin management.
  • Experience working in Linux environments, with the ability to troubleshoot system-level issues.
  • Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to work effectively in a team-oriented environment.


Preferred Qualifications / Nice To Have

  • Experience supporting or operating CI/CD systems at scale.
  • Familiarity with Git-based development workflows.
  • Knowledge of scripting (e.g. Python or shell) to support automation.
  • Solid understanding of infrastructure concepts such as compute, storage, and networking.
  • Awareness of reliability, monitoring, and operational best practices in CI environments.


Where you will be working

Cork has a proud reputation as Ireland's second largest economic engine and is now one of the Top 20 location choices in Europe with 39,000 people being employed by over 170 overseas companies.

There's a growing diversity in the region with people from many nationalities relocating to Cork, relishing the opportunity to work and live in a location that offers an excellent quality of life.

A gateway to Europe, Cork airport provides access to almost 50 international destinations including transatlantic air routes.

  • Salary, stock and performance related bonus

  • Matching pension scheme

Preferred Qualifications

  • Master's degree in Electrical/Electronic Engineering, Computer Engineering, or Computer Science.
  • 6+ months of experience with architecture and design tools.
  • 6+ months of experience with scripting tools and programming languages.
  • 6+ months of experience with design verification methods.


Principal Duties & Responsibilities

  • Applies ASIC knowledge to assist and support the defining, modeling, designing (digital and/or analog), optimizing, verifying, validating, implementing, and documenting of IP (block/SoC) development for a variety of high performance, high quality, low power products.

  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills.

KKR is a leading global investment firm that offers alternative asset management as well as capital markets and insurance solutions. KKR aims to generate attractive investment returns by following a patient and disciplined investment approach, employing world-class people, and supporting growth in its portfolio companies and communities. KKR sponsors investment funds that invest in private equity, credit and real assets and has strategic partners that manage hedge funds. KKR’s insurance subsidiaries offer retirement, life and reinsurance products under the management of Global Atlantic Financial Group. References to KKR’s investments may include the activities of its sponsored funds and insurance subsidiaries.

THE PROGRAMME

This is a full-time in-person graduate position based in Dublin, Ireland, offered as an 18-month fixed-term contract commencing on September 6, 2027. You will join the Technology team as a Software Engineer for the duration of the programme and take part in a structured onboarding covering KKR and alternative investments. You will work on real production initiatives across the Investment Lifecycle and asset-class platforms, attend educational and network-building programming, and have the opportunity to showcase your work to technology leaders across the firm.

THE OPPORTUNITY

As part of our continued investment in Ireland, KKR is launching a Technology & Engineering Centre of Excellence in Dublin. This new hub will play a central role in building the world’s first technology platform engineered to manage over one trillion dollars in alternative AUM (assets under management). Designed from the ground up for scale, security and speed, this is the infrastructure for the future of global finance. Areas of focus include investment technology, portfolio construction and management, liquidity solutions, risk analytics, and advanced data platforms

THE TECHNOLOGY FUNCTION

KKR's Technology organisation is a global group of passionate technologists and product managers, unified by a shared mission to deliver exceptional products and solutions that drive value for our stakeholders, clients, and investors. Our passion for technology and innovation fuels our commitment to creating high-quality, impactful solutions that address complex challenges and meet the evolving needs of our sophisticated businesses.

Teamwork is at the core of the organisation's success. We thrive on open collaboration and continuous learning, driving a culture that values diversity of thought and collective achievement. Our global footprint fosters the integration of a diverse set of ideas and viewpoints in product and solution delivery, allowing us to design more comprehensive solutions that are adaptable and scalable. We optimise for impact, prioritising and delivering solutions with excellence while remaining agile in response to the evolving needs of our businesses.

THE TEAMS

Investment Systems

The Investment Systems team engineers all aspects of the Investment Lifecycle across an array of asset classes — from deal sourcing and portfolio construction to risk management and monetisation. They design platforms that connect data, people, and insights across Private Equity, Credit, Real Estate, Infrastructure, and Capital Markets, enabling investment teams to make faster, smarter decisions at scale. Their mandate is to transform how KKR invests by engineering shared, data-driven platforms that replace fragmented legacy tools with integrated solutions that drive efficiency, transparency, and alpha generation.

Business Operations Systems

The Business Operations Systems team is comprised of Operations Systems and Enterprise Systems. It consolidates capabilities across five core domains: Operating Platform Services, which supports the firm's core operating platforms; Client Operations and lifecycle management across Asset Management and Insurance; Finance Technology, providing an integrated fund and corporate finance technology ecosystem; Human Capital & Employee Experience, driving HR platforms, workforce data, collaboration tools, and employee experiences; and Governance, Risk & Compliance Technology, supporting the Legal, Compliance, Risk, Audit, and Tax functions.

CRITICAL COMPETENCIES FOR SUCCESS

  • Recent graduate of a university in Ireland, the UK, or continental Europe with an outstanding academic record
  • Bachelor's or master's degree in computer science or a related technical field, with graduation between January and August 2027
  • Right to work in Ireland on a full-time basis without the need for current visa sponsorship
  • Proficiency with Java, Python, C/C++
  • Curiosity about and openness to adopting emerging AI technologies in day-to-day workflows
  • Ability to critically evaluate AI-generated outputs for accuracy and relevance
  • Familiarity with effective prompt design and generating reliable results using generative AI tools
  • Exceptional communication and interpersonal skills
  • Ability to act both strategically and tactically with exceptional attention to detail
  • Team-player who enjoys working in a collaborative and collegial environment and is willing to pitch in when needed
  • Intellectual curiosity and an interest in financial services and alternative investments

KKR is an equal opportunity employer. Individuals seeking employment are considered without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex, marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, veteran status, sexual orientation, or any other category protected by applicable law.

Job Description

AI is the biggest shift in how organisations build anend work in a generation. The organisations who win will be the ones who can move beyond a working demo and get genuinely production-grade, multi-agent AI systems live, reliable and maintained at scale. That is the hardest part of the journey, and it's where this role sits.

As an Applied AI Consultant, you bring that change to the top table. You've done this before — as a CTO, a founder, or the most senior engineering leader in your organisation — and you've taken a whole organisation through the shift to becoming AI native, not just a team. You are as comfortable setting direction with a Chief Executive or Chief Technology Officer as you are going deep on architecture with a lead engineer, and our largest, most strategic customers will look to you to set the pace of their AI transformation.

You'll shape and lead our most significant engagements, secure and hold executive sponsorship, and set the standard the rest of the team builds towards.

What You'll Do

  • Own our most strategic engagements. Lead full-scale AI transformation programmes for our largest and most complex customers, from initial vision through to organisation-wide adoption.
  • Set direction with the C-suite. Work directly with CEOs, CTOs, CIOs and other executive stakeholders to shape AI strategy, secure sponsorship, and connect adoption to the outcomes the business actually cares about.
  • Transform whole organisations. Draw on your own experience taking an organisation through AI-native transformation to guide customers through the same shift — at the scale of a function, a division, or the whole business.
  • Bring the vision. Act as a genuine AI visionary for our customers — someone who can see past the immediate ask to where the technology and the business are both heading, and bring customers with you.
  • Shape how we sell and deliver. Help shape full transformation deals, define how value gets measured, and protect the trust our partners and customers place in Version 1.
  • Lead and mentor. Set the standard for Applied AI Consultants, mentor senior hires, and help build the playbooks and IP that make the whole programme better.
  • Represent Version 1 externally. Build our reputation and thought leadership in the market, as a visible, credible voice on AI adoption and transformation.

Qualifications

What good looks like

  • A proven AI transformation leader at organisation scale. You've personally led an organisation — not just a team — through becoming AI native, as a CTO, founder, or the most senior engineering leader in the room.
  • Genuine AI vision. You don't just keep up with the field, you have a real point of view on where it's heading and what it means for how businesses operate — and people want to hear it.
  • Fluent at C-suite level. You've operated as a peer to CEOs, CTOs and other executives, and you're just as comfortable setting strategy in the boardroom as you are getting hands-on with architecture.
  • Deep technical credibility. Your AI engineering depth is real and current, not historical — engineers and architects trust your judgement because you've stayed close to the work.
  • A track record customers can check. You can point to organisations you've genuinely transformed, and to the outcomes that resulted, not just initiatives you were involved in.
  • Comfortable owning the outcome. You take full ownership of the largest, most ambiguous, highest-stakes engagements, and you bring the judgement and composure the moment needs.

What We're Looking For

  • 10–15+ years in senior engineering leadership, as a CTO, founder, or the most senior technical leader in your organisation.
  • Direct, personal experience leading an organisation-wide shift to becoming AI native, with outcomes you can speak to in detail.
  • A genuine track record operating at C-suite level, comfortable setting direction alongside CEOs, CTOs and other executive stakeholders.
  • Deep, current AI engineering expertise: production LLM and agent experience, evaluation frameworks, and deployment at scale.
  • Experience shaping or building AI solutions and intelligent applications, not just overseeing them.
  • Strong programming fundamentals and enough hands-on depth to be credible with architects and senior engineers.
  • A degree in a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

Nice to have

  • Experience as a founder or CTO of a business that itself went through AI-native transformation.
  • A public profile — thought leadership, speaking, writing, or advisory work — in applied AI or AI transformation.
  • Hands-on experience with the Claude API, Claude Code, MCP, or GitHub's AI tooling.
  • Domain depth in a regulated or enterprise vertical: public sector, financial services, or healthcare and life sciences.
  • Experience shaping large-scale commercial deals or outcome-based propositions.

Additional Information

Why Version 1?

At Version 1, we believe in providing our employees with a comprehensive benefits package that prioritises their wellbeing, professional growth, and financial stability.

  • Share in our success with our Quarterly Performance-Related Profit Share Scheme, where employees collectively benefit from a share of our company's profits
  • Strong Career Progression & mentorship coaching through our Strength in Balance & Leadership schemes with a dedicated quarterly Pathways Career Development programme
  • Flexible/remote working, Version 1 is tremendously understanding of life events and people’s individual circumstances and offer flexibility to help achieve a healthy work life balance

  • Employee Wellbeing schemes including Gym Discounts, Bike to Work, Fitness classes, Mindfulness Workshops, Employee Assistance Programme and much more. Generous holiday allowance, enhanced maternity/paternity leave, marriage/civil partnership leave and special leave policies
  • Educational assistance, incentivised certifications, and accreditations, including AWS, Microsoft, Oracle, and Red Hat
  • Reward schemes including Version 1’s Annual Excellence Awards & ‘Call-Out’ platform.
  • Environment, Social and Community First initiatives allow you to get involved in local fundraising and development opportunities as part of fostering our diversity, inclusion and belonging schemes.

Version 1 is an equal opportunities employer.

We are committed to building a diverse, inclusive and respectful workplace where everyone feels valued and able to thrive. We welcome applications from people of all backgrounds, identities and lived experiences, and we value the different perspectives people bring including those shaped by disability and neurodiversity.

Who We Are

SiriusXM and its brands (Pandora, SiriusXM Media, AdsWizz, Simplecast, and SiriusXM Connected Vehicle Services) are leading a new era of audio entertainment and services by delivering the most compelling subscription and ad-supported audio entertainment experience for listeners -- in the car, at home, and anywhere on the go with connected devices. Our vision is to shape the future of audio, where everyone can be effortlessly connected to the voices, stories and music they love wherever they are.

This is the place where a diverse group of emerging talent and legends alike come to share authentic and purposeful songs, stories, sounds and insights through some of the best programming and technology in the world. Our critically-acclaimed, industry-leading audio entertainment encompasses music, sports, comedy, news, talk, live events, and podcasting. No matter their individual role, each of our employees plays a vital part in bringing SiriusXM’s vision to life every day.

SiriusXM is the leading audio entertainment company in North America, and the premier programmer and platform for subscription and digital advertising-supported audio products. SiriusXM’s platforms collectively reach approximately 150 million listeners, the largest digital audio audience across paid and free tiers in North America, and deliver music, sports, talk, news, comedy, entertainment and podcasts. Pandora, a subsidiary of SiriusXM, is the largest ad-supported audio entertainment streaming service in the U.S. SiriusXM's subsidiaries Stitcher, Simplecast and AdsWizz make it a leader in podcast hosting, production, distribution, analytics and monetization. The Company’s advertising sales organization, which operates as SXM Media, leverages its scale, cross-platform sales organization and ad tech capabilities to deliver results for audio creators and advertisers. SiriusXM, through Sirius XM Canada Holdings, Inc., also offers satellite radio and audio entertainment in Canada. In addition to its audio entertainment businesses, SiriusXM offers connected vehicle services to automakers.

How You’ll Make An Impact

As a member of our mobile engineering team, you will have the opportunity to bring the Pandora, SiriusXM, and Stitcher experiences to our large and expanding mobile customer base. See it differently

You see the world through a unique lens and that’s exactly what we need. We embrace how you see things differently – it’s essential for creating a sustainable future.

Arup is a global consultancy with advisory and technical expertise across more than 150 disciplines. We guide, plan and design the future of the built environment. Globally, each year we recruit hundreds of graduates and students who help us see things differently and solve the most complex challenges facing our clients, climate and communities.

The Opportunity

At Arup, we are reimagining the future of aviation through innovative, sustainable, and people-focused projects. As a Graduate Project Manager - Aviation, you will work alongside multidisciplinary teams to help deliver complex airport and aviation infrastructure projects that connect communities and support economic growth.

This is an exciting opportunity for a curious and motivated graduate who enjoys solving problems, collaborating with others, and turning ideas into successful project outcomes.

As a Graduate Project Manager - Aviation, you will, but not limited to:

  • Support the planning, coordination and delivery of aviation projects from concept through to completion.
  • Assist with project planning, scheduling, budgeting, resource allocation and project controls.
  • Analyse project information and datasets to identify trends, risks and opportunities.
  • Produce clear reports, presentations and project documentation for clients and project teams.
  • Collaborate with engineers, designers, consultants and external stakeholders across multidisciplinary teams.
  • Apply critical thinking and problem-solving skills to complex aviation challenges.
  • Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives and digital project delivery solutions.
  • Utilise Microsoft 365 tools, including Excel, to support project management activities.

https://www.arup.com/markets/transport/aviation/

Is this role right for you?

For this opportunity, we are seeking the following qualifications, skills and attributes:

A Bachelor's degree (Level 8 or above) or Master's degree or PhD in a relevant discipline, including:

  • Civil Engineering
  • Mechanical Engineering
  • Project & Programme Management
  • Business & Commerce

We're Looking For Graduates Who Demonstrate

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills
  • Excellent attention to detail
  • A collaborative approach, with the ability to work both independently and as part of a team
  • A self-motivated mindset and willingness to ask questions and learn
  • Strong organisational skills and the ability to manage competing priorities and deadlines
  • Analytical thinking and the ability to summarise complex information
  • Curiosity, initiative and a passion for continuous improvement
  • Creative problem-solving and critical thinking abilities

Experience or exposure to any of the following would be advantageous:

  • Power BI
  • Power Automate
  • Basic coding knowledge (C++, C# or SQL)

To Be Considered For a Graduate Opportunity, Your Application Must Include a Copy Of Your Academic Transcript And Meet The Following Criteria

  • No more than 12 months of full-time experience in a comparable role
  • Recently graduated, or on track to graduate, from your most recent degree, related to your role of choice, before employment starts.

Please note, in the event of high applicant volume, this role may be closed ahead of the advertised closing date. We advise that you apply early.

Closing Date: 12 November 2026

Eligibility

We're able to consider candidates who require an employment permit to work in Ireland, where the role and offered salary meet the Irish Government's eligibility criteria (for example, under the Critical Skills or General Employment Permit schemes). All Employment Permits are granted at the discretion of the Deciding Officer with offers contingent to obtaining the correct immigration to work and reside in Ireland."

What we offer you

At Arup, we care about each member’s success, so we can grow together.

Guided by our values, we provide an attractive total reward package that recognises the contribution of each of our members to our shared success. As well as competitive, fair and equitable pay, we offer a career in which all of our members can belong, grow and thrive – through benefits that support health and wellbeing, a wide range of learning opportunities and many possibilities to have an impact through the work they do.

We are owned in trust on behalf of our members, giving us the freedom, with personal responsibility, to set our own direction and choose work that aligns with our purpose and adds to Arup’s legacy. Our members collaborate on ambitious projects to deliver remarkable outcomes for our clients and communities. Profit Share is a key part of our reward, enabling permanent members to share in the results of our collective efforts.

We take an approach to flexible working that supports the diversity and wellbeing of our graduates.

For our permanent members we offer private medical insurance allowances, life assurance and income protection cover.

Different people, shared values

Arup is an equal opportunity employer that actively promotes and nurtures a diverse and inclusive workforce. We welcome applications from individuals of all backgrounds, regardless of age (within legal limits), gender identity or expression, marital status, disability, neurotype or mental health, race or ethnicity, faith or belief, sexual orientation, socioeconomic background, and whether you’re pregnant or on family leave. We are an open environment that embraces diverse experiences, perspectives, and ideas - this drives our excellence.

Guided by our values and alignment with the UN Sustainable Development Goals, we create and contribute to equitable spaces and systems, while cultivating a sense of belonging for all. Our internal employee networks support our inclusive culture: from race, ethnicity and cross-cultural working to gender equity and LGBTQ+ and disability inclusion – we aim to create a space for you to express yourself and make a positive difference. Discover more about life at Arup at www.arup.com/careers/your-life-at-arup . We are an open environment that embraces diverse experiences, perspectives, and ideas.

We are committed to providing an inclusive recruitment process. Candidates may inform us of any disability, learning difference, or other circumstance that may require reasonable adjustments for interviews or assessments. Any information provided will be used only to make appropriate arrangements and will not be considered in any other aspect of your application or selection process.

Global Operations, Operations Summer Analyst

About Us

At Bank of America, we are guided by a common purpose to help make financial lives better through the power of every connection. We do this by driving Responsible Growth and delivering for our clients, teammates, communities, and shareholders every day.

Being a Great Place to Work is core to how we drive Responsible Growth. Bank of America is committed to an in-office culture with specific requirements for office-based attendance and which allows for an appropriate level of flexibility for our teammates and businesses based on role-specific considerations.

At Bank of America, you can build a successful career with opportunities to learn, grow, and make an impact. Join us!

The team:

Global Operations (GO) teams manage the critical systems and multiple platforms needed to maintain the enterprise's market-leading positions in key segments. By performing vital functions throughout the end-to-end lifecycle of products, services, and client transactions, we help deliver seamless client outcomes while maintaining a strong risk and control environment.

These activities include client onboarding, trade validation, settlement, servicing, reporting, reconciliations, risk management, process improvement and change delivery.

Programme Overview

Our Summer Analyst Programme in Dublin is designed to provide you with a unique experience within Global Operations. Opportunities are available in the following teams, with alignment based on your interests, development opportunities, and current business needs:

Global Markets Operations (GMO) – Provides end-to-end operational support for Global Markets sales, trading and underwriting activities across securities, loans, and derivative products. Our teams manage critical activities throughout the trade lifecycle, including trade processing, settlement, reconciliation, collateral management, and client servicing, helping deliver seamless market execution.

Training and Development

Your training and development is our top priority with extensive formal training offered at the start of the programme in addition to on‑the‑job training, virtual spotlight sessions, Executive Speaker Series, networking events, and hands‑on project work, with mentorship throughout.

Responsibilities:

As a Summer Analyst, you will be aligned to one team based on your interests and current business needs. Your key tasks and responsibilities may include but are not limited to:

  • Develop an understanding of client, account, and product reference data management processes.
  • Support settlement, clearing, and reconciliation activities across a range of products and services.
  • Build knowledge of trade lifecycle processes, including trade validation, maintenance, exception management, and reconciliation.
  • Build knowledge of the products, services and operational processes that support the bank and its clients
  • Analyse data, identify trends and contribute to business insights, process reviews, and operational excellence initiatives
  • Develop an understanding of risk management, controls, governance and regulatory requirements
  • Support project delivery, business analysis and stakeholder engagement activities
  • Prepare reports, dashboards, presentations and updates for business partners and senior stakeholders


Eligibility

  • Candidates are required to be pursuing a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree from an accredited college or university with a completion time frame between September 2027 and July 2028. Completion means that you have completed all final exams, coursework, and have no outstanding requirements for graduation. Please note that we reserve the right to request evidence of this completion date before extending an offer.
  • On track for a minimum 2:2 degree classification (or equivalent)
  • Must be available to join the programme from June 2027 to August 2027


Candidates who perform well during the internship may be offered full time employment to commence in July 2028; some lines of business may also offer the opportunity of a January or April start date. You must be available to join on one of these start dates if offered, unfortunately we are unable to offer deferrals

What We Are Looking For

Essential:

  • Clear motivation for exploring an Operations career within financial services
  • Evidence of self-learning outside of studies, and efforts to advance technical skills
  • Strong analytical and critical thinking skills, with the ability to solve problems and positively challenge existing processes
  • Effective communication and interpersonal skills, and ability to interact with a variety of people
  • Display evidence of strong teamwork, leadership, and the ability to work in a fast-paced environment, managing multiple priorities
  • Demonstrate integrity and ethics by earning other’s trust and respect through consistent honesty and professionalism in all interactions
  • Fluency in written and spoken English is a pre-requisite


Most importantly, we are looking for individuals with a growth mindset who are keen to learn, embrace challenges and contribute fresh perspectives while delivering an exceptional experience for our clients and teammates.

Our recruitment process

Analyst internship and full-time recruiting takes place on a rolling basis once our applications are open. Assessments often begin before the deadline, so it is best to submit your application early as this will give you the best chance of being considered for the role.

We care deeply about shaping the world of work to be an equal and inclusive one – and that starts with our recruitment process. We know just how important and valuable it is to have a wide range of skills, backgrounds and experiences shaping our work and ideas. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds, and we are proud to focus on attracting, retaining, and developing diverse talent within Bank of America. Together, we aim to mirror the customers, clients, and communities we serve.

We are an equal opportunities employer, and ensure that no applicant is subject to less favourable treatment on the grounds of gender, gender identity or gender reassignment, marital or civil partner status, race, religion or belief, colour, nationality, ethnic or national origins, age, sexual orientation, being pregnant or on maternity leave, socio-economic background, responsibilities for dependants, physical or mental disability. The Bank selects candidates for interview based on their skills, qualifications, and experience.

What if I need workplace adjustments?

We are committed to ensuring our online application process provides an equal employment opportunity to all job seekers. If you need a workplace adjustment to search for a job opening, need help completing your application or video interview, please email juniortalentemea@bofa.com and let us know. We will be more than happy to discuss the support you need, and we will respond to your email within two business days.

Job Description

A wonderful opportunity has arisen for a Digital and Data Quality (Snr Specialist) to join the global Digital & Data Quality (DDQ) team in Ballydine, reporting to the Associate Director of DDQ for EMEA.

In this hands-on role, you will support manufacturing, laboratory, and logistics teams to assess, select, and validate computerized systems used in GMP processes, ensuring validation effort matches system complexity and risk. You will provide quality oversight for computerized systems used in support of GMP processes, provide expert Data Integrity (DI) guidance, and support inspection readiness.

At our company, we aspire to be the premier research-intensive pharmaceutical company. We are at the forefront of research to deliver innovative health solutions that advance the prevention and treatment of diseases in people and animals. We use the power of leading-edge science to save and improve lives around the world. As a Senior Specialist Digital and Data Quality, you will play a vital role in ensuring compliance with our company’s policies, procedures, and regulatory expectations.

Key Responsibilities

The responsibilities cover the quality aspects of data integrity, GMP computerized systems, master data management, laboratory instrumentation/systems, and supporting infrastructure used in site facilities, utilities, manufacturing, and laboratories to ensure compliance with company policies, procedures, and regulatory expectations.

  • Act as a change driver and strategic lead to site processes within the global Quality Management System (QMS) framework.
  • Influence the organizational future through review and approval of all quality-related activities, such as policies, procedures, plans, protocols, requirements, reports, deviations, and changes, as well as contributing to site inspection readiness.
  • Introduce strategic initiatives on site, driving standardisation across the GMP environment for computerized systems and data integrity, and representing DDQ in global governance meetings for data integrity, computerized system validation, master data management, and lab instrumentation / systems.
  • Promote cGMP and Data Integrity awareness and support a culture of continuous improvement. Help develop and maintain training on computerized systems validation, data integrity, and internal procedures.
  • Work together with the business to resolve regulatory non-conformances for cGMP computerized systems and data integrity in a way that ensures business efficiency and compliance. Drive improvements on both a local and global level, based on emerging trends, compliance gaps, and system weaknesses.
  • Act as a representative for DDQ management in site- and above-site meetings as needed.

Qualifications & Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree, preferably in Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or equivalent.
  • At least five years of demonstrable experience delivering validated IT solutions or working in an application support role.
  • Strong understanding of the current pharmaceutical industry and applicable regulations (FDA/EU/ICH)
  • Familiarity or practical experience in the implementation of quality systems in a pharmaceutical, laboratory, or manufacturing environment.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, complemented by strong communication and teamwork skills that add great value to the team’s success.
  • Timely decision-making and the ability to manage changing priorities, with strong project management skills, a sense of urgency, and a track record of delivering quality deliverables.
  • Extended experience with deviations, CAPA, change control, master data, qualification/validation, and inspection readiness in a GxP environment.

Ballydine is the primary Drug Substance commercialisation hub within the network, where new processes are scaled and transitioned to commercial manufacture. The site supports clinical and commercial API supply and the transfer of processes and technologies across internal manufacturing sites and external partners.

We keep the patient at the very heart of all that we do and strive to find solutions and treatments for some of the world’s most challenging healthcare needs. So, if you are ready to Invent solutions to meet unmet healthcare needs, Impact the future by driving one of the world’s leading healthcare companies, and inspire your team to reach their full potential and push the boundaries of science and technology, please apply today.

Who We Are

Build what matters. Grow where it counts.

At AMCS, sustainability means business — and careers that create impact. From our roots in Ireland to our teams across Europe, North America and Australasia, we are bringing together ambitious people to help reshape the industries that sustain our world.

What We Build

We build intelligent, cloud-based SaaS solutions that turn complex operations into smarter, more sustainable performance. Powered by AI, data and deep industry expertise, our technology helps customers optimise routes, manage recycling, improve compliance, unlock insight and move faster toward a more efficient, circular future.

Why Join AMCS

Join AMCS and be part of a global team where purpose meets performance. Here, you can grow your career, challenge what’s possible and work on technology that makes a measurable difference — for our customers, our communities and the planet.

Data Analyst — Enterprise Data Platform

Team:BI & Analytics

Location / type:Limerick

Reports to:Jeevan Krishna

About The Role

AMCS’s Enterprise Data Platform serves the business through Power BI, built on a lakehouse architecture (Bronze/Silver/Gold) on Azure Databricks. As a Data Analyst, you sit closest to the business — turning stakeholder questions into reports and dashboards, writing DAX and SQL against the Gold layer, and partnering with Data Engineering on what the dimensional model needs to answer the next question. You’re the primary consumer of what Data Engineering builds, and one of the best signals for what it should build next.

What You’ll Work On

  • Build and maintain Power BI reports and semantic models on top of the Gold layer (dim_/fact_ tables), using the version-controlled .pbip format
  • Write DAX measures and ad hoc SQL against Databricks SQL Warehouses to answer one-off business questions that don’t warrant a full report.
  • Partner with stakeholders across finance, sales, marketing, HR, and support to turn open-ended questions into well-scoped, testable report requirements.
  • Work with Data Engineering to prioritize and validate new dim_/fact_ models — you’re often the first to notice a gap between what a report needs and what the dimensional model currently supports.
  • Validate the legacy reports being migrated off their old SQL Server logic onto the new data model in databricks — compare new output against old and sign off before cutover.
  • Keep report-level documentation current, including which reports depend on which models, so impact analysis stays trustworthy as the model evolves.
  • Work within the platform’s Beta → Production promotion model — validate everything in Beta before it reaches Production, no exceptions.

What We’re Looking For

Must-have

  • Strong Power BI skills: report/dashboard design, DAX, semantic modeling (relationships, measures, calculation groups).
  • Solid SQL — comfortable querying a modern cloud warehouse/lakehouse (MS Fabric, Databricks SQL, Snowflake, Synapse, or similar).
  • Experience translating ambiguous business questions into clear, testable report requirements, not just building what’s literally asked for.
  • Basic grounding in dimensional modelling (facts, dimensions, grain)
  • Comfortable working in a Git-based workflow for version-controlled reports (PR review, structured project files)

Nice-to-have

  • Experience with dbt authoring models & reading model docs/lineage.
  • Exposure to NetSuite or Salesforce as source systems or reporting subjects.
  • Experience validating a data migration — comparing legacy vs. new report output as part of a cutover.
  • Familiarity with Azure Databricks specifically (Unity Catalog permissions, SQL Warehouses).

The transformations we make are often deep—designed to speed up innovation, benefit customers, and strengthen business performance. Here, hierarchy is minimal and teams are small and talent-dense. We operate established products with the ambition, agility, and urgency of a startup. Across the company, we integrate AI deeply into how we work so that human judgment and machine intelligence reinforce each other. For a talented, driven, and collaborative individual, working at Bending Spoons is an opportunity to learn, make an impact, and progress their career at an exceptionally high rate. Take real ownership from idea to production, creating systems used by millions and evolving them into products at scale. Amplify your impact with AI. Integrate the most powerful AI tools directly into your development workflow—design, implementation, testing, and documentation—to move faster while maintaining high standards for correctness, reliability, and maintainability. Master your toolkit. Work across diverse stacks with end-to-end ownership, choosing the right technologies for each challenge. You feel deeply responsible for your work. You hold yourself to a high—and rising—bar. Team spirit. You give generously and without the expectation of receiving in return. You support the best idea, not your idea. You're always happy to get your hands dirty to help your team. You’re reliable, honest, and transparent. Proficiency in English. Spooners in their 20s lead products worth hundreds of millions of dollars. And if you’ve got what it takes, you’ll soon be playing an essential role in major projects, too. All. These. Benefits. The Role


We're looking for an engineer who builds with AI daily, can make technical calls with confidence, and brings strong leadership and clear thinking to the work.


Coastline Gaming operates 11 venues across Ireland plus Slotbox online casino, and bring a startup mindset to building an established and growing business. The directors use Claude Code in their own work—you won't be persuading anyone that AI-assisted building is worth doing. You'll be joining people already doing it and expected to push it further than they have.


Working across online gaming and physical venues gives you an unusual mix of product and engineering challenges. You'll help build the digital customer experience and the software used on the ground, with access to the people using both. You'll have a hand in the early decisions on new builds as well as improving existing products. The role gives you room to take responsibility for projects while staying involved in the engineering yourself.


What You'll Do

• Build customer-facing applications and new frontends for our online casino brands.

• Develop APIs and integrations that connect our customer products and business systems.

• Work with staff to find where better software would help, then build internal tools that solve those problems.

• Help set technical direction: how systems fit together, which architecture makes sense, and when to build, adapt or buy.

• Manage several projects at once, agree priorities with the directors and give engineers clear ownership of the work.

• Help other engineers work through difficult problems, review code and improve how the team builds with AI.


What We're Looking For


• You build with AI daily. Claude Code, Codex, Cursor or equivalent tools are central to how you work. You try new approaches, know where they help and can show us what you've built.

• You get to grips with unfamiliar systems quickly. You ask useful questions, test your assumptions and know when to ask someone who knows more.

• You can challenge a brief. You work out whether it solves the right problem and can explain a simpler approach when there is one.

• You've managed people and several projects while continuing to build yourself. You can explain what needed your attention, what you delegated and how you handled problems. Managing a small team counts.

• You've earned broader responsibility within an organisation and can show what changed as you took on more. Experience building and leading in a startup or smaller team is particularly relevant.

• You can make technical decisions and explain the trade-offs. You understand what a change means for the users and the other systems involved.

• You judge your own work. You check AI-generated changes, look for what could fail and change your approach when the evidence calls for it.


Working Here


Compensation is open for the right person. You must already be based in Ireland and have the right to work in the Republic of Ireland. The main office is in Dublin and the role is hybrid; we'll consider the right person elsewhere in Ireland.


How to Apply


Apply directly using the "Apply" button


It is essential that you send a link or attachment showing something you've built with AI alongside your CV. It can be a system, workflow, app or tool, from work or a personal project. Send a working link, repo, short video demo, write-up or presentation that shows what you built. Please add a few lines explaining what it does, your contribution or something to give us a bit of context as to what we are looking at.


For confidential work, send a redacted demo or write-up that shows the build without sharing your employer's code or data.

• Permanent position available with a considerable portfolio of works for the next 5+ years
  • To build your career by assisting in the delivery of ‘leading edge’ engineering projects.
  • To work with a vibrant, agile and multi-functional team in delivering projects on time, safely, to budget and to the required quality standards.
  • To benefit from Kirby’s Career Development Programmes that will enhance your leadership capability.
  • To work with the best.
  • Excellent package on offer with room for negotiations

About Kirby Group Engineering

Kirby Group Engineering is an international multi-disciplinary engineering services contractor and leading provider of high-value engineering services to a number of ‘blue chip’ companies. Operating across Ireland, the UK, Europe and South Africa, Kirby has become the engineering service provider of choice in growth segments such as pharmaceuticals, data centres and power transmission and distribution. Our culture is innovative, collaborative and performance focused. The successful candidate will have the opportunity to grow and develop in a company committed to developing talent and rewarding performance.

About The Role

We are seeking an experienced Project Manager to join our growing Power & Renewables team. Reporting to the Operations/Contracts Manager, you will take full responsibility for the successful delivery of complex projects from pre-construction through to commissioning and handover. You will lead project teams to deliver outstanding results across health & safety, programme, quality, commercial performance, and client satisfaction, ensuring projects are completed safely, on time, within budget, and to the highest standards.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead the end-to-end delivery of Power & Renewables projects.
  • Develop and manage project execution strategies, programmes, resources, and delivery plans.
  • Ensure projects are delivered safely, in compliance with all HSE requirements and company standards.
  • Take ownership of project budgets, cost control, contract administration, variations, and overall commercial performance.
  • Manage project risks and opportunities, implementing mitigation plans where required.
  • Build and maintain strong client relationships, acting as the primary point of contact throughout project delivery.
  • Oversee subcontractors, procurement activities, and supply chain performance to ensure successful project outcomes.
  • Coordinate closely with engineering, commercial, quality, and site teams to drive efficient delivery.
  • Monitor project progress, provide accurate reporting, and escalate key risks or issues when necessary.
  • Lead project review meetings and ensure lessons learned are captured and implemented across future projects.

Qualifications & Experience

  • Degree-qualified in Engineering, Construction Management, Project Management, or a related discipline or hold a recognised electrical trade qualification.
  • Professional qualification such as PMP, PRINCE2, APM PMQ, or equivalent is desirable.
  • Minimum 5 years' experience delivering HV Power and Renewable-related projects, such as BESS and substations
  • Demonstrable experience delivering projects safely, on programme, and within budget.
  • Strong understanding of project planning, commercial management, contract administration, and risk management.
  • Strong knowledge of construction health, safety, and environmental requirements.
  • Full driving licence and willingness to travel to project locations across Ireland.

What We're Looking For

The successful candidate will be a confident leader with excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, capable of motivating teams and driving performance in a fast-paced environment. You will possess strong commercial awareness, sound decision-making abilities, and a proven track record of successfully delivering complex infrastructure projects while maintaining the highest standards of safety, quality, and client service.

For more information on this role, or other Construction / Engineering opportunities across Ireland, the UK, Europe, or South Africa please review our careers page (Vacancies - Kirby Group Careers) or contact the Talent Acquisition Team at Kirby Group in confidence on +353 (0)1 454 0411.

Kirby Group Engineering is an equal opportunities employer. We are committed to fostering an inclusive workplace and welcome applications from all suitably qualified candidates, regardless of race, gender, disability, religion, sexual orientation, or age.

  • Strong hands-on expertise with Databricks, PySpark, Spark SQL, Python, SQL, Delta Lake, and cloud data services, with Azure and/or AWS experience.
  • Demonstrated experience designing reusable ingestion and data pipeline frameworks, including orchestration and integration with dbt, Apache Airflow, Azure Data Factory, AWS Glue, or comparable tools.
  • Strong knowledge of data architecture and modeling, including dimensional modeling, star and snowflake schemas.
  • Experience defining and implementing automated testing strategies for data engineering code and pipelines, including unit, integration, regression, reconciliation, data-quality testing, and CI/CD integration.

  • Experience supporting Agile product teams, mentoring engineers, and building reusable platform capabilities embraced across multiple business functions.

This role has been designed as 'Hybrid' with a requirement that you will work on average 2 days per week from an HPE office.

Who We Are

Hewlett Packard Enterprise is the global edge-to-cloud company advancing the way people live and work. We help companies connect, protect, analyze, and act on their data and applications wherever they live, from edge to cloud, so they can turn insights into outcomes at the speed required to thrive in today’s complex world. Our culture thrives on finding new and better ways to accelerate what’s next. We know varied backgrounds are valued and succeed here. We have the flexibility to manage our work and personal needs. We make bold moves, together, and are a force for good. If you are looking to stretch and grow your career our culture will embrace you. Open up opportunities with HPE.

Job Description

What the Project Is About

Data centres are becoming some of Europe's most consequential and fastest-growing electricity users, yet most still appear to the grid as large, opaque, and largely grid-agnostic loads. AIRCAS, short for AI-driven Resource & Cooling forCASting and control for data centres, gives you the opportunity to change this through advanced AI control in a live data-centre environment. You will help build a digital twin, forecasting, and safety-constrained control system that coordinates electricity demand, cooling, heat recovery, and water use.

At HPE Labs Ireland, the role will involve live telemetry processing, research, training, evaluation, and deployment of reinforcement-learning controllers across two MODPODs in the Customer Innovation Centre (CIC) data centre. You will validate control policies through replay, hardware-in-the-loop, shadow-mode, and controlled live trials. This is an applied research role spanning physical-system modelling, software engineering, machine learning, and operational deployment.

You will collaborate with our international project partners: the University of Porto, CNRS, Savery Tech, RWTH Aachen, Swerim, TerraBarrier, and Daikin Applied.

The Opportunity

Hewlett Packard Labs is seeking a highly qualified, self-motivated machine-learning and AI researcher to join its growing AI research team in Ireland. The role will accelerate research on digital twins that incorporate machine learning, with a focus on the AIRCAS programme.

You will develop and deploy advanced reinforcement-learning control for a live data-centre environment. The work spans research, software engineering, and experimental validation: from data collection and physical-system modelling through forecasting, control-policy training, hardware-in-the-loop testing, shadow operation, and bounded live trials.

What You Will Do

  • Build the CIC data and workload pipeline, including controlled workload generation, telemetry ingestion, time-series data management, data-quality checks, and baseline datasets.
  • Develop modular digital-twin software that combines site telemetry with physical models, empirical performance maps, cooling and storage models, and operational constraints.
  • Develop probabilistic forecasts for IT load, cooling demand, and relevant water and heat signals using CIC operational data.
  • Research, implement, train, and evaluate objective-shifting multi-objective reinforcement-learning policies that balance flexibility, cost, carbon, water use, and durability within hard safety limits.
  • Implement a price-response interface that produces feasible, auditable flexibility commitments with uncertainty information.
  • Validate the control stack through replay, hardware-in-the-loop testing, shadow mode, and controlled actuation windows on the CIC MODPODs.
  • Produce reproducible evidence for flexibility, reliability, sustainability, and durability performance, including measurement-and-verification workflows and KPI analysis.
  • Collaborate with HPE Labs researchers and the AIRCAS partners to integrate laboratory cooling results, sustainability signals, and physical operating guardrails into the control system.

About Hewlett Packard Labs And AIRL

Hewlett Packard Labs is HPE's central research organisation. Its purpose is to deliver breakthrough technologies that create a competitive advantage for HPE, investing in fundamental areas of strategic interest and preparing resulting technologies for adoption.

The AI Research Lab (AIRL) focuses on applied machine-learning research and applications relevant to HPE and its customers. Its work includes reinforcement learning for sustainability, digital twins, complex scientific applications such as fusion energy, large language models, trustworthy and responsible AI, and data foundations for AI. The team brings together diverse skills and expertise to explore ambitious research and technology opportunities.

What We Are Looking For

We are looking for a machine-learning research engineer with experience in machine learning, time-series analysis, reinforcement learning, and digital twins. The role requires strong engineering judgement and an aptitude for modelling physical systems. The ideal candidate is entrepreneurial, comfortable with system-level analysis and design, and motivated to turn research ideas into deployed technology.

We expect team members to provide technical leadership, take innovative ideas from conception through design, development, implementation, evaluation, and technology transfer, and collaborate effectively with HPE Labs teams, external partners, and HPE's wider innovation community.

Education And Experience

  • PhD degree, or Master's degree with equivalent research and innovation experience, in a relevant discipline such as computer science, software engineering, electrical engineering, mathematics, physics, statistics, or mechanical engineering.
  • Proven record of innovation in deep learning, scientific computing, engineering computation, or machine-learning applications.
  • Demonstrated experience developing proofs of concept, first-of-a-kind solutions, or technologies for transfer into practice.
  • Evidence of independent research leadership, for example through publications in leading conferences or journals.

Required Technical Skills

  • Strong software-development skills in Python and PyTorch.
  • Strong experience applying machine learning to physical systems.
  • Knowledge of digital twins, machine learning with digital twins, and sustainability applications.
  • Strong science or engineering background, including system-level analysis and modelling.
  • Sound understanding of machine-learning algorithms, data structures, and modern AI/ML platforms.
  • Ability to develop integrated software algorithms; work with large-scale computing, data-analysis, and modelling environments; and translate technical specifications into robust code.
  • Excellent research, development, written, and verbal communication skills in English.

Preferred Skills

  • Research publications in machine learning, applied statistics, or AI.
  • Experience designing, implementing, and operating AI/ML systems.
  • Experience with reinforcement learning, probabilistic time-series forecasting, optimisation, or control.
  • Experience with experimental systems, hardware-in-the-loop testing, or production software for research prototypes.

If you believe you require accommodation during any stage of the application or interview process, please submit your request by completing our secure form linked here.

Note: This option is reserved for applicants needing assistance/reasonable accommodation related to a disability.

What We Can Offer You

Health & Wellbeing

We strive to provide our team members and their loved ones with a comprehensive suite of benefits that supports their physical, financial and emotional wellbeing.

Personal & Professional Development

We also invest in your career because the better you are, the better we all are. We have specific programs catered to helping you reach any career goals you have — whether you want to become a knowledge expert in your field or apply your skills to another division.

Unconditional Inclusion

We are unconditionally inclusive in the way we work and celebrate individual uniqueness. We know varied backgrounds are valued and succeed here. We have the flexibility to manage our work and personal needs. We make bold moves, together, and are a force for good.

Description

AWS Lambda’s goal is nothing less than to simplify and improve the experience of computing in the cloud for every developer on the planet, from start-ups to the largest Fortune 100 companies. Serverless computing is rapidly changing how every company thinks about building and delivering software solutions, and Lambda is leading this industry wide effort.

Our Team

AWS Lambda is growing its initiatives in Dublin, Ireland, with goals of continuing to define the Serverless revolution. Lambda teams in Dublin are part of lambda experience charter with mission to simplify the developer, operator, and administrator tasks in bringing code from desktop-development to a production service. If you’re excited by Serverless computing, programming languages and container/function interaction models, this role is for you. Join us and change how the world computes by enabling new frameworks that enable customers to build better software on top of AWS.

Lambda Experience Runtimes is one of the most customer visible and developer commented upon areas of Lambda. The Language Runtimes team are responsible for the curation, patching and deprecation of all the six Managed Runtimes that Lambda supports such as Python, NodeJS, Java, Ruby, Go, DotNet in addition to the custom runtime plus the associated lambda container images.

An ideal candidate has experience delivering new initiatives and be comfortable working closely with Customers. You should be aware of industry best practices & patterns in all aspects of building, releasing & verifying software. You should also be familiar with industry trends in programming languages, build tooling, and deployment spaces. You will own and help driving exciting new and existing initiatives in Lambda, while being capable of working on massive scale, high availability, and ambiguous performance problems as well as developer experience problems. This role will involve identifying and solving problems in different programming language ecosystems, enabling new customer facing functionality, and new programming paradigms in the Serverless ecosystem.

What does it take to succeed in this role?

A roll-up-your-sleeves type. Comfortable working in an environment dedicated to meeting the expectations and requirements of customers. Able to think about business opportunities, operational issues, and architectural diagrams in the course of a single conversation. Intellectually curious, always looking to learn, and a dedication to turning developers into fans. Someone who makes the team both productive and a fun place to work. Being excited to learn from others while bringing your own novel capabilities and perspectives.

On-Call Responsibility

This position involves on-call responsibilities, every builder on Lambda is also an owner. Nobody likes to get paged in the middle of the night or on the weekend, so we work to ensure that our systems are well engineered, fault tolerant and meet a high quality bar before the go into production. Our customers expect nothing less. When we do get paged we work together as a team to resolve the root cause of the issue and nobody is left on their own to deal with an operational issue.

What you should expect?

If you’re excited by defining how modern and future software applications are built and want to help lead from the innovative edge, we guarantee that your work in our team will be ground-breaking and challenging. We’re looking for a new teammate who is enthusiastic, empathetic, curious, motivated, reliable, and able to work effectively with a diverse team of peers; someone who will help us amplify the positive & inclusive team culture we’ve been building.

Together, we’ll deliver the next generation of industry-leading compute features and help every business from the smallest startups to the largest enterprises run their code in the cloud without the burden of infrastructure or scale (that’s our job). We’ll shape not just our own products, but contribute to the direction of AWS and the serverless industry.

Utility Computing (UC)

AWS Utility Computing (UC) provides product innovations — from foundational services such as Amazon’s Simple Storage Service (S3) and Amazon Elastic Compute Cloud (EC2), to consistently released new product innovations that continue to set AWS’s services and features apart in the industry. As a member of the UC organization, you’ll support the development and management of Compute, Database, Storage, Internet of Things (Iot), Platform, and Productivity Apps services in AWS. Within AWS UC, Amazon Dedicated Cloud (ADC) roles engage with AWS customers who require specialized security solutions for their cloud services.

Come help us change the world!

About The Team

About AWS

If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Why AWS?

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Inclusive Team Culture

Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon (gender diversity) conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.

Mentorship & Career Growth

We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Work/Life Balance

We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why flexible work hours and arrangements are part of our culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.
