job.description:
At Bending Spoons, we’re striving to build one of the all-time great companies. A company that serves a huge number of customers. A company where team members grow to their full potential. A company that functions at unparalleled levels of effectiveness and efficiency. A company that creates value for shareowners at an extraordinary rate. And a company that does so while adhering to high ethical standards.

In pursuit of this objective, we acquire and improve digital businesses, not to sell on, but to own and operate for the long term. The transformations we make are often deep—designed to speed up innovation, benefit customers, and strengthen business performance. Here, hierarchy is minimal and teams are small and talent-dense. We operate established products with the ambition, agility, and urgency of a startup. Across the company, we integrate AI deeply into how we work so that human judgment and machine intelligence reinforce each other.

For a talented, driven, and collaborative individual, working at Bending Spoons is an opportunity to learn, make an impact, and progress their career at an exceptionally high rate. That’s our promise to such a candidate.

A few examples of your responsibilities
  • Build AI-powered product experiences. Work with product teams to identify high-impact opportunities where AI can transform the user experience for millions—and then build these transformative solutions. Drive the process from possibility to production, delivering code that’s robust, reproducible, and built for scale.
  • Amplify your impact with AI. Integrate the most powerful AI tools directly into your development workflow—design, implementation, testing, and documentation—to move faster while maintaining high standards for correctness, reliability, and maintainability.
  • Master your toolkit. Work across diverse stacks with end-to-end ownership, choosing the right technologies for each challenge. From monoliths to microservices, gRPC to REST, Kubernetes to Docker, Python to Rust—you’ll apply technologies thoughtfully, focusing on depth and purpose rather than trends.
  • Build software that matters. Take real ownership from idea to production, creating systems used by millions and evolving them into products at scale.
  • Simplify relentlessly. Question every layer of complexity. Improve architectures, pipelines, and codebases to build systems that are simpler, more scalable, and easier to maintain.

What we look for
  • Reasoning ability. Given the necessary knowledge, you can solve complex problems. You think from first principles, and structure your ideas sharply. You resist the influence of biases. You identify and take care of the details that matter.
  • Drive. You’re extremely ambitious in everything you do—and your initiative, effort, and tenacity match the intensity of your ambition. You feel deeply responsible for your work. You hold yourself to a high—and rising—bar.
  • Team spirit. You give generously and without the expectation of receiving in return. You support the best idea, not your idea. You're always happy to get your hands dirty to help your team. You’re reliable, honest, and transparent.
  • Proficiency in English. You read, write, and speak proficiently in English.

What we offer
  • Incredibly talented, entrepreneurial teams. You’ll work in small, result-oriented, autonomous teams alongside some of the brightest people in your field.
  • An exceptional opportunity for growth. We go to great lengths to hire individuals of outstanding potential—then, our priority is to put them in the ideal position to thrive. Spooners in their 20s lead products worth hundreds of millions of dollars. And if you’ve got what it takes, you’ll soon be playing an essential role in major projects, too.
  • All. These. Benefits. Flexible hours, remote working, unlimited backing for learning and training, top-of-the-market health insurance, a rich relocation package, generous parental support, and a yearly retreat to a stunning location. We help each Spooner set up the conditions to do their best work.
  • A flexible start date and part-time options. You don't need to wait until graduation to apply. We offer flexible start dates and the possibility to begin part-time, transitioning to full-time as you complete your degree. Many Spooners joined before graduating and progressively took on greater responsibility, with arrangements that allowed them to do so without compromising their education.
  • Competitive pay and access to company equity at a discount. Typical annual salary offers range from £85,797 to £151,436 in London and from €66,065 to €107,837 elsewhere in Europe. The lower end of these ranges applies to candidates with little or no relevant experience, while exceptionally experienced candidates may receive offers of up to £316,052 in London or €240,330 elsewhere in Europe. Candidates offered a permanent contract may choose to receive part of their compensation in discounted company equity.

Commitment & contract
Permanent or fixed-term. Full-time.

Location
Milan (Italy), London (UK), Madrid (Spain), Warsaw (Poland).

The selection process
In our screening process, we prioritize verifiable signals of excellence, regardless of seniority. There are no preferential paths beyond what your application demonstrates, and we evaluate every candidate through the same process.

Some people hold back because they feel they lack experience or have an “imperfect” CV. If you like the role and believe you could excel over time, don’t self-reject.

All applications go through our careers page, which is the only way to be considered. If you pass our screening, you’ll be asked to complete one or more tests. They are challenging, may involve unfamiliar problems, and can take several hours. To learn more about what to expect throughout the selection process, you can find additional information here.

We set the bar high and won’t extend an offer until we’re confident we’ve found the right candidate. This is why a job may remain open for months or be reposted several times.

We consider all applicants for employment and provide reasonable accommodations for individuals with disabilities—please let us know through this form.

Before you apply
If you’ve applied before but didn't receive an offer, we recommend waiting at least one year before applying again.

Bending Spoons is a demanding environment. We’re extremely ambitious and we hold ourselves—and one another—to a high standard. While this tends to lead to extraordinary learning, achievement, and career growth, it also requires significant commitment.

To help you ramp up quickly and set yourself up for success, we expect you to spend most days in our Milan office during your first few months with us, regardless of your long-term work location. It’s the best way to rapidly absorb our company culture and build trust with your new teammates. We’ll support you with generous travel and accommodation assistance. After that, you’re welcome to work from one of our offices, or remotely from approved countries—depending on what we agree at the offer stage.

If the role speaks to you and you’re excited to give your best, we’d love to hear from you. Apply now—we can’t wait to meet you.

Specialising in research across health, nutrition and beauty, the company is looking for a Data Analyst with experience analysing survey and panel data.

The role

  • Clean, structure and validate survey and panel datasets, including recoding variables, merging files and identifying missing values, duplicates and inconsistencies.
  • Develop and implement statistical analysis plans for quantitative research projects.
  • Produce descriptive statistics, cross-tabulations, significance tests and comparisons across respondent groups.
  • Apply weighting and analyse changes across study phases where relevant.
  • Translate statistical results into clear tables, charts and research findings.
  • Support researchers with questionnaire design, ensuring methodological consistency and analytical feasibility.
  • Maintain accurate documentation and traceability of data processing.
  • Contribute to improving analytical workflows, reporting and quality control.


Your profile

  • Experience within a market research, insights or studies agency.
  • Strong hands-on proficiency in SPSS, with the ability to work independently on research datasets.

  • Advanced Excel skills, including PivotTables, complex formulas and data preparation.

  • A degree in Statistics, Data Science, Econometrics or a related quantitative discipline.
  • Strong analytical judgement, attention to detail and the ability to explain technical findings to non-specialist colleagues.
  • A collaborative approach, curiosity and confidence learning new tools.

  • Python or R for data preparation, statistical analysis or automation.

TikTok is the leading destination for short-form mobile video. At TikTok, our mission is to inspire creativity and bring joy. TikTok's global headquarters are in Los Angeles and Singapore, and we also have offices in New York City, London, Dublin, Paris, Berlin, Dubai, Jakarta, Seoul, and Tokyo.

Every challenge is an opportunity to learn and innovate as one team. We're resilient and embrace challenges as they come. By constantly iterating and fostering an "Always Day 1" mindset, we achieve meaningful breakthroughs for ourselves, our company, and our users. When we create and grow together, the possibilities are limitless. Join us.

Diversity & Inclusion

Whether people and businesses are sending money to another country, spending abroad, or making and receiving international payments, Wise is on a mission to make their lives easier and save them money. As part of our team, you will be helping us create an entirely new network for the world's money. For everyone, everywhere. Job Description More about our mission and what we offer . Our team builds the ledger that answers that question: a real-time, accurate view of Wise's FX position and liquidity. This is high-volume, event-driven infrastructure where correctness matters. Your work directly supports how Treasury manages Wise's money, and the evolution of the ledger as the business grows. What will you be working on? Build new specialised ledgers that track Wise's FX risk and liquidity in real time, using modern stream-processing technology. Design real-time reconciliation and data-quality controls that catch discrepancies as they happen, not days later. Why join Hager as a V.I.E.?

Joining Hager as a V.I.E. means setting sail on an international journey where you will navigate real-world challenges, contribute to meaningful projects and chart your course alongside experienced professionals. You will be part of a collaborative, growth-oriented culture in which your ideas help steer the ship and your development is supported every step of the way. With opportunities to build your skills, gain broad technical exposure and explore new horizons, this is more than an assignment: it is a true launching point for your international career.

Are you ready to come aboard and start your journey with us?

As a V.I.E. Technical & Market Support Engineer, you will report to the Technical Function Lead and Sales Engineer within Hager Ireland, based in Santry, Dublin, for an initial 12-month V.I.E. assignment, renewable up to 24 months.

What will you do?

  • Provide responsive technical support to customers, consultants, contractors, panel builders, sales teams and internal stakeholders, including handling daily calls and inbox enquiries.
  • Translate specifications, schematics and electrical distribution designs into accurate technical solutions, consumer-unit designs, bills of materials and lighting-control take-offs.
  • Work closely with sales and technical teams to identify market opportunities and strengthen Hager’s specification influence across commercial, industrial and residential segments.
  • Support product launches, product promotion and customer-engagement initiatives, with occasional visits to customer sites, panel builders, meetings and industry events across Ireland.
  • Contribute to market analysis and help reinforce Hager Ireland’s position in low-voltage distribution, energy management and emerging smart-building markets.

What about you?

  • You hold a degree in Electrical Engineering, Building Services Engineering or a related technical discipline; relevant practical, trade or apprenticeship experience would be an advantage.
  • You have a strong understanding of low-voltage electrical distribution systems, relevant standards, technical specifications, schematics and electrical distribution designs.
  • You are fluent in English and communicate technical concepts clearly, both verbally and in writing, with strong presentation skills.
  • You combine analytical and problem-solving skills with commercial curiosity and an interest in energy management, EV infrastructure, smart buildings and market development.
  • You are comfortable working independently and collaboratively in a cross-functional environment, and you are proficient in Microsoft Office, particularly Excel and PowerPoint.

What do we offer?

The Volontariat International En Entreprise (V.I.E.) Is a Unique Opportunity For Young Professionals To Gain International Experience While Contributing To Exciting Projects Within a Dynamic Company. As a V.I.E. At Hager Group, You Will

  • Develop your skills in a professional and multicultural environment, with broad technical exposure and direct customer contact.
  • Benefit from structured support, mentorship, career-development opportunities and visibility across the business.
  • Experience life in Ireland while discovering a new culture and building a strong professional network.
  • Enjoy a personalised onboarding programme designed to make your first days smooth.
  • Access learning and development opportunities through Hager’s Hi! University.

Your compensation and core benefits are determined under the Business France V.I.E. framework and include international health insurance. Any additional Hager Ireland stipend or local benefits will be confirmed during the recruitment process.

What are the recruitment stages?

  • Once your CV has been selected, a recruiter will contact you for an initial phone conversation.
  • You will be invited to a first online interview with the hiring manager and the recruiter.
  • You will complete an AssessFirst assessment and have the opportunity to showcase your skills through a business case.
  • A final interview will be organised with the Country Manager and the Early Careers team.

Our success relies on collective energy. Apply now and power up your future with us!

V.I.E. eligibility

Please Note That, To Be Eligible For The V.I.E. Programme, You Must Meet The Applicable Business France Criteria. If In Doubt, Please Check The Business France Website. In Particular

  • You must be between 18 and 28 years old when you apply.
  • You must be a citizen of a Member State of the European Economic Area.
  • You must not be a citizen of the host country, Ireland, unless you hold dual citizenship with another Member State of the European Economic Area.
  • You must comply with the V.I.E. residence, tax, previous-assignment and legal-record requirements applicable to the programme.
  • You must not have previously completed a V.I.E. assignment.

  • Demonstrated practical understanding of data pipelines, ETL/ELT processes, data modeling, data quality, and data governance principles
  • Proven experience working with modern data platforms, including demonstrated experience with Databricks
  • Demonstrated solid understanding of Agile product development, backlog management, prioritization, and product discovery practices
  • Proven experience translating business problems into clear technical requirements and partnering effectively with engineering and data teams
  • Demonstrated solid analytical and problem-solving skills
  • Demonstrated solid communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence technical and business stakeholders

What We Offer

  • Inclusive and supportive team culture
  • Key benefits: private health insurance, wellness programs, matching pension contribution, lunch provided by the company, training opportunities, employee donations matching and others

Location: Dublin

A bit about the job


We’re looking for an experienced and proactive Scrum Master to support delivery within our Corporate Solutions Programme. This strategic initiative focuses on transforming corporate offerings through agile delivery, digital innovation, and operational excellence.


You’ll play a key role in enabling high-performing, cross-functional teams, facilitating effective Agile delivery, removing impediments, and promoting a culture of collaboration and continuous improvement. Working closely with Product Owners, Programme Managers, and key stakeholders, you’ll help ensure delivery remains aligned with programme objectives, priorities, and timelines.

Day-to-day responsibilities

Desirable experience

We’re inclusive and welcome applications from people of all backgrounds and experiences. If you’re excited about this opportunity but don’t meet every requirement, we’d still encourage you to apply.


We also support flexible working arrangements, including part-time working and job shares. We aim to accommodate different locations, hours, and working patterns to suit our customers, our business, and you. Most colleagues work smartly, spending at least 50% of their time in the office each week while enjoying the benefits of flexibility and collaboration.

job.description: Data centres powering modern artificial intelligence workloads currently account for more than 2% of global electricity consumption, a figure projected to rise substantially over the next decade. In hyperscale facilities, around 30% of input electrical energy is lost as heat during power conversion and distribution. To address the power conversion challenges outlined in the UK’s Clean Power 2030, Solid-State Transformers (SSTs) that combine wide-bandgap power semiconductors and high-frequency magnetics offer the power density, efficiency, and bidirectional power-flow control required for AI data centres, megawatt-scale electric vehicle charging, and renewable-rich distribution networks. Research Aims & Scope This PhD project focuses on developing medium-voltage SST cells tailored for hyperscale AI data centres and net-zero grids. You will investigate the core physical challenges of high-frequency power conversion, focusing on designing compact, ultra-efficient magnetic links and mitigating electrical-thermal degradation under repetitive high-dv/dt stresses. Leveraging the supervisory team’s established research in advanced power semiconductors, sensing and gate-driving technologies, your work will combine multi-physics finite-element modelling (ANSYS/COMSOL) with experimental validation in our high-voltage power electronics laboratory, culminating in a scaled hardware prototype demonstrating enhanced efficiency and power density. The Research Environment Dr Jiaqi Yan and Prof. Layi Alatise will supervise the student at the University of Warwick, working within our world-class power electronics facilities. This project offers a unique opportunity to master the intersection of power semiconductors and high-voltage engineering, directly contributing to the UK's capability in next-generation energy infrastructure. Scholarship: The award will cover the UK tuition fee level, plus a tax-free stipend, currently £21,805, paid at the prevailing UKRI rate for 3.5 years of full-time study. International candidates are welcome to apply, but must be able to cover the difference in the fee levels. Eligibility: Essential: - A first-class or strong upper second-class degree (or equivalent) in Electrical/Electronic Engineering, Physics, or a related discipline. - Hands-on experience in power electronic devices/systems or high-voltage setups. Solid theoretical foundation in power electronics, power semiconductor devices, or high-voltage engineering. Desirable: Experience in multi-physics simulation tools (ANSYS, COMSOL), high-speed PCB design, embedded DSP/FPGA control, or other related skills How to apply: Interested candidates should submit a full formal application through https://warwick.ac.uk/fac/sci/eng/postgraduate/funding/jy/ Informal enquiry is also welcome.

job.description:
About Northern Trust

As a global leader in innovative wealth management, asset servicing, asset management and banking services, Northern Trust (Nasdaq: NTRS) is proud to guide the world’s most successful individuals, families, corporations and institutions.

Since 1889, we have aligned our efforts with our three guiding Principles That Endure: Service, Expertise, and Integrity. Together, they reflect the three cornerstones of business conduct which we strive to instill in our employees, whom we call partners, and to provide to our clients and the communities we serve worldwide.

With more than 135 years of financial experience and over 24,000 partners, we serve the world’s most sophisticated clients using leading technology and exceptional service.

Role/ Department

The Business Management Analyst supports the team’s day-to-day business management, governance and reporting activities. This entry-level role offers a graduate or early-career professional the opportunity to develop practical experience across business management, including financial management, sales and business performance.

Working with guidance from experienced colleagues, the Analyst will complete assigned tasks, maintain accurate records and reporting, and follow established processes and controls. Training and ongoing development will support the individual in learning core governance routines, relevant systems and analytical tools, with opportunities to contribute to process improvements as their knowledge develops.

The Key Responsibilities Of The Role Include

  • Support recurring governance activities, including Regional Fee Review, by gathering information, preparing documentation and maintaining records in line with established procedures.
  • Assist with approval workflows by tracking submissions and approvals, following up on outstanding items and escalating missing information, inconsistencies or exceptions to experienced colleagues.
  • Update management information, trackers and recurring reports, checking information for accuracy and completeness.
  • Assist with gathering and organizing data and preparing basic analysis across financial management, sales and business performance.
  • Support partner recognition processes on behalf of executive leadership, including submission, approval tracking and reporting activities
  • Learn to use Microsoft 365 tools, including Microsoft Copilot, to support assigned work and assist with opportunities to simplify routine tasks.
  • Organize and prioritize assigned tasks to meet agreed deadlines, seeking guidance when priorities or requirements are unclear.
  • Work collaboratively with internal partners and provide project and ad hoc support while developing knowledge of the team’s processes, controls and wider business.

Skills & Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Finance, Accounting, Economics or a related discipline preferred, or equivalent relevant experience.
  • No previous financial services experience required; an interest in developing a career in business management and financial services.
  • Good organizational skills, attention to detail and commitment to accuracy.
  • Good numerical, analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Working knowledge of Microsoft Office, particularly Excel, and willingness to learn Microsoft 365 tools and relevant systems.
  • Good written and verbal communication skills and ability to work collaboratively with colleagues.
  • Ability to organize assigned work and meet deadlines, with guidance as needed.
  • Curiosity, willingness to learn and a proactive approach to asking questions, seeking guidance and raising issues.

Work Authorization

Applicants must have the right to work in Ireland at the time of application and for the duration of employment.

Please note that Northern Trust is unable to provide employment permit sponsorship for this role. This includes Critical Skills Employment Permits, General Employment Permits, Intra-Company Transfer Employment Permits, Stamp 1G permissions, and other employment permits under Irish immigration frameworks.

Working with Us

As a Northern Trust partner, you will be part of a flexible and collaborative work culture, which has a strong history of financial strength and stability. Movement within the organization is encouraged, senior leaders are accessible, and you can take pride in working for a company committed to an inclusive workplace and assisting the communities we serve.

Philanthropy is deeply rooted in Northern Trust’s history and is an essential element of our culture. Employees around the world give their time and talent to work for the greater good of their communities.

Reasonable Accommodation

Northern Trust is committed to working with and providing adjustments to individuals with health conditions and disabilities. If you need a reasonable accommodation for any part of the employment process, please email our HR Service Center at MyHRHelp@ntrs.com, or alternatively you can discuss your individual requirements with the recruiter you are working with.

We're hiring a Data Scientist to join Planet's AI team and lead our commercial data science work.   • Churn modelling — Build, deploy, and iterate on customer churn prediction models. Identify leading indicators, segment at-risk cohorts, and work with Customer Success on retention playbooks.

Planet is an equal opportunity employer where diversity is valued, and all employment is decided based on qualifications, merit, and business need.

Come and grow your career in the most exciting, fast paced technology market, with a business that delivers feel-good connected commerce.

We would love to hear from you – Apply now.

About Albany Beck

Albany Beck is a specialist Financial Services Consultancy helping institutions deliver complex change and transformation while building the internal capability to sustain it. We combine subject matter expertise with innovative delivery models that help clients scale efficiently, while offering meaningful, long-term career opportunities to our people. At Albany Beck, you’ll be choosing to work with an organisation that’s passionate about your learning journey and committed to your professional and personal development.


Role Overview

We are seeking an experienced Data Scientist to support the development and implementation of AI-driven solutions, intelligent automation and digital workforce initiatives across the organisation.

The successful candidate will play a key role in translating business challenges into practical AI solutions, supporting the development of LLM-based applications and intelligent digital coworkers, and identifying opportunities to improve business processes through data science, advanced analytics and AI technologies.


Working across enterprise-level AI programmes and business-led initiatives, the Data Scientist will contribute to the design, development, testing and deployment of AI capabilities, helping move solutions from proof of concept into production. The role will also support the development of robust AI governance frameworks, data models and reusable technical capabilities to enable the responsible and scalable adoption of AI.


This is an opportunity to join a growing AI function at an early stage of its maturity, with significant scope to influence the organisation’s AI strategy, technical capabilities and approach to intelligent automation.


Key Responsibilities

AI & Machine Learning Development

  • Design, develop and implement AI and machine learning solutions to address business challenges and improve operational efficiency.
  • Develop LLM-based applications, AI agents and intelligent workflows using technologies such as LangGraph and other relevant large language model frameworks.
  • Support the development of digital coworkers and AI-powered assistants as part of enterprise-wide AI programmes.
  • Build and enhance business-led AI solutions using Microsoft Copilot Studio and associated Microsoft technologies.
  • Develop prototypes and proof-of-concept solutions, evaluating their feasibility, performance and potential business value before production deployment.
  • Support the transition of successful AI use cases into production, including testing, performance monitoring and continuous improvement.


AI Use Case Identification & Delivery

  • Work with business stakeholders to identify, assess and prioritise AI opportunities across functions and processes.
  • Translate business requirements into technical designs, AI models and practical solutions.
  • Evaluate potential use cases based on business value, technical feasibility, implementation complexity, risk and scalability.
  • Support the development of an AI use case pipeline, helping establish a sustainable approach to AI innovation and delivery.
  • Collaborate with process engineering and transformation teams to identify opportunities for intelligent automation and process optimisation.


Data Science, Modelling & Analytics

  • Develop data models, statistical models and predictive analytics solutions to support decision-making and business performance.
  • Explore, prepare and analyse structured and unstructured data to identify patterns, trends and opportunities.
  • Apply appropriate analytical and machine learning techniques to generate actionable insights.
  • Work with data engineering and analytics colleagues to improve data quality, accessibility and suitability for AI applications.
  • Support the integration of data science outputs into reporting, business processes and AI-enabled solutions.


AI Governance, Risk & Responsible AI

  • Contribute to the development and implementation of AI governance frameworks, standards and controls.
  • Support responsible AI practices covering data privacy, security, transparency, explainability and human oversight.
  • Help assess model performance, reliability, bias and operational risks.
  • Establish appropriate testing, validation, monitoring and documentation practices for AI solutions.
  • Work with risk, compliance, technology and business stakeholders to ensure solutions align with relevant organisational policies and regulatory expectations.


Process Transformation & Digital Workforce

  • Identify opportunities to redesign and optimise business processes through AI, automation and advanced analytics.
  • Support the development of digital workforce capabilities that augment employee productivity and improve service delivery.
  • Collaborate with business and technology teams to embed AI solutions into existing workflows and operating models.
  • Measure the effectiveness of AI initiatives against agreed business outcomes, including productivity, quality, efficiency and user adoption.


Essential Skills & Experience

  • Proven experience in a Data Science, Machine Learning, Applied AI or equivalent technical role.
  • Practical experience developing and deploying data science, machine learning or AI solutions.
  • Strong Python programming skills and experience with relevant data science libraries and frameworks.
  • Experience working with LLMs, generative AI, prompt engineering, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), AI agents or comparable technologies.
  • Understanding of agent orchestration frameworks, ideally LangGraph or similar technologies.
  • Experience developing AI prototypes and translating them into reliable, production-ready solutions.
  • Strong analytical, statistical and problem-solving skills.
  • Experience in data preparation, feature engineering, model development and evaluation.
  • Understanding of data modelling, data pipelines and the data foundations required to support AI solutions.
  • Awareness of AI governance, responsible AI, model risk and data privacy considerations.
  • Strong stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts to non-technical audiences.
  • A pragmatic, delivery-focused mindset, with the ability to operate independently in a developing AI environment.


Desirable Skills & Experience

  • Experience with Microsoft Copilot Studio and the Microsoft Power Platform.
  • Experience with Azure AI services, Microsoft Foundry or equivalent enterprise AI platforms.
  • Experience with cloud-based data and AI environments.
  • Knowledge of API integration, software engineering best practices, version control, automated testing and deployment processes.
  • Experience with process mining, intelligent automation or business process re-engineering.

job.description:
About Telnyx

Telnyx is an industry leader that's not just imagining the future of global connectivity—we're building it. From architecting and amplifying the reach of a private, global, multi-cloud IP network, to bringing hyperlocal edge technology right to your fingertips through intuitive APIs, we're shaping a new era of seamless interconnection between people, devices, and applications.

We're driven by a desire to transform and modernize what's antiquated, automate the manual, and solve real-world problems through innovative connectivity solutions. As a testament to our success, we're proud to stand as a financially stable and profitable company. Our robust profitability allows us not only to invest in pioneering technologies but also to foster an environment of continuous learning and growth for our team.

Our collective vision is a world where borderless connectivity fuels limitless innovation. By joining us, you can be part of laying the foundations for this interconnected future. We're currently seeking passionate individuals who are excited about the opportunity to contribute to an industry-shaping company while growing their own skills and careers.

The Role

As a Machine Learning Engineer on the Messaging team, you will own the systems that decide — in real time — which of the many millions of outbound messages a day reach real people and which get stopped. You'll build and operate fraud and abuse detection for our messaging platform: phishing and smishing, brand impersonation, artificially inflated traffic (AIT), and social-engineering scams targeting real users.

You'll join at an inflection point. We're rebuilding our detection stack on a modern decision-engine architecture — inline hot-path decisioning, a complete decision audit ledger, and entity-level risk state — with active programs in social-engineering, phishing, and brand-impersonation detection.

What You Will Do

  • Design, train, evaluate, and operate text classifiers end-to-end: data curation, labeling, offline evaluation, deployment, and production drift monitoring.
  • Run shadow-mode evaluations against labeled fraud corpora and human-reviewed legitimate controls before any model earns enforcement authority; report precision, recall, and calibration per abuse archetype.
  • Build detection that holds up against adversarial content: obfuscated and confusable brand text, URL and domain evasion, and cross-account template fingerprinting.
  • Serve detection models inline on the message send path under strict latency budgets, with deliberate fail-open/fail-closed behavior per dependency.
  • Power human-in-the-loop fraud review: reviewer tooling, label quality, and turning fraud dispositions into replay and training signals.
  • Collaborate with fraud operations, trust & safety, and cross-functional engineering teams.
  • Participate in code reviews and help raise code quality and standards.

What You Bring

  • 3+ years of software development and/or machine learning experience.
  • Strong proficiency in async Python webservice frameworks (e.g. FastAPI).
  • Production experience building and operating text classification systems in fraud, spam, abuse, or trust & safety.
  • Rigorous evaluation methodology: labeled corpora, holdout sets, precision/recall tradeoffs, and calibration.
  • Experience using LLMs as classifiers or judges within a larger decision pipeline.
  • Experience deploying and maintaining ML models in production.
  • Excellent communication skills and the ability to work effectively with cross-functional teams.

Nice to Have

  • Familiarity with A2P messaging abuse: artificially inflated traffic, smishing, brand impersonation, and 10DLC / toll-free verification regimes.
  • Adversarial ML experience: evasion-resilient detection, obfuscation handling, or attack-surface hardening.
  • High-scale data experience with ClickHouse, PostgreSQL, Redis, and streaming systems such as Kafka.
  • Experience with a cloud-native stack (e.g. Docker, Kubernetes, Prometheus).
  • Experience with distributed batch scoring (e.g. Ray).

We unite caring with discovery to help make life better for people around the world, knowing that every decision, every detail, and every day matters. QA Graduate Programme

Location: Dundurrow, Kinsale

Working Model: Onsite, 5 days per week

Programme Duration: 24 months

Salary: €49,000 to €53,500

Mobility Requirement: Candidates must be open to opportunities at US and OUS sites following completion of the Graduate Programme.

About The Role

We are seeking a recent MSc or PhD graduate in Science, Engineering, or a related discipline to join our Quality Assurance Graduate Programme.

This 24-month programme provides an opportunity to develop practical experience within a regulated manufacturing environment, building strong knowledge of Quality Assurance, GMP requirements, manufacturing processes and quality systems.

As a QA Graduate, you will work closely with manufacturing and cross-functional teams, gaining hands-on experience while helping to ensure that products, processes and systems meet the required quality and regulatory standards.

Key Responsibilities

As Part Of The Programme, You Will

  • Provide Quality direction and governance within your assigned area of responsibility.
  • Support and manage quality-related matters within the manufacturing environment.
  • Review and approve relevant Quality and GMP documentation, ensuring requirements are met.
  • Perform day-to-day activities in compliance with site policies and procedures.
  • Promote safe working practices and promptly report any safety concerns.
  • Support the establishment, maintenance and continual improvement of Quality Systems.
  • Develop a strong understanding of the manufacturing process, including facilities, procedures, people and Quality Systems.
  • Help ensure consistent implementation of Quality standards across assigned areas.
  • Support ongoing GMP compliance and ensure Quality Systems and programmes remain in a validated state and aligned with regulatory commitments.
  • Maintain a regular presence within manufacturing areas to monitor GMP compliance, programmes and systems.
  • Participate in production floor audits and the site self-inspection programme.
  • Verify the effective implementation of key GMP programmes.
  • Review and approve key GMP documents.
  • Escalate critical Quality issues to the appropriate level of Quality management.
  • Communicate and provide guidance to colleagues on GMP requirements and regulations.
  • Support the development and delivery of training associated with assigned Quality Systems and Quality programmes.
  • Provide coaching and support to Operations personnel and other QA colleagues on appropriate risk management and timely, business-focused solutions to compliance issues.
  • Contribute to the site's overall GMP plan and Quality objectives.


Programme Experience

During the programme, graduates will gain broad exposure to Quality Assurance activities.

Unless business requirements mean the graduate is assigned to a specific support area, such as Vendor Management, CSQA, Material Management, Supply Chain or Maintenance, graduates should complete a minimum of six months in an online Manufacturing QA role.

Experience May Include

  • Assessing the potential impact of deviations on product quality.
  • Reviewing and approving change controls, deviations and failure investigations.
  • Reviewing suspect analytical results, product quality complaints, stability studies and associated reports.
  • Reviewing documentation associated with manufactured batches.
  • Reviewing and approving GMP documentation associated with qualification and validation.
  • Reviewing raw material specifications, sampling protocols, master formulas and process flow documentation.
  • Working directly with manufacturing teams to provide Quality oversight and support effective decision-making.


Candidate Profile

To Be Considered For This Programme, You Should Have

  • A recent MSc or PhD in Science, Engineering or a related discipline.
  • Strong learning agility, curiosity and a willingness to develop within a regulated manufacturing environment.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Strong organisational, prioritisation and self-management skills.
  • An ability to identify problems, assess risk and contribute to practical solutions.
  • A collaborative approach and the ability to build effective relationships across different teams and functions.
  • Confidence in positively influencing others and contributing to effective team decision-making.
  • Flexibility and the ability to work effectively in an environment where priorities can change.


Additional Skills Or Experience

Experience or knowledge in one or more of the following would be advantageous:

  • Chemical, peptide or protein synthesis.
  • Development or implementation of digital solutions.
  • GMP or regulated manufacturing environments.
  • Quality Systems or Quality Assurance.
  • Innovative problem-solving and solution development.


What Success Looks Like

By the end of the 24-month Graduate Programme, you should be able to:

  • Demonstrate a high level of proficiency within your area of responsibility.
  • Perform key Quality activities independently.
  • Make sound Quality decisions aligned with business standards, GMP requirements and regulatory expectations.
  • Effectively monitor GMP compliance, programmes and Quality Systems.
  • Clearly communicate and educate colleagues on GMP requirements and regulations.
  • Provide confident Quality oversight and support within a manufacturing environment.
  • Apply appropriate risk-management principles when addressing Quality and compliance issues.
  • Be ready to support business needs and potential opportunities at US or OUS sites following completion of the programme.


Key Attributes for Success

Business Awareness

Takes ownership of work, delivers to a high standard and proactively looks for better and simpler ways of working. Demonstrates strong organisation, prioritisation and self-management.

Learning Agility And Curiosity

Diversity - Innovation - Caring - Global Collaboration - Winning Spirit - High Performance

At Boston Scientific, we’ll give you the opportunity to harness all that’s within you by working in teams of diverse and high-performing employees, tackling some of the most important health industry challenges. With access to the latest tools, information and training, we’ll help you in advancing your skills and career. Here, you’ll be supported in progressing – whatever your ambitions.

Advancing possibilities for a brighter tomorrow

Boston Scientific is seeking a highly motivated Graduate Test Engineer on a defined-term (23month) basis to join our Clonmel team.

Job Purpose

Start your career where your ideas, curiosity and technical skills can make a meaningful difference. As a Graduate Engineer at Boston Scientific, you will have the opportunity to learn from experienced colleagues, contribute to innovative medical technologies and build hands-on experience in a collaborative environment.

Boston Scientific Clonmel Manufacture Implantable Medical Devices, in this role the candidate will be responsible for providing manufacturing engineering support and expertise in the testing and failure analysis of a full range of medical devices. Working with a technical team to improve product quality, Test Equipment yields and performance of the electronic manufacturing systems, fixtures and process.

This is an opportunity to apply what you learned during your studies, develop your technical and problem-solving capabilities and gain valuable experience while contributing to technologies designed to improve patients' lives.

Key Responsibilities

  • Working with the Test Engineering team supporting the manufacturing line in the manufacture of implantable medical devices.
  • Work daily with cross functional team in quality, manufacturing engineering and operations, providing improvement feedback and assisting with resolution of quality and manufacturing issues.
  • The ability to perform failure analysis on devices to get to root cause to component level for implantable electronic medical devices.
  • Using knowledge of standard applications, able to work with in-house and external software developers to define and drive improvements and changes to software applications and systems to improve yields.
  • Work with cross functional groups to improve product quality, lean efficiency’s and test system efficiency’s and reduction in production fallout.
  • Performs tests, analyzes data, writes reports and executes validations to medical device standards.
  • Excellent data analysis and technical problem-solving skills, utilizing common applications and in-house component and device tracking systems.
  • Utilizing good documentation skills complete regulatory submissions using change notice process and procedures.

Education & Experience

  • Hons Bachelor Degree (Level 8) in electrical or electronic engineering.
  • Graduated within the past two years or currently in the final year of university.
  • Relevant work experience or completion of a co-op program.
  • Knowledge in electronics with good problem-solving abilities and the ability to project manage issues to closure.
  • Strong understanding of test software applications such as Lab View and C or C++ and experience in validations in the medical device industry would be an advantage.
  • Eligibility to work in Ireland.
  • Strong communication and teamwork skills, with the initiative to contribute in a collaborative environment.
  • Strong systems aptitude and an interest in developing technical skills.
  • Enthusiastic, proactive approach to learning and problem-solving.
  • Interest in medical technology, manufacturing, product development or continuous improvement.

What We Can Offer You

Competitive Benefits – we offer market leading benefits including performance-related bonus, pension contribution, onsite gym, onsite parking, subsidised canteen, organised social groups and healthcare.

A Career with Meaningful Purpose – opportunity to transform the lives of patients worldwide. 

Our Culture - our work is guided by core values that define our culture and empower our employees. 

Career Development – our highly engaged leaders will empower you to grow and will invest in your potential. You can also broaden your skills through personal development courses. 

Opportunity to Innovate – we encourage you to fulfil your true creative potential by speaking up with your ideas and solutions to problems that matter. 

Work-Life Balance – we have created a culture that acknowledges, respects and supports your life and work choices.  

Corporate Social Responsibility – we are dedicated to progressing business practices in areas important to our communities. Our onsite charity events have raised over €1.5 million for worthy causes in the past ten years. 

As a leader in medical science for more than 40 years, we are committed to solving the challenges that matter most – united by a deep caring for human life. Our mission to advance science for life is about transforming lives through innovative medical solutions that improve patient lives, create value for our customers, and support our employees and the communities in which we operate. Now more than ever, we have a responsibility to apply those values to everything we do – as a global business and as a global corporate citizen.

So, choosing a career with Boston Scientific isn’t just business, it’s personal. And if you’re a natural problem-solver with the imagination, determination, and spirit to make a meaningful difference to people worldwide, we encourage you to apply and look forward to connecting with you!

To search and apply for open positions, visit: https://bostonscientific.eightfold.ai/careers

We stand for inclusion, equality, and opportunity for all. By embracing the richness of our unique backgrounds and perspectives, we create a better, more rewarding place for our employees to work and reflect the patients, customers, and communities we serve. This role is based in Letterkenny and will be 2 days on site a week. This role will be 11am - 7pm (some flexibility).

A GLOBAL LEADING ASSET MANAGER WITH A DIVERSE & INCLUSIVE CULTURE

As the Global Asset Management business of Prudential, we’re always looking for ways to improve financial services. We’re passionate about making a meaningful impact - touching the lives of millions and solving financial challenges in an ever-changing world.

We also believe talent is key to achieving our vision and are intentional about building a culture on respect and collaboration. When you join PGIM, you’ll unlock a motivating and impactful career – all while growing your skills and advancing your profession at one of the world’s leading global asset managers!

If you’re not afraid to think differently and challenge the status quo, come and be a part of a dedicated team that’s investing in your future by shaping tomorrow today.

At PGIM, You Can!

What You Will Do

Are you looking for a career that helps you apply your love of data, financial analysis, investments and technology to inform business and system strategy and work with diverse teams on challenging projects? Are you passionate about being a part of an Investment Accounting Business Analysis group that is focused on developing technical and professional skills while collaborating alongside internal business partners and technologists in the asset management and financial management community? If you are results driven, have a real passion for working with financial data, and are deeply analytical, technically adept and highly innovative, then our Prudential Global Services Business Analysis team is the place for you! We provide the technology support that contributes to PGIM being a world-class investment manager through an integrated technology and data strategy.

Our group supports PGIM Investment Accounting Systems through all aspects of the software development life cycle. We work closely with our internal contacts to meet their needs with an increased focus on transformation, automation and improved data/workflow. We look for innovative solutions and continue to add new technology to the mix. Team members work on a variety of projects and support many different systems, applications, programs and processes.

What You Can Expect

  • Identifying solutions to complex business problems by gathering, analyzing, and documenting business and systems requirements to enhance operational performance.
  • Reviewing user and/or Operations requests and conducting data-gathering interviews.
  • Writing business specifications/requirements/rules, redesigning applications/processes, creating mockups, and analyzing user data.
  • Partnering closely with clients and developers to work through the phases of systems development lifecycle (SDLC).
  • Creating test plans to validate that system functionality satisfies associated business requirements.
  • Designing and implementing tests for systems changes. Developing test cases matrices, creating actual test cases, executing tests, reviewing of actual vs. expected results, communicating and resolving issues and documenting results.
  • Interacting with product owners/clients, other business analysts, software developers and testers in the group.
  • Utilizing various technologies which may include (but are not limited to) Jira, Excel, SQL, Visio, Python, Selenium, Oracle, SQL Server, Power BI/Tableau, Cognos, Power Automate, data processing/manipulation, compare tools, automated test tools, and Xceptor.

What You Will Bring

  • Ideally you will have experience in the banking and financial services industry, fund administration, accounting, tax or operations experience in financial services.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Management Information Systems (MIS), Business Analytics and Information Technology (BAIT). Business, Accounting, Computer Science, Finance, Economics, or a related field.
  • Strong analytical and problem solving skills.
  • Strong project management, organization and communication skills.
  • Ability to work with some schedule flexibility to extend overlap and collaboration with U.S. based partners and stakeholders.

What will set you apart?

  • Experience with SQL and related tools (e.g., Microsoft Query, Rapid SQL, DBeaver, etc.) preferred.
  • Knowledge of the Software Development Life-Cycle preferred; experience with Agile methodology is a plus.
  • Experience with Cognos or other reporting platforms is a plus.
  • Experience with business analysis, requirements, software testing or productivity tools (e.g., automated testing tools, compare tools, robotics, data visualization, Python) a plus
  • PGIM welcomes all applicants, even if you don't meet every requirement. If your skills align with the role, we encourage you to apply.

What We Offer You

  • Health Insurance: PGIM Ireland partner with Laya and BUPA to provide health insurance schemes that cover eligible employees day to day medical and hospital expenses.
  • Annual Leave of 23 days at full pay.
  • Pension Scheme: Members of the scheme can contribute up to 8% of salary per annum and PGIM Ireland matches contributions up to 8% of salary. Members can also make voluntary contributions to the scheme.
  • Life Assurance: fully paid by PGIM Ireland, employees are covered from their start date and beneficiaries are provided with a lump sum of four times an employee’s salary.
  • Education Assistance: PGIM Ireland have an Education Assistance Programme that reimburses eligible employees for furthering their education.

About PGIM – Global Asset Management

PGIM is the global asset management business of Prudential Financial, Inc. (NYSE: PRU), a leading global investment manager with nearly US$1.34 trillion in assets under management as of March 31st, 2024. With offices in 18 countries, PGIM’s businesses offer a range of investment solutions for retail and institutional investors around the world across a broad range of asset classes, including public fixed income, private fixed income, fundamental equity, quantitative equity, real estate and alternatives.

With a history dating back 148 years, and experience through more than 30 market cycles, PGIM takes a long-term view, not only in our investment philosophy, but also in how we develop our talent. We want to see our employees excel from their first day with the firm and throughout their tenure with PGIM. We will inspire you, support you, and help you reach your greatest personal and professional aspirations. If PGIM sounds like the place for you, join us. For more information about PGIM, visit PGIM.com.

Prudential Financial, Inc. of the United States is not affiliated with Prudential plc. which is headquartered in the United Kingdom.

Our Commitment to Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion

PGIM has a long-held commitment to advancing diversity, equity and inclusion, rooted in the belief that this is a prerequisite for PGIM's success and sustainability. We work to attract, retain, develop and promote talent at all levels and aim to have a workforce that reflects the communities where we work, live and invest. We are intentional about creating a workplace where everyone has a voice and is welcomed, valued, respected and understood. From the moment people join PGIM, we pledge to help them unlock their full potential. Together, we are shaping a future where talent knows no boundaries.

PGIM Ireland is proud to be an equal opportunity employer and is committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of applicants’ gender, civil status, family status, sexual orientation, religion, age, disability, race or membership of the traveler community. PGIM Ireland's aim is to hire the best people for the open roles and all appointments will be made on merit.

Any offer of employment made by PGIM Ireland will be contingent on receiving satisfactory references. Applicants should be aware that background checks will be carried out on all candidates offered a position within PGIM Ireland.

Job Overview

Join the Machine Learning DevOps team and help ML software teams adopt effective DevOps practices. You will contribute to the infrastructure, automation and services that support software development, including cloud enablement and management of shared physical-device test infrastructure. This is an opportunity to work closely with engineers on technologies that help power the next generation of computing.

Responsibilities

  • Partner with Machine Learning software teams to understand their development and infrastructure needs and support the adoption of DevOps practices.
  • Develop and maintain hybrid (Windows, Linux, MacOs, Android) infrastructure, automation and support services for software engineering workflows.
  • Support multi-cloud enablement activities and board farm management for ML software development and testing.
  • Improve continuous integration and continuous delivery workflows, containerised environments and operational documentation.
  • Investigate infrastructure and tooling issues, communicate findings clearly and contribute to practical solutions with the wider team.
  • Deploy, monitor and troubleshoot a pool of physical devices (Silicon boards and mobile handsets)

Required Skills and Experience

  • Practical experience working with Linux systems and supporting engineering infrastructure.
  • Understanding of DevOps principles and how they support reliable software delivery.
  • Ability to write and maintain automation scripts using Bash, Python or a similar scripting language.
  • Experience with CI/CD or containerisation technologies, such as Docker or Kubernetes, and the ability to collaborate clearly with technical colleagues.

Nice-to-Have Skills and Experience

  • Experience building or maintaining software workflows using CI/CD tools.
  • Interest in computer architecture, compilers or operating systems.
  • Experience with low-level programming or debugging.
  • Contributions to open-source projects or personal technology projects that demonstrate practical learning and problem solving.

In Return

You will work in a collaborative team where your ideas and contributions can make a tangible difference. The role offers the opportunity to develop your DevOps expertise while working with Machine Learning software teams on infrastructure and tooling that support future computing technologies. You will have scope to learn, share knowledge and help improve the ways teams build, test and deliver software.

Additional Information

Please note this role does not meet the eligibility requirements for sponsorship, and therefore the successful candidate must have the right to work in the UK without relying on sponsorship by Arm.

Our 10x Mindset

At Arm, we believe progress happens when people are empowered to think bigger and push beyond what seems possible. Our 10x mindset is about curiosity, ambition and creating impact that will be used by millions. We learn fast, prioritise collaboration and turn bold ideas into real technology. We look for people who are inspired by this way of working and want to grow in an environment where bold ideas are welcomed. Discover how the 10x mindset shapes life at Arm: https://careers.arm.com/10x-mindset

Use of AI in Your Application

At Arm, we embrace the benefits AI can bring, including in recruitment. You may use AI to support your preparation, such as improving the clarity of written responses, practicing interview questions, or learning more about our industry. However, your application and interview responses must reflect your own thinking, experience, and abilities. We want to understand your authentic perspective, creativity, and approach to problem solving. As such, you may not use AI to complete assigned tasks as part of any assessments. If you plan to use AI-supported or assistive technologies as part of a reasonable adjustment, please contact accommodations@arm.com so we can support you.

Recruitment Adjustments and Accommodations

At Arm, we want to build extraordinary teams. If you need an adjustment or an accommodation during the recruitment process, please email accommodations@arm.com . To note, by sending us the requested information, you consent to its use by Arm to arrange for appropriate accommodations. All accommodation or adjustment requests will be treated with confidentiality, and information concerning these requests will only be disclosed as necessary to provide the accommodation. Although this is not an exhaustive list, examples of support include breaks between interviews, having documents read aloud, or office accessibility. Please email us about anything we can do to accommodate you during the recruitment process.

Hybrid Working

Arm’s approach to hybrid working is designed to create a working environment that supports both high performance and personal wellbeing. We believe in bringing people together face to face to enable us to work at pace, whilst recognizing the value of flexibility. Within that framework, we empower groups/teams to determine their own hybrid working patterns, depending on the work and the team’s needs. Details of what this means for each role will be shared upon application. In some cases, the flexibility we can offer is limited by local legal, regulatory, tax, or other considerations, and where this is the case, we will collaborate with you to find the best solution. Please talk to us to find out more about what this could look like for you.

Equal Opportunities

Arm is an equal opportunity employer, committed to providing an environment of mutual respect where equal opportunities are available to all applicants and colleagues. We are a diverse organization of dedicated and innovative individuals, and don’t discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or status as a protected veteran.

Description

Amazon Security operates at a scale few engineers ever get to work at. Epoxy is the team that builds the automation making that coverage possible. We are looking for a Software Development Engineer to support the building and operating of the platforms that onboard threat detection, remediate security risk, and accelerate security response across every AWS account.

AWS Security, Epoxy builds a collection of automation platforms for AWS Security. We enable threat detection across a large fleet of AWS accounts (onboarding coverage, auditing it continuously, and making findings available to partner teams), we help partner teams remediate detected risks and respond to incidents automatically at scale, and we run the foundational services (communications, workflow orchestration, data enrichment, and secure access) that the rest of AWS Security][ operations relies on. Our systems operate at very high scale and carry a high operational bar: you build it, you run it.

You are a Software Development Engineer who enjoys taking a difficult, loosely specified problem and turning it into a well designed, thoroughly tested, and cleanly operated system. You care about the quality of what you ship and about leaving the systems you touch better than you found them. Experience in security is a plus, but it is not a requirement: what matters most is that you build robust, maintainable, high quality software using modern practices and technologies such as AWS services, Python, and TypeScript, and that you take ownership of the operational health of what you deliver.

Key job responsibilities

  • Design and deliver features and components that solve difficult problems across AWS Security Epoxy's services, working independently from a well understood business goal even when the implementation is not fully specified.
  • Own the operational excellence of the systems you work on: instrument them, alarm on the right signals, and drive down operational load through automation rather than manual toil.
  • Write high quality, well tested code that meets a high engineering bar, and clear documentation and runbooks that let others maintain and extend your work.
  • Participate in the team on-call rotation, supporting our services and responding to high-severity requests from AWS Security operations and Partner Teams. You resolve issues, then eliminate their contributing causes with permanent fixes.
  • Improve the resiliency, scalability, and safety of systems that operate at very high scale, making sound trade-offs between short-term needs and long-term maintainability.
  • Raise the bar through code reviews, design reviews, operational readiness reviews, and post-incident analyses, giving useful and actionable feedback including to more senior engineers.
  • Mentor newer teammates and interns, and begin to influence partner teams by helping them adopt sound engineering and operational practices.

A day in the life

You pick up a feature request on one of Epoxy's services, break it into deliverable pieces, and ship it incrementally with tests and monitoring in place.

You review a teammate's design, ask the questions that surface a hidden resiliency risk, and help simplify the approach before code is written.

On an on-call week, you triage a high-severity issue, mitigate customer impact quickly, then open the follow-up work to make sure that class of failure cannot recur.

You spot a piece of manual operational work your team repeats every week and replace it with automation, giving the whole team time back.

You sync with a partner detection or response team to understand how they use an Epoxy capability, and feed what you learn back into the roadmap.

About The Team

Diverse Experiences

Amazon Security values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn't followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don't let it stop you from applying.

Why Amazon Security?

At Amazon, security is central to maintaining customer trust and delivering delightful customer experiences. Our organization is responsible for creating and maintaining a high bar for security across all of Amazon's products and services. We offer talented security professionals the chance to accelerate their careers with opportunities to build experience in a wide variety of areas including cloud, devices, retail, entertainment, healthcare, operations, and physical stores.

Inclusive Team Culture

In Amazon Security, it's in our nature to learn and be curious. Ongoing DEI events and learning experiences inspire us to continue learning and to embrace our uniqueness. Addressing the toughest security challenges requires that we seek out and celebrate a diversity of ideas, perspectives, and voices.

Training & Career Growth

We're continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth's Best Employer. That's why you'll find endless knowledge-sharing, training, and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Work/Life Balance

We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there's nothing we can't achieve.

Basic Qualifications

  • Experience (non-internship) in professional software development
  • Experience designing or architecting (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems
  • Experience programming with at least one modern language such as Java, C++, or C# including object-oriented design
  • This role requires you to be a national of an EU Member state.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent
  • Experience with full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations

Amazon is an equal opportunities employer. We believe passionately that employing a diverse workforce is central to our success. We make recruiting decisions based on your experience and skills. We value your passion to discover, invent, simplify and build. Protecting your privacy and the security of your data is a longstanding top priority for Amazon. Please consult our Privacy Notice (https://www.amazon.jobs/en/privacy_page) to know more about how we collect, use and transfer the personal data of our candidates.

Amazon is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of protected veteran status, disability, or other legally protected status.

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

Minimum 2 years of experience in CAD design + drafting (using Siemens NX or similar) and FE analysis (using Hypermesh or similar). Good understanding of machine design and different manufacturing processes (e.g. machining, welding, etc), design for manufacturing and GD&T. Familiarity with standard margin calculation methodologies for various applications like beams, bolted joints, welds, etc. Experience with design of test setups/jigs/fixtures and planning/execution of mechanical tests in-house would be a plus. Good at documentation including design descriptions, assembly instructions, test reports, etc. Creative with innovative ideas and technical problem solving/troubleshooting skills. Basic hands-on experience with mechanical assembly and simple machining tools like drilling machine. Previous experience in space AIT and MGSE design would be highly appreciated. Good English communication skills (German would be a plus). Why you should join us! job.description: We are an applied AI lab building end to end recruiting agents that feel like coworkers. We help organizations hire with radically more speed and precision, automating toil and augmenting humans for teams across fast-growing tech companies. Founded by operators who've scaled major tech companies before, we've raised significant funding from top tier investors. We are growing fast, our customers are raving fans of the product, and our story has been covered by major business and tech publications. Now is the time to re-engineer how work gets done with AI at the core, and our toughest challenges still lie ahead. We are looking for people seeking the hardest, most fulfilling work of their lives. We have one value: velocity. Not motion for its own sake, but real progress. We ship every day, ship on Fridays, and skip the tickets, roadmaps, and design-doc theater. We barely write code by hand anymore: every engineer orchestrates a stack of agents, and we ship many times what we did a year ago with the same small team. Process stays light, standards stay high, and feedback loops stay short. What You'll Build Day to day, you'll work on: new product experiences across the hiring workflow systems that turn conversational signal into structured actions and insights AI-assisted features that need to feel useful, transparent, and well-integrated into the product improvements to quality, speed, and reliability across both user-facing and agent-facing parts of the product product problems that cut across engineering, design, product, and go-to-market context What You'll Own In your first 3-6 months, you should: own and ship meaningful product areas from problem definition through rollout help shape how our AI products behave in real customer workflows identify and drive improvements that make the product faster, clearer, and more valuable contribute to the engineering bar across craft, execution, and product judgment What We're After We're hiring across all levels, but we are excited by people who: have shipped product in fast-moving software environments are comfortable working across the stack, or moving outside their default lane when needed care deeply about users and can translate messy problems into clear product decisions combine technical strength with product sense and good judgment like ownership, ambiguity, and close collaboration across functions want to help build a category-defining product while the shape of the company is still being formed What You Want To Know A small, sharp, in-person team based in a major European city. Best ideas win on merit, not ceremony. We pay in the top 10% of the market salary and meaningful equity. We operate with simplified leveling: early-career, mid-career, and staff and above. Your level sets your comp. No back-and-forth, no games. We track the market closely and adjust when it tells us to. Market refreshers, twice a year. We re-benchmark against the market two times a year and move comp up when it drifts — so "top 10%" stays true, not just true on your start date. Promotions and raises on a real cycle. We review level and scope roughly every six months. When your responsibilities grow, your comp follows. Equity that's genuinely competitive. World-class equity option grants so we're all owners. We keep the structure simple: cash and equity. Visa sponsorship and immigration support. We sponsor work visas and handle the process with you, start to finish. Time off, unlimited. You should feel empowered to take as much time off as you need.
