job.description:
Company Description

PartnerRe is a leading, privately owned, multi-line global reinsurer with a reputation of financial stability and strength, and a commitment to rebuilding businesses and communities after risk events around the world.

Our mission is to continue to be a financially stable and predictable business partner, supporting our clients with solutions tailored to their needs, delivering superior returns to our owner, providing rewarding opportunities for our people and making a positive contribution to society. To achieve this, we live by our values of Integrity, Performance, Collaboration, Straightforward Communication and Respect and Care.

Core to The PartnerRe Experience is our global nature. No matter where you sit in the company, you are part of something bigger. Our teams represent our truly international mindset, forging connections across office locations and all levels of the organization and building a network of mutual success. The result is a day-to-day experience that will allow you to:

Shape your own career

Grow in a supportive environment

Connect with a community of experts

Make an impact

View Home - PartnerRe Experience e-book to find out more about what it’s like to work at PartnerRe.

We are always looking for bright, proactive individuals to join our team!

Please follow our Careers page for all updates on new positions. We look forward to receiving your application.

PartnerRe is an equal opportunities employer.

Please join our company LinkedIn Page for all updates on new positions that are coming live.

Compensation

The salary range for this role is CAD 108,045 -132,055 per year.

Job Summary

We are looking for a dynamic solution-oriented Scrum Master to join our Group Information Technology Department. This person will be reporting to the Head of PMO, and will be based in either our Dublin or Toronto PartnerRe Office.

Your main mission is to successfully manage a range of IT projects from initiation to completion, that delivers capabilities inline with our corporate strategy and IT transformation goals. Projects will be varied, and include technology innovation and transformation, for example AI, Automation, Cloud, etc.

About The Role

  • Support the Agile adoption within the organization by helping the team to understand the theories and practices, as well as rules and values of Scrum, Kanban and agile methods
  • Ensure roadmaps, backlogs, and stories are following agile best practices
  • Facilitate scrum ceremonies - Sprint Planning, Daily Scrum, Sprint Review, and Sprint Retrospective.
  • Ensure roadmaps, backlogs, and stories are following agile best practices.
  • Coach, mentor and support an agile mindset and values.
  • In addition to your activity as a Scrum Master, you will take responsibility for the definition, documentation and execution of small to medium scale projects, engaging with stakeholders and actively participating in all phases of the project. Identifying, assessing and managing risks and issues which could affect the success of the project.
  • Prepare and maintain realistic project schedules and quality plans, and track all activities against them, providing regular and accurate reports to stakeholders, as appropriate.
  • Monitor costs, timescales and resources used, and take action where these deviate from agreed tolerances.
  • Provide effective leadership to the project team ensuring that team members are motivated. Actively engage in discussions and decisions, and contribute to the project deliverables.
  • Ensure that projects are formally closed and, where appropriate, subsequently reviewed, and that lessons learned are captured.

Qualifications

You bring at least 5 years of project management and IT experience and you possess the following skills and background:

  • Track record in delivering successful IT projects of various sizes and complexities ideally across multiple IT domains.
  • Agile certification (Scrum Master, PMP-ACP etc.) is a must.
  • Strong technology background, ideally experienced with technology innovation and cloud.
  • Knowledge/experience with both waterfall and agile methodology.
  • Excellent verbal and written English skills, knowledge in French and German are a plus.
  • Preferably knowledge/experience in the insurance or reinsurance industry.
  • Strong stakeholder management, negotiation and communication skills. Able to explain complex solutions to a non-technical audience.
  • Able to work on multiple and conflicting priorities (be a fast context switcher) in an interdisciplinary, collaborative and multi-cultural environment.
  • Dedicated problem solver with a positive personality and can-do attitude.

Additional Information

:

PartnerRe provides a working environment in which diversity is valued, where all employees feel welcome, respected, and empowered to perform at their best. We invite you to learn more about D&I at PartnerRe.

Thank you,

PartnerRe Hiring Team

job.description: About us Rivan Industries is a synthetic fuel company decarbonising heavy industry. We’re making synthetic fuel cheaper than fossil fuels, sustaining life on earth by keeping the CO2 locked underground. Engineering at Rivan is about taking technologies that are conventionally treated as low volume, bespoke, and expensive, and rethinking them completely to be mass manufactured, standardised, and ultra low cost. Every design aspect must be re-reasoned from first principles, every part’s existence questioned, and every manufacturing step scrutinised. We’re looking for a talented Mechanical Engineer to accelerate the mechanical design of our methanation reactor sub-system, tasked with uncovering new ways of thinking about our system integration, performance, longevity, and manufacturability, all in the name of producing the world’s cheapest green synthetic gas. If you thrive on a lot of responsibility and tight deadlines, come and build! The role Own the design and manufacture of an entire Rivan sub-system. We practice our culture, everyone at Rivan has direct ownership of part of our system, regardless of seniority. We operate with minimal process and bureaucracy, only what is essential to ensure our systems are safe, legally compliant, and deployed on time, everything else is up to you. We expect you to: Own the concept generation, architecting and technical requirements capture Design test-rigs to validate underlying hypothesis quickly and effectively Own and iterate the design drawings with our inhouse manufacturing team Own the assembly, integration, commissioning and test plans of the methanation reactor sub-system Liaise with external vendors to support our production line Essential skills 1-2+ years professional experience Bachelor’s or Masters in mechanical/aero or related field System design experience including CAD (SolidWorks), design for manufacture/assembly, and part specification and procurement Hands on workshop fabrication and build experience Additional skills Fundamental thermofluids understanding, including pressure loss, heat and mass transfer Simulation/analytical modelling competency (e.g. python, FEA, CFD) Test setup design, running of experiments, and data analysis Specifics £40 - 50k Salary depending on experience Significant share options as part of the early team In-person work at our HQ in Bermondsey, South-East London Extensive relocation support, including £6000 per year extra to live close to our HQ Private health insurance Visa sponsorship available Unlimited time-off We encourage exceptional applicants from all backgrounds to apply for this role, even if they do not meet all the requirements listed. If you don't see a current role that fits, we also welcome open applications via our website. Apply at Rivan.com

Build the next-generation in-memory database services!

AWS ElastiCache, a fully-managed in-memory data store compatible with Valkey, Redis OSS, and Memcached, enables customers to build data-intensive apps or boost existing database performance by retrieving data from high throughput and low latency in-memory data stores.

AWS MemoryDB, a Valkey and Redis OSS compatible, durable, in-memory database service, delivers ultra-fast performance for modern, micro services applications.

job.description:
Description

Junior Data Engineer

About Designer Group

Designer Group is a leading international mechanical & electrical provider specialising in turnkey packages for the design, supply, and installation of M&E services. Headquartered in Dublin, we work with some of the world's largest multinational companies, and our common purpose is delivering ambitious, innovative and sustainable engineering solutions, building client partnerships that bear testament to the standards we uphold.

Our people are the foundation of our continued growth across all client sectors. We invest in our people and have a philosophy of continuous professional development. This investment has produced an innovative and passionate team that delivers projects for our clients safely, efficiently and to the highest standards in the industry.

Our approach to everything we do is underpinned by our Values of:

  • Safe
  • Trust
  • Respect
  • Challenge
  • Deliver

Role Purpose

Designer Group is seeking a Junior Data Engineer to join our Technology team. This is an excellent opportunity for a graduate or early-career professional to develop their skills within a growing data and digital function.

Working closely with the Data Engineering Lead and stakeholders across the business, the successful candidate will support the development and optimisation of Designer Group's data platform, helping transform business requirements into reliable data products. The role will involve data engineering, reporting, data quality improvement, and business intelligence development using Microsoft Fabric and Power BI.

Key Responsibilities

Business Engagement & Requirements Gathering

  • Collaborate with stakeholders across Finance, Commercial, Operations, HR, BIM and Project teams to understand reporting and analytics requirements.
  • Assist in translating business requirements into clear data and reporting specifications.
  • Support prioritisation of reporting and data requests.
  • Provide guidance and support to users adopting dashboards and self-service reporting solutions.
  • Maintain regular communication with stakeholders regarding progress and delivery timelines.

Data Quality & Governance

  • Analyse source data to identify inconsistencies, errors, duplicates and data quality issues.
  • Support root-cause analysis and recommend improvements to business processes and system configurations.
  • Implement data quality validation checks within data pipelines and reporting solutions.
  • Support the maintenance of data definitions, business glossaries and related documentation.
  • Contribute to data governance and continuous improvement initiatives.

Data Engineering

  • Develop and maintain data pipelines within Microsoft Fabric.
  • Support the design and maintenance of data lakehouse and warehouse solutions.
  • Write and maintain SQL and Python/PySpark code for data ingestion and transformation.
  • Follow established standards relating to testing, documentation, security, version control and deployment.
  • Participate in peer reviews and code review processes.

Platform Monitoring & Support

  • Monitor pipeline execution, scheduled refreshes and platform performance.
  • Investigate, troubleshoot and resolve issues or escalate where appropriate.
  • Create and maintain operational documentation and runbooks.
  • Assist with monitoring Microsoft Fabric capacity utilisation and workload performance.
  • Maintain alerts and monitoring processes for data platform operations.

Power BI Development & Reporting

  • Design, develop and enhance Power BI reports, dashboards and semantic models.
  • Develop DAX measures and apply best-practice data modelling techniques.
  • Manage report publication, workspace administration, refresh schedules and security controls.
  • Gather user feedback to improve reporting solutions and user experience.
  • Maintain the report catalogue and support the full report lifecycle from request through to retirement.

Team Collaboration

  • Work collaboratively with Technology, IT, Enterprise Applications and BIM teams.
  • Ensure compliance with GDPR, Information Security and AI governance requirements.
  • Actively participate in training, mentoring and continuous professional development opportunities.

Essential

Skills, Knowledge & Experience

  • Third-level qualification in Computer Science, Data Analytics, Information Systems, Engineering, Mathematics or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience.
  • Experience using Power BI, including data modelling, DAX, Power Query, dashboard and report development.
  • Good working knowledge of SQL.
  • Working knowledge of Python, including experience with PySpark.
  • Understanding of ETL/ELT processes and data engineering principles.
  • Understanding of data quality management and data modelling concepts.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder engagement abilities.
  • Strong attention to detail and a structured, methodical approach to work.

Desirable

  • Experience with Microsoft Fabric including Lakehouse, Warehouse, Notebooks and Fabric Pipelines.
  • Experience with Azure Data Factory, Synapse Analytics or Databricks.
  • Microsoft certifications such as PL-300, DP-600 or DP-700.
  • Familiarity with Git, Azure DevOps or similar version control tools.
  • Experience working with ERP, CRM, HR or Project Management systems.
  • Understanding of data governance, data catalogues and modern data management practices.
  • Experience within construction, engineering, infrastructure or project-based organisations.

Personal Attributes

  • Curious and motivated to understand business processes and how data can drive better decision-making.
  • Collaborative and approachable, with the ability to build strong working relationships.
  • Demonstrates ownership, accountability and a proactive attitude.
  • Strong organisational and time management skills.
  • Eager to learn and develop professionally.
  • Positive, adaptable and solution-focused mindset.

Qualifications

Essential

  • Degree in Computer Science, Data Analytics, Information Systems, Engineering, Mathematics or a related discipline.

Desirable

  • Microsoft Certified: Power BI Data Analyst Associate (PL-300).
  • Microsoft Certified: Fabric Analytics Engineer Associate (DP-600).
  • Microsoft Certified: Data Engineering on Microsoft Fabric (DP-700).

Why Join Designer Group?

  • Join a leading international engineering contractor delivering complex projects across multiple sectors.
  • Gain hands-on experience with Microsoft Fabric, Power BI and modern cloud-based data platforms.
  • Receive mentoring and support from experienced data professionals.
  • Be part of a growing Technology team driving digital transformation across the organisation.
  • Access continuous professional development and career progression opportunities within a dynamic and expanding business.

KTP Associate: Data Product Analyst

We are seeking a Marketing Research & Data Analyst with experience in data analysis, AI-driven search analytics, and content strategy to join Flixmedia Ltd as a KTP Associate, based at its London office.

About The Role

This is an exciting opportunity to accelerate your career through a Knowledge Transfer Partnership (KTP), working at the interface of industry and academia with Flixmedia Ltd and The School of Management at the University of Bath.

As the KTP Associate, you will lead this innovative project to develop an advanced decisioning GEO content optimisation platform that transforms shopper behaviour data into actionable insights. The project will create new data science capabilities that enable global brands and retailers to measure, test and optimise GEO performance and digital content driving improved engagement and conversion outcomes.

You will be embedded within Flixmedia, working closely with company stakeholders while receiving academic support and mentorship from experts at the University of Bath. As project lead, you will take ownership of project delivery, manage key stakeholder relationships and drive the successful implementation of project objectives.

This role offers a unique opportunity to apply cutting-edge research in a commercial setting while gaining valuable experience in leadership, project management and innovation.

About Flixmedia Ltd

Flixmedia Ltd is a leading retail technology company that helps global brands and retailers create, optimise and distribute digital product content that improves online shopper experiences and drives sales. Flixmedia was recently named by the Sunday Times as one of the Best Places to Work, while also being recognised as a UK-certified Great Place to Work.

Benefits Of Being a KTP Associate

In addition to the salary, KTP Associates benefit from:

  • £3,000 dedicated personal development budget
  • 10% of working time allocated to professional development
  • Two residential training programmes focused on leadership and project management
  • Mentoring and support from both Flixmedia and the University of Bath
  • Access to extensive academic and industry resources
  • Travel and subsistence budget for project-related activities
  • Mentoring opportunities through Innovate UK Business Connect
  • Potential opportunity to secure a permanent role following successful project completion

About You

The ideal candidate will have:

  • A PhD in Marketing with strong quantitative components or a related discipline (including candidates currently in postdoctoral research roles). Alternatively, a relevant Master’s degree combined with three or more years’ experience in quantitative marketing research, analytics or data-driven product innovation
  • Experience in data analytics, ideally within marketing, e-commerce or digital content environments, alongside familiarity with cloud platforms, data visualisation, UX principles and digital content management workflows
  • Strong quantitative research methods skills relevant to marketing, such as experimentation, causal inference, econometrics, and machine learning
  • Technical skills, including proficiency in R or Python, SQL (preferably BigQuery), and experience with API-enabled digital systems
  • Ability to translate analytical findings into actionable commercial recommendations
  • Familiarity with Generative Engine Optimisation (GEO) concepts and objectives
  • Ability to translate business problems into research questions, review and synthesise academic literature, develop rigorous empirical research designs, and interpret findings with appropriate consideration of identification, robustness and limitations
  • Experience contributing to academic research outputs, such as peer-reviewed publications, working papers or conference presentations.
  • Strong communication, project management and stakeholder engagement skills, with the ability to work independently, collaborate across academic and commercial teams, and manage complex projects

As a KTP Associate you can enjoy the benefits of being an employee at the University of Bath whilst working full-time at Flixmedia.

It is essential that you understand how KTP works with business and the University, and the vital role you will play.

Further information

This is a fixed-term role for a period of 18 months.

This is a full-time role, primarily office-based at Flixmedia's London office with the opportunity to work hybrid. Flixmedia offers 24 days of annual leave, plus UK public holidays.

For any questions about this role please email partnerships@bath.ac.uk

We consider ourselves to be a university where difference is celebrated, respected and encouraged. We have an excellent international reputation with staff from over 60 different nations and have made a positive commitment towards gender equity and intersectionality receiving a Silver Athena SWAN award. We truly believe that diversity of experience, perspectives, and backgrounds will lead to a better environment for our employees and students and encourage applications from all genders, backgrounds, and communities, particularly from under-represented groups, and value the positive impact that will have on the university. We are committed to maintaining a safe and secure environment for our students, staff, and community by reinforcing our Safer Recruitment commitment.

We're very proud to be a signatory of the Armed Forces Covenant. an accredited Disability Confident Leader; autism friendly university, committed to building disability confidence and supporting disabled staff.

What we can offer you

Role Overview

The Graduate Health & Safety Consultant & Trainer will join The Food Safety Company (FSC) consultancy team, supporting the delivery of Health & Safety and food safety consultancy, auditing and training services to a diverse portfolio of clients across Ireland.


This is an excellent opportunity for a recent graduate with a recognised qualification in Occupational Health & Safety who is looking to establish a career in professional consultancy.


The successful candidate will initially focus on developing their practical Health & Safety knowledge and consultancy skills, working alongside experienced consultants and receiving structured training, guidance and mentoring from the management team.


Responsibilities will include assisting with Health & Safety audits, workplace inspections, risk assessments, Safety Statements, compliance documentation and the delivery of Health & Safety training as their competence develops.


The role will also provide an opportunity to develop expertise in food safety, HACCP and food safety auditing. Previous food safety experience is not required, as FSC will provide the necessary training and technical support.


The successful candidate will be expected to demonstrate enthusiasm, initiative, a willingness to learn and the ability to develop positive working relationships with clients and colleagues.


Job Requirements

1. Health & Safety Consultancy and Auditing

  • Assist with and progressively undertake Health & Safety audits and workplace inspections.
  • Identify workplace hazards, assess risks and recommend appropriate control measures.
  • Assist in the preparation of audit reports, communicate findings and monitor corrective actions.
  • Support clients in understanding and achieving compliance with relevant Health & Safety legislation.
  • Develop practical knowledge of workplace Health & Safety requirements across different business sectors.
  • Work alongside experienced consultants to develop the technical and practical skills required to manage client assignments independently.


2. Health & Safety Documentation and Implementation

  • Assist in the preparation, review and updating of Safety Statements, risk assessments and associated Health & Safety documentation.
  • Undertake workplace-specific risk assessments, including general workplace, manual handling, fire safety and chemical safety.
  • Support clients with the implementation of effective Health & Safety management systems.
  • Develop an understanding of relevant legislation, codes of practice and HSA guidance.
  • Provide practical advice and guidance to clients within the scope of their qualifications and developing competence.


3. Food Safety Consultancy and HACCP Development

  • Participate in FSC's food safety training and development programme.
  • Develop knowledge of food safety legislation, HACCP principles and food safety management systems.
  • Assist with the preparation, review and implementation of HACCP documentation.
  • Develop the skills required to undertake food safety audits and inspections.
  • Support clients with food safety compliance, hygiene standards and corrective actions.
  • Work towards achieving the technical competence required to deliver food safety consultancy and training services.

Previous food safety experience or qualifications are not essential. Full training and support will be provided by FSC.


4. Training and Development

  • Initially observe and support the delivery of Health & Safety training courses.
  • Develop the knowledge, confidence and presentation skills required to deliver training independently.
  • Progress towards delivering Health & Safety training in accordance with FSC's course content and quality standards.
  • Participate in FSC's food safety training programme and work towards developing food safety training delivery skills.
  • Maintain accurate training records, assessments and certification documentation.
  • Contribute to the development and improvement of training materials where required.


5. Client Relationship Management and Service Delivery

  • Develop professional relationships with clients and colleagues.
  • Attend client sites and support the delivery of consultancy and auditing assignments.
  • Develop an understanding of client operations, requirements and industry-specific risks.
  • Respond to client queries professionally and seek guidance from senior colleagues where necessary.
  • Work collaboratively with the consultancy team to ensure services are delivered to FSC's required standards.
  • Progress towards independently managing assigned client accounts as experience and competence develop.


6. Professional Development and Regulatory Knowledge

  • Take responsibility for ongoing professional development and building technical knowledge.
  • Keep up to date with relevant HSA guidance, legislation, codes of practice and industry developments.
  • Develop knowledge of FSAI guidance, food safety legislation and HACCP requirements.
  • Participate in internal training, technical meetings and knowledge-sharing sessions.

Diversity - Innovation - Caring - Global Collaboration - Winning Spirit - High Performance

At Boston Scientific, we’ll give you the opportunity to harness all that’s within you by working in teams of diverse and high-performing employees, tackling some of the most important health industry challenges. With access to the latest tools, information and training, we’ll help you in advancing your skills and career. Here, you’ll be supported in progressing – whatever your ambitions.

Advancing possibilities for a brighter tomorrow

Boston Scientific is seeking a highly motivated Graduate Deployment Analytics Analyst on a defined-term (23months) basis to join our Clonmel team.

Job Purpose

Start your career where your ideas, curiosity and technical skills can make a meaningful difference. As a Graduate Engineer/Analyst at Boston Scientific, you will have the opportunity to learn from experienced colleagues, contribute to innovative medical technologies and build hands-on experience in a collaborative environment.

Provide deployment intelligence through analytics, reporting automation, readiness insights and AI-enabled decision support.

This is an opportunity to apply what you learned during your studies, develop your technical and problem-solving capabilities and gain valuable experience while contributing to technologies designed to improve patients' lives.

Key Responsibilities

Deployment Analytics

  • Develop deployment readiness dashboards using Power BI or other visualization tools.
  • Analyze deployment metrics and trends.
  • Support executive reporting and the preparation of PowerPoint presentations.

Risk and Readiness Insights

  • Analyze readiness progression.
  • Support the product owner in identifying major deployment challenges and developing technical solutions.
  • Create deployment performance scorecards.

Reporting Automation

  • Develop Power BI dashboards.
  • Create automated reporting processes.
  • Support key performance indicator standardization.
  • Validate AI-generated reports.

Education & Experience

  • Hons Bachelor Degree (Level 8) in engineering or science is essential.
  • Graduated within the past two years or currently in the final year of university.
  • Relevant work experience or completion of a co-op program, ideally within or knowledge of industrial engineering and supply chain analytics.
  • Eligibility to work in Ireland.
  • Strong communication and teamwork skills, with the initiative to contribute in a collaborative environment.
  • Strong systems aptitude and an interest in developing technical skills, interest in information systems.
  • Enthusiastic, proactive approach to learning and problem-solving.
  • Interest in medical technology, manufacturing, product development or continuous improvement.
  • Strong analytics, data science and statistical skills.

What We Can Offer You

Competitive Benefits – we offer market leading benefits including performance-related bonus, pension contribution, onsite gym, onsite parking, subsidised canteen, organised social groups and healthcare.

A Career with Meaningful Purpose – opportunity to transform the lives of patients worldwide. 

Our Culture - our work is guided by core values that define our culture and empower our employees. 

Career Development – our highly engaged leaders will empower you to grow and will invest in your potential. You can also broaden your skills through personal development courses. 

Opportunity to Innovate – we encourage you to fulfil your true creative potential by speaking up with your ideas and solutions to problems that matter. 

Work-Life Balance – we have created a culture that acknowledges, respects and supports your life and work choices.  

Corporate Social Responsibility – we are dedicated to progressing business practices in areas important to our communities. Our onsite charity events have raised over €1.5 million for worthy causes in the past ten years.

So, choosing a career with Boston Scientific isn’t just business, it’s personal. And if you’re a natural problem-solver with the imagination, determination, and spirit to make a meaningful difference to people worldwide, we encourage you to apply and look forward to connecting with you!

Create reliable event and streaming services with safe handling for load, retries, backpressure, and disconnections. job.description:
• Location: Waterford, Ireland
  • Start Date: 1 September 2027
  • Duration: 23 months | Two 8-month rotations, and 7-month
  • Working Model: Fully on-site
  • Working Hours: Full-time
  • Salary: €41,600 gross per annum
  • Assessment Centre: January 2027 | In person, Waterford

Your opportunity at Sanofi

Ready to turn your academic knowledge into real-world experience?

Join Sanofi, a global biopharmaceutical company, through our 23-month Graduate Programme in Waterford. Explore three different functions, gain hands-on industry experience and develop the skills to shape your future career.

As a Manufacturing Science and Technology (MSAT) Graduate, you'll discover how science and innovative technologies help bring life-changing medicines to patients. From introducing new products and improving manufacturing processes to developing analytical methods, you'll gain hands-on experience across three specialist areas that play a vital role in biopharmaceutical manufacturing.

One Programme. Three Rotations. A World Of Experience.

Why explore just one area when you could experience three?

Our structured Graduate Programme takes you through three rotations (two 8-month rotations, and 7-month), providing exposure to different functions, meaningful projects and opportunities to learn from experienced professionals.

Your rotation journey

Rotation 1: Manufacturing Sciences | Months 1–8

Start your journey in the state-of-the-art MSAT laboratory, working alongside the Manufacturing Sciences team and supporting the Lyophilisation Centre of Excellence for the Sanofi network. You'll explore the science behind biopharmaceutical products and learn how laboratory technologies support manufacturing processes.

  • Support new product introductions and technology transfers to Sanofi Waterford and the wider Sanofi network.
  • Gain hands-on experience with small-scale lyophilisers, protein characterisation and solid-state characterisation techniques.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to support manufacturing investigations and deviations.

Rotation 2: Manufacturing Technologies & Industrialisation | Months 9–16

Build on your laboratory experience by exploring how scientific knowledge and technologies are transferred into commercial manufacturing. You'll learn how complex manufacturing processes are introduced, maintained and continuously improved.

  • Support technology transfer projects and the introduction of new products to commercial manufacturing operations.
  • Learn how changes to validated manufacturing processes are managed to improve efficiency and support product lifecycle management.
  • Contribute to manufacturing investigations, deviation resolution and process improvement activities.

Rotation 3: Analytical Sciences | Months 17–23

Complete your graduate journey in the MSAT Analytical Sciences team, working in a state-of-the-art analytical laboratory. You'll develop an understanding of the methods and technologies used to analyse biopharmaceutical products and support their quality.

  • Gain experience in the development, qualification and validation of analytical methods for biopharmaceutical testing.
  • Support analytical method transfers, new technology introduction and cross-functional projects.
  • Contribute to analytical investigations, troubleshooting, method optimisation/automation and innovation initiatives.

Your development focus

Throughout the programme, you'll build the scientific knowledge, technical capabilities and transferable skills needed to develop your career in Manufacturing Science and Technology.

  • Scientific and technical expertise: Develop practical knowledge of lyophilisation, protein characterisation, analytical testing and biopharmaceutical manufacturing processes.
  • Problem-solving and analytical thinking: Strengthen your ability to interpret scientific data, investigate technical challenges and contribute to process improvements.
  • Collaboration and communication: Build confidence in presenting scientific findings, working with cross-functional teams and communicating technical information clearly.
  • Project management and professional development: Develop organisational, influencing and leadership skills through hands-on projects, structured training and practical experience.

Your growth, our commitment

Your development is at the heart of our programme. Here's what you can look forward to:

  • Three diverse rotations: Explore different functions and build a broader understanding of the business.
  • Dedicated cross-functional mentor: Receive guidance from an assigned mentor, with monthly check-ins throughout the programme.
  • A buddy in every rotation: Get practical, day-to-day support as you settle into each new team.
  • Hands-on training: Learn directly from experienced colleagues and develop skills through practical experience and training opportunities.

Who We're Looking For

We're looking for curious, motivated graduates who are eager to learn, collaborate and explore new opportunities.

To Be Eligible, You'll Need To

  • Have graduated within the past two years or be due to graduate before 1 September 2027.
  • Hold a minimum 2.1 primary degree or a Master's degree in Biology, Chemistry, Biochemistry, Biotechnology, Biopharmaceutical Science or a related scientific discipline.
  • Have full, unrestricted right to work in Ireland.

Essential Skills

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with an ability to interpret scientific data and approach technical challenges.
  • A proactive, self-motivated approach, with good organisational skills and the ability to take initiative.
  • Effective communication and teamwork skills, with confidence in sharing findings and collaborating with others.
  • Good working knowledge of Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint.

Desirable Qualifications

  • Exposure to statistical analysis or scientific research through university projects, internships or placements.
  • Familiarity with technical writing, scientific documentation or systems such as Qualipso or Veeva.

Previous experience through internships, placements or relevant work is an advantage, but not essential.

Meet your team

The Manufacturing Science and Technology (MSAT) team plays a key role in supporting Sanofi Waterford and the wider Sanofi network. Bringing together expertise in manufacturing sciences, manufacturing technologies and analytical sciences, the team supports new product introductions, technology transfers, process improvements and technical investigations.

Throughout your rotations, you'll work alongside experienced scientists and technical specialists, gaining an understanding of how these areas collaborate to support reliable manufacturing and the supply of medicines to patients.

About Sanofi

We're an R&D-driven, AI-powered biopharma company committed to improving people's lives and delivering compelling growth. Our deep understanding of the immune system – and innovative pipeline – enables us to invent medicines and vaccines that treat and protect millions of people around the world.

Together, we chase the miracles of science to improve people's lives.

What We Offer

Alongside structured professional development, you'll receive:

  • Annual salary: €41,600 gross per annum
  • Bonus: Performance related bonus 8% (STI)
  • Benefits: Access to an attractive benefits package.

Your recruitment journey

We want you to know what to expect at every step:

  • Apply & complete a short survey: After applying, you'll receive a mandatory screening survey.
  • On-demand video interview: Selected candidates can record their responses at a convenient time within the given deadline.
  • Short connect call: An informal conversation with our recruitment team to discuss your application and confirm a few details.
  • In-person assessment centre: Final assessments are planned for January 2027 at our Waterford site.

Candidates will be assessed at each stage, with Progression to the next step depending on the outcome. Further details will be shared with those progressing.

Ready to start your journey?

You don't need to have your whole career figured out. If you're curious, eager to learn and excited to explore what the pharmaceutical industry has to offer, we'd love to hear from you.

Three rotations. Two years. Your future starts here.

Apply now and start your journey with Sanofi!

job.description:
Who we are

Resonance is an Applied AI company, founded by a team of seasoned operators and engineers from Europe's leading software investor and a leading AI consultancy. Collectively we've shipped 30+ AI products, embedded AI into 50+ businesses and created $250m of value for them.

AI models are improving faster than companies can use them. The models are good enough today. What's missing is building AI into how a company actually works, and that's what we do. We work with ambitious companies to help fundamentally rewire how they work with AI, and accelerate their growth.

Our mission is to help companies reinvent themselves for the AI era and cross the emerging AI productivity gap.

The role

We are looking for graduates to join Resonance as AI Transformation Leads. You will work on client projects from your first month, alongside Senior AI Transformation Leads and AI engineers, doing the analysis and hands-on work that turns a redesigned process into AI running in production.

You'll join our first graduate cohort in London or Berlin.

What you'll do

Support the engagement

  • Work with client managers and operational teams, supporting the Senior AI Transformation Lead who runs the project
  • Map how key processes really run, gather the data and find where AI changes the economics

Build and test

  • Build the analysis behind the business case, and track what each build delivers once it goes live
  • Prototype new workflows yourself with the latest AI tools, working side by side with AI engineers

Grow at pace

  • Coaching from senior transformation leads and the founding team
  • Take on more ownership as you grow, and help shape our company as a key member of our team

Your first year

  • Training: Comprehensive training when you join, covering AI, how we run client projects and the industries we work in
  • Your first project: On a client team from your first month, with a Senior AI Transformation Lead who coaches you
  • Progression: You'll start as a Junior Transformation Lead and typically become a Transformation Lead within 18-24 months

How we work

  • A small team: You'll know everyone by name, founders included, and work closely with people across London and Berlin
  • Questions welcome: Nobody expects you to know it all when you start. Asking for help early is part of the job, and senior people make time for it
  • Low ego, high standards: We set a high bar and help each other reach it. Credit is shared, and mistakes are something we learn from together
  • Time together: Three days a week in the office means you learn by working next to people, not just over video calls

Who you are

Mindset

  • You take the initiative: you start things without being asked and see them through
  • You're obsessed with AI and try new models and tools the day they come out
  • New problems and new domains give you energy, and you like solving them with other people
  • You learn fast and go looking for hard problems

Background

  • You're finishing a degree or have already completed one
  • You likely studied a technical or quantitative subject
  • You can show what you're capable of through your grades, competitions, internships, societies or things you've built
  • You structure complex problems quickly and back your arguments with data

AI fluency

  • You use AI every day and have built something with it: a workflow, an agent or a tool
  • You pick up new tools rapidly and show others how to use them

Working with people

  • You're comfortable working with people at every level, from managers to the operators who do the work
  • You listen well, ask sharp questions and act on feedback quickly

Nice to have

  • An internship in consulting, PE, banking or a high-growth startup
  • German for Berlin roles. English is our working language

How to apply

If this sounds like you, we'd love to hear from you. Send your CV with your grades and a short note on a problem you're proudest of solving and the impact it had.

We hire people from every background and judge them on what they've built. If you don't tick every box above, please don't hesitate to apply. We'd love to chat.

Resonance is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applications regardless of age, disability, gender reassignment, marriage or civil partnership, pregnancy or maternity, race, religion or belief, sex or sexual orientation. If you need adjustments at any stage, tell us and we'll make them.

Why Resonance

  • Work at the AI frontier: We have investment from a leading frontier lab and some of the most influential leaders in the AI ecosystem; you'll be pushed every day to keep pace with the AI platform shift
  • Solve hard problems with real stakes: Your work will drive tangible outcomes for consequential companies and change the way people and companies operate at scale
  • Learn fast: You'll learn alongside operators and engineers who have embedded AI into 50+ businesses
  • Work with the best: Our aim is to build one of the most talent-dense teams in Europe and worldwide; we're seeking out the top 0.1% of operators and engineers to be part of our mission
  • Close Europe's gap: Europe is falling behind on AI. Every build moves another European business to the right side of the productivity gap
  • Build the firm: Join our first graduate cohort and shape how we train, deliver and grow
  • Top of market compensation: We offer exceptional compensation, with a steep career trajectory and exceptional benefits

Location and logistics

  • Location: London or Berlin. Three days a week in the office or on client sites
  • Travel: Expect 25-50% of your time at clients, mostly in the UK and Europe
  • Right to work: We can sponsor visas for eligible candidates
  • Start date: Summer 2027 (dates tbc)
  • Internships: Summer 2027 internships for students in the penultimate year of their degree

job.description:
When travelers are searching for a hotel, we want the obvious choice to be trivago! Our leading metasearch engine is super fast and constantly optimized - enabling millions of travelers to compare hotel prices from hundreds of booking sites and find great deals in just a few clicks. We use cutting-edge technology, real-time auction, and machine learning techniques with petabytes of data to create an experience - time and money saved! In the lively city of Düsseldorf, we seize opportunities to learn everyday, innovate, and make an enduring mark on the travel industry. At trivago you will find those who aren't afraid of change but rather embrace it, turning every challenge into a pathway for growth. Join trivago, work with a great team, and grow with us!

Join us in making a difference


As a Software Engineer in our AI & Productivity Solutions team, you'll turn the everyday needs of colleagues across trivago (we call them talents) into shipped software. We built trivago Copilot, the Help Center smart search and the Business Studio chatbot, and we're now working on Claude automation, the "trivago brain" (our memory layer for AI) and a web app for our MCP and Skills Library. Our team of developers, QA, Product Owners, Project Managers and AI Strategy Managers delivers most of trivago's internal AI productivity tools, in a field that changes weekly. You'll own initiatives end to end, shape the technical approach, and mentor others as we grow. We move fast and hold high standards, and we invest just as much in each other's growth, so no one figures it out alone. If that pace energizes you, apply and help shape how trivago works with AI.

How you’ll make an impact:


  • Independently drive initiatives from prototype to production, building apps, integrations, copilots and chatbots for internal AI and productivity needs.
  • Write clean, tested and maintainable code, and champion best practices and secure development principles across our connectors to SaaS and custom tools.
  • Understand the business value behind every request: talk to talents about their workflows, advise them on technical opportunities, and turn their needs into solutions that matter.
  • Contribute to architecture and technology discussions, evaluating alternative approaches and choosing the best fit for a fast-evolving AI stack together with our Product Owners.
  • Share your work and learnings through Show & Tells, technical documentation and post-mortems, and guide less experienced engineers along the way.
  • Stay close to the AI frontier by keeping up with new models, frameworks and best practices, and bring fresh approaches into the team's work.


What you'll need to thrive:


  • Strong full-stack engineering experience: you build APIs, integrations and data-backed features and ship maintainable software end to end, ideally with C#/.NET, React/TypeScript and Azure or similar cloud services (strong fundamentals in any modern stack carry over).
  • A pragmatic, product-minded approach: you start from the problem, ship the smallest valuable version fast, iterate, and care whether what you built actually made someone's day easier.
  • A collaborative, consultative style: you enjoy working with people across the company to figure out what's worth building, and you stay productive when priorities shift and there's no fixed six-month roadmap.
  • A genuine learning mindset: you approach challenges with curiosity, seek out feedback, and pick up new tools and frameworks quickly.
  • A performance mindset: you set ambitious goals for yourself and have the determination and resilience to follow through, even when the ground moves under you.
  • An open and curious mindset toward AI: you experiment constantly, use AI to deliver real outcomes rather than demos, and apply the right guardrails for data access and privacy.


Not ticking every box? We still want to hear from you. Apply, tell us what motivates you, and you could be a great match—now or in the future. Your application does not need to include a photo.

Recruiting process for this role:


  • Asynchronous video interview
  • Technical interview with coding task
  • Profile Dynamics Assessment interview
  • Product + team fit interview


Want to know more about life at trivago? Check out what our colleagues say on kununu and Glassdoor.

What you can look forward to:

trivago is a place where technical ambition meets genuine investment in your growth — here's what you can look forward to:

Own your stack.


We give engineers real agency over technical decisions. You'll work in small, autonomous teams with direct access to production, where your choices have measurable impact and your input actively shapes how we build.

Stay sharp with dedicated learning opportunities.


Beyond our campus library and free online courses, engineers get access to specialist technical meetups, internal guilds, architecture reviews, certifications, specialist tools, and hands-on experimentation time.

Ship fast, learn faster.


We run a continuous deployment culture with short feedback loops. You'll move from idea to production in days — with the autonomy, tooling, and trust to iterate quickly and own your outcomes end to end.

AI-native engineering environment.

Job Description
We have a number of exciting opportunities across Ireland for graduates to work within our Project Management Teams.

As a Graduate Project Manager at AECOM, you have the opportunity to work on a number of exciting projects across a wide array of sectors. These include education, health care, sports facilities, residential and transport to name but a few, for both public and private sector clients.

Here's what you'll do:
The role of the Project Manager is dynamic and stimulating. As a Graduate Project Manager you will assist other members of the Project Management team to drive projects forward and ensure that our clients achieve the built assets that their business function requires. This involves working at all stages of the project from initial concept right through to construction and operation of the building. The Project Manager is a key interface between the client, design team, consultants, contractors and other project stakeholders.

The Project Manager helps to ensure actions are carried out by the appropriate parties at the right times to ensure deadlines are met and that value is added to the clients projects.

To be effective in the role of a Graduate Project Manager you must have strong communication skills, be good at building relationships and rapport with the various parties involved in a project, be good at planning and managing your time, be highly motivated, and be committed to delivering excellent service to our clients.

Day to day duties include:
  • Regular liaison with all relevant parties,
  • Procurement
  • Liaising/Assisting Senior/Associate Project Managers
  • Contact administration
  • Data management
  • Coordinating the project team
  • Planning key tasks
  • Reporting on progress and cost
  • Site visits and meetings

Here is what you will get from us!
Enjoy the Perks.
At AECOM, you'll enjoy a range of core and personalised benefits designed to support your future and well-being, customised to fit your lifestyle. Take advantage of career development opportunities, our flexible hybrid working model to ensure a work-life balance that suits your lifestyle, technical practice networks, AECOM University, and volunteering days.

National chartership support network
The journey to Chartership is challenging however at AECOM we have a strong support network to help you be successful. Within each office a dedicated coordinator will connect you with a supervisor who will mentor you throughout, whilst our dedicated Chartership Steering Group drives our strategy and maintains close relationships with our accrediting bodies.

Early Careers Training Programme
Our Training programme ADVANCE focuses on providing the necessary tools to navigate your early career with focus on EDI, social value, wellbeing, career development and planning, professional skills, brand awareness and understanding AECOM processes. Delivered in person and online you’ll meet and work with senior leaders during the programme.

We’ll prepare you for your Chartership assessment with interactive presentation skills and case study training days that will develop skills that benefit you now and for times ahead. Underpinning our live and interactive content our bespoke AECOM University resource provides over 30 hours of self-directed learning aligned to your Chartership pathway.

AECOM has been developing professionals for many years and benefits from an engaged Chartership community who support graduates in practicing for their assessment interview with mock interviews; creating assessment conditions for rehearsal and valuable feedback to be obtained

Our monthly CPD programme delivered by internal and external subject matter experts will further enhance your technical understanding and embed a CPD habit that will support your professional development.

Residential
Our Chartership Technical Training Residential; hosted at Aston Conference Centre provides graduates with the opportunity to build both their technical and interpersonal skills to support successful Chartership.

Over three days you will have opportunity to work with other graduates across disciplines laying the foundations of working relationships for the future. Our bespoke EQ workshop will enhance the themes explored in AECOM’s ADVANCE programme and focus on building your self-awareness to support your career aspirations.

Qualifications
Here’s what we’re looking for:
  • Bachelor’s degree (min 2:1 or equivalent) in Project Management, Construction Management, Quantity Surveying or Civil Engineering is essential. SCSI / CIOB / RICS / CABE accreditation preferred.
  • A Master’s degree in Project Management or Construction Management & relevant work experience would be an advantage.
  • Effective decision making and strong verbal and written communication
  • Proactive and driven approach to work and creating success
  • Ability to working in a team of diverse individuals to meet common objectives
  • Buy-in to achieving deadlines set by Clients and Managers
  • Good organisation skills; ability to manage multiple tasks and willingness to ask for help when needed, as well

Additional Information
Applicants are encouraged to apply as early as possible since CVs will be reviewed, and candidates selected on a rolling recruitment basis. Please include a covering letter with your application and provide all predicted and/or obtained academic grades.

You must have permanent right to work in the UK &/or Ireland as we unable to offer visa sponsorship for this position.
At AECOM, we are committed to maintaining a secure and trustworthy recruitment process and take any fraudulent hiring activity seriously. To support this commitment, all newly hired employees are required to attend an in-person Day 1 onboarding at an AECOM office location as a condition of employment.
About AECOM
AECOM is the world’s trusted infrastructure consulting firm, delivering professional services throughout the project lifecycle – from advisory, planning, design and engineering to program and construction management. On projects spanning transportation, buildings, water, new energy and the environment, our public- and private-sector clients trust us to solve their most complex challenges. Our teams are driven by a common purpose to deliver a better world through our unrivaled technical and digital expertise, a culture of equity, diversity and inclusion, and a commitment to environmental, social and governance priorities. AECOM is a Fortune 500 firm and its Professional Services business had revenue of $16.1 billion in fiscal year 2025. See how we are delivering sustainable legacies for generations to come at aecom.com and @AECOM.

Freedom to Grow in a World of Opportunity
You will have the flexibility you need to do your best work with hybrid work options. Whether you’re working from an AECOM office, remote location or at a client site, you will be working in a dynamic environment where your integrity, entrepreneurial spirit and pioneering mindset are championed.

You will help us foster a safe and respectful workplace, where we invite everyone to bring their whole selves to work using their unique talents, backgrounds and expertise to create transformational outcomes for our clients.

AECOM provides a wide array of compensation, benefits and well-being programs to meet the diverse needs of our employees and their families. We’re the world’s trusted global infrastructure firm, and we’re in this together – your growth and success are ours too.

Join us, and you’ll get all the benefits of being a part of a global, publicly traded firm – access to industry-leading technology and thinking and transformational work with big impact and work flexibility. As an Equal Opportunity Employer, we believe in each person’s potential, and we’ll help you reach yours.

We are a Disability Confident Employer and will offer an interview to applicants who have a disability or long-term condition, who meet the minimum/essential criteria for the role. Please let us know using this email address ReasonableAccommodationsUKI@aecom.com if you would like to apply through the Disability Confident Interview Scheme.

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

Description

Do you want to build the software that connects the world's largest enterprises to the AWS cloud? Would you like to own distributed systems that keep a global network running, and use AI to change how that network is operated?

The AWS Direct Connect team delivers solutions that make it easy for customers to establish a dedicated network connection from their premises to the AWS cloud. AWS Direct Connect is available in more than 150 locations across more than 45 countries, and it connects AWS to our largest customers in data centers around the world.

We are building a new software engineering team in Dublin, working side by side with the Direct Connect network engineering team in the same office. You will build and operate the systems that keep Direct Connect customers healthy: data pipelines that analyze network traffic at scale to spot when a customer's traffic is degraded, services that identify which customers are impacted by a network event and keep them informed, and AI agents that automate how engineers handle operational tickets. Your work will help us find and resolve customer issues faster, and free engineers from repetitive operational work.

Key job responsibilities

  • Design, build, and operate services and asynchronous workflows across all AWS regions and Direct Connect locations.
  • Build data processing, monitoring services, and automation that help us detect customer impact during events and resolve it faster.
  • Troubleshoot and root-cause customer-impacting issues, and drive deep dives and corrective actions to completion.
  • Partner with network development engineers to automate repeatable operational work, using AI-assisted development and agent-driven workflows.
  • Write and review design documents, and mentor engineers through design and code reviews.

A day in the life

On a typical day, you might root-cause a customer-reported issue that spans our services and the network, whiteboard a workflow design with a senior engineer, or pair with a network engineer to automate a task they do by hand today. You'll collaborate with software and network engineers in Dublin and the US on system design. On-call rotations give you direct exposure to how your services and the network behave in production at AWS scale. Expect a mix of heads-down building and collaborative design sessions.

About The Team

We prioritize availability and invest heavily in deployment safety and monitoring. As our network is one of the largest in the world, there is no blueprint at our scale, so engineers have the autonomy to drive technical decisions and own the results. We favor automation over manual work, are early adopters of AI in our development and operations, and value clear, peer-reviewed documentation for our technical decisions.

Basic Qualifications

  • Experience (non-internship) in professional software development

Associate Actuary, Reinsurance Operations Analytics

Location: This role is hybrid, based in our Letterkenny office 2 days a week.

Prudential Financial Inc.’s (PFI) Bermuda Reinsurance team is seeking a skilled and highly motivated actuary to fill an Associate Actuary, Reinsurance Operations Analytics role that will be based in Ireland and report to the Director, Reinsurance Operations, supporting the Bermuda-based affiliate reinsurance companies, Gibraltar Reinsurance Company Ltd. (Gibraltar Re) and Lotus Reinsurance Company Ltd. (Lotus Re). The captives reinsure life insurance business originating from Japan and the U.S., providing the role with exposure to cross-border reinsurance operations across multiple markets.

This is a newly created role within the Reinsurance Operations function, offering the opportunity to help shape and develop the actuarial analytical capabilities of the team as the function continues to grow.

This role will be responsible for actuarial analysis and review supporting the companies’ life reinsurance and retrocession operations, with a primary focus on actual business results, reinsurance cash flows and settlements, actual-to-expected analyses, and investigation of material variances and potential issues.

The role will work closely with Actuarial, Finance, and other stakeholders to assess the reasonableness and consistency of results, identify and explain underlying drivers, and deliver actuarial insights that support effective reinsurance operations, financial reporting, and management understanding of the business.

This role is well suited for an actuary who enjoys working with policy-level, settlement, and financial data, investigating results in detail, identifying underlying drivers and potential issues, and translating actuarial analyses into clear insights and appropriate follow-up actions.

Primary Responsibilities

  • Perform actual-to-expected analyses of key policyholder experience and reinsurance cash flows, including Investigation of material variances and emerging trends.
  • Assess the reasonableness of reinsurance settlement amounts, including their consistency with relevant policy, actuarial, and financial information, and investigate significant or unexpected items.
  • Prepare and analyze PHAB roll-forwards, assess the reasonableness of key movements and components, and investigate material or unexpected variances.
  • Review in-force data for reasonableness and consistency with reinsurance settlement data, and investigate material differences as appropriate.
  • Identify potential data, model, assumption, or process issues observed through actuarial analysis and coordinate appropriate investigation and follow-up with relevant stakeholders.
  • Own the production, interpretation, and continuous improvement of recurring actuarial analyses and reporting, and perform ad hoc actuarial analyses to support emerging business needs, issue investigation, and management inquiries.
  • Partner with Valuation and other actuarial teams to understand expected results, assumptions, and model outputs required to interpret actual experience.
  • Work closely with Finance and other stakeholders to communicate findings, resolve identified issues, and determine appropriate follow-up actions.
  • Synthesize analysis into clear insights for management, including prioritization of key drivers, issues, and recommended follow-up actions.
  • Develop and enhance analytical tools and processes using Excel, Microsoft Access, and other technologies, while supporting the design, testing, and implementation of future automation solutions.
  • Maintain appropriate documentation, controls, and review procedures for recurring actuarial analyses and reporting.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in actuarial science, mathematics, statistics, finance, or a related quantitative discipline.
  • Significant progress toward, or completion of, a recognized actuarial qualification.
  • 5+ years of relevant actuarial experience in life insurance, with a strong understanding of actuarial concepts and insurance cash flows.
  • Experience analyzing actual insurance or reinsurance results, including actual-to-expected analysis, investigating material variances, and identifying underlying drivers.
  • Experience working with policy-level or other large insurance datasets, with strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel and the ability to analyze and reconcile data from multiple sources.
  • Ability to communicate actuarial analyses, findings, and potential issues clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Strong attention to detail and ability to manage recurring analytical deliverables while collaborating effectively with Actuarial, Finance, and other stakeholders.

It’d Be a Plus If You Had

  • Experience with life reinsurance and/or retrocession.
  • Experience analyzing Japanese life insurance business.
  • Experience with actuarial modeling software such as PolySystems, and familiarity with the relationship between model assumptions, expected cash flows, and actual results.
  • Experience with VBA, Microsoft Access, Python, SQL, Power Query, or similar analytical and automation technologies.
  • Experience developing, enhancing, or automating recurring actuarial analyses and reporting.
  • Japanese language skills.
  • PGIM welcomes all applicants, even if you don't meet every requirement. If your skills align with the role, we encourage you to apply.

What We Offer You

  • Health Insurance: PGIM Ireland partner with Laya and BUPA to provide health insurance schemes that cover eligible employees day to day medical and hospital expenses.
  • Annual Leave of 23 days at full pay.
  • Pension Scheme: Members of the scheme can contribute up to 8% of salary per annum and PGIM Ireland matches contributions up to 8% of salary. Members can also make voluntary contributions to the scheme.
  • Annual Bonus Programme & Shop LK Vouchers / CleverCards (subject to eligibility): Along with an annual bonus employees are rewarded with Shop LK Vouchers/ CleverCards which are paid tax free.
  • Life Assurance: fully paid by PGIM Ireland, employees are covered from their start date and beneficiaries are provided with a lump sum of four times an employee’s salary.
  • Education Assistance: PGIM Ireland have an Education Assistance Programme that reimburses eligible employees for furthering their education.

Prudential Financial, Inc. (PFI) of the United States is not affiliated in any manner with Prudential plc, incorporated in the United Kingdom, or with Prudential Assurance Company, a subsidiary of M&G plc, incorporated in the United Kingdom.

PGIM Ireland is proud to be an equal opportunity employer and is committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of applicants’ gender, civil status, family status, sexual orientation, religion, age, disability, race or membership of the traveler community. PGIM Ireland's aim is to hire the best people for the open roles and all appointments will be made on merit.

Any offer of employment made by PGIM Ireland will be contingent on receiving satisfactory references. Applicants should be aware that background checks will be carried out on all candidates offered a position within PGIM Ireland.

job.description:
Overview

As a Project Manager (Pre-Construction) at Linesight, you will work with highly experienced, culturally diverse and passionate teams, contributing to the successful delivery of complex construction projects through the pre-construction and design phases.

You will support the coordination and management of project activities, working closely with clients, consultants and wider project teams to monitor progress, coordinate design information and help ensure projects are prepared for successful delivery.

You will gain valuable industry experience, develop your project management capabilities and take increasing responsibility within a collaborative environment. We will empower, support and enable you to develop your skills and progress your career with us.

For us, lasting trusted relationships are everything, both with our teams and our clients.

The Opportunity

In this role you will:

  • Support the coordination and delivery of commercial projects through the pre-construction phase, helping ensure activities are progressed in line with agreed programmes, budgets and quality expectations.
  • Monitor day-to-day design and pre-construction activities, coordinating information flow, tracking progress and highlighting issues or potential delays.
  • Work closely with client teams, design consultants, contractors and other project stakeholders to support effective communication and coordination.
  • Assist with the development and monitoring of project programmes, identifying dependencies, tracking milestones and reporting on progress.
  • Support the preparation and coordination of project handover plans, ensuring relevant documentation and deliverables are completed to the required standards and timescales.
  • Identify potential project risks, issues and constraints, escalating where appropriate and working collaboratively with the wider team to support effective resolution.
  • Assist with the implementation and monitoring of project procedures, processes and reporting requirements, ensuring agreed standards are maintained.
  • Attend and contribute to project meetings, providing updates, tracking actions and supporting the resolution of design and delivery issues.
  • Support the review of proposed variations, programme changes and potential delays, helping assess their impact on project delivery.
  • Build effective working relationships with clients, consultants and project partners, contributing to a collaborative and solutions-focused project environment.


We would love to hear from you if you:

  • Have experience in project management, project coordination or pre-construction within the construction or engineering sector.
  • Have a good understanding of design development, design coordination and pre-construction processes.
  • Hold a degree or equivalent qualification in Project Management, Construction Management, Engineering or a related discipline.
  • Have experience working with multidisciplinary project teams, consultants, contractors and clients.
  • Have an understanding of project programmes, reporting, risk management and project controls.
  • Are working towards, or interested in pursuing, a recognised project management qualification. We can support your development.
  • Are organised, detail-oriented and focused on delivering quality outcomes.
  • Have strong communication and stakeholder engagement skills, both written and verbal.
  • Enjoy working collaboratively, building relationships and contributing to a positive team environment.


All interviews are conducted either in person or virtually with video required.

About Us

Linesight is a highly successful global project and cost management consultancy that keeps clients coming back. And for that we have our people to thank. You see we’re not like the others. We’re different. Unique. It’s our fresh thinking and focus on what matters that has led to our evolving. We are on a journey working in some of the most exciting innovative sectors with some of the world’s most prestigious companies delivering major projects that deliver a more sustainable built environment. We have an open culture and a flat structure where you can expect to be treated with genuine care, respect, and empathy. With Linesight, you can truly discover the power of team!

Diversity, inclusion and accessibility

Linesight is committed to transparent, equal opportunity employment practices. We are building a diverse and inclusive organisation, accessible to all, based on having a safe culture which enables all our people to be their true selves. We are a people business, and we understand that the more inclusive we are, the happier our people and better our work will be. We will ensure that individuals with disability are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the application or recruitment process and are accommodated in the workplace. If you require assistance or accommodation of any kind, please mention this in your application, we would love to hear from you!
