About The Opportunity

Job Type: Permanent

Application Deadline: 20 November 2026

Job Description

Title AI Engineer

Department Asset Management Platforms

Location Dublin

Reports To Head of Research, AMP

Level 6

We’re proud to have been helping our clients build better financial futures for over 50 years. How have we achieved this? By working together - and supporting each other - all over the world. So, join our team and feel like you’re part of something bigger.

Our clients come from all walks of life and so do we. We are proud of our inclusive culture and encourage applications from the widest mix of talent, whatever your age, gender, ethnicity, sexual orientation, gender identity, social background and more.

As a flexible employer, we trust our people to perform their role in the way that works best for them, our clients and our business. We are a disability-friendly company and would welcome a conversation with you if you feel you might benefit from any reasonable adjustments to perform to the best of your ability during the recruitment process and beyond.

About Your Team

Asset Management Platforms (AMP) is responsible for the design, engineering and delivery of technology solutions that support Fidelity's global Asset Management business. We partner with Investment Management, Asset Management Operations and Distribution teams across Europe and Asia to deliver modern platforms that enable investment professionals to make better investment decisions and improve client outcomes.

About Your Role

The AI Engineer is a senior technical leader responsible for defining and delivering AI-enabled software engineering capabilities across Asset Management Platforms (AMP). The role combines enterprise AI strategy, software engineering leadership, and practical adoption of AI-assisted development to improve productivity, quality, and speed of delivery while maintaining Fidelity's standards for architecture, security, governance, and software quality.

This is an exciting opportunity to shape how AI is adopted across Asset Management Platforms, helping engineering teams deliver high-quality software faster while ensuring solutions remain secure, maintainable and aligned with Fidelity's engineering standards.

Key Responsibilities

AI Strategy & Platform Leadership

  • Define the technical vision, architecture, and operating model for AI-enabled engineering across AMP.
  • Establish enterprise standards, reference architectures, and governance frameworks for AI, Generative AI, AI agents, and AI-assisted software development.
  • Lead decisions relating to model strategy, orchestration, retrieval architecture, and multi-model AI adoption.
  • Evaluate emerging AI technologies and identify opportunities to create business and engineering value.

AI Engineering Enablement

  • Drive adoption of AI-assisted software engineering practices across development teams.
  • Develop reusable patterns, workflows, prompts, and accelerators.
  • Coach engineers in the effective use of tools such as GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, and other AI development assistants.
  • Establish standards for AI-generated code, quality assurance, security, and responsible AI usage.

Software Engineering & Architecture

  • Design and deliver modern, scalable software solutions supporting Fidelity's investment platforms.
  • Champion engineering best practices across architecture, development, testing, CI/CD, DevSecOps, observability, and automation.
  • Support technical design decisions and guide teams through complex engineering challenges.
  • Contribute to engineering strategy, roadmaps, and architecture governance.

Stakeholder Leadership

  • Partner with Engineering Leads, Architects, Product Owners, and business stakeholders to identify opportunities for AI-driven improvement.
  • Build communities of practice and promote knowledge sharing across engineering teams.
  • Communicate AI strategy and engineering outcomes to technical and business audiences.

About You

We're looking for an experienced software engineer who has designed and delivered production Generative AI/LLM solutions.

Essential Experience

  • Experience in software engineering, architecture, or technical leadership roles.
  • Proven track record delivering enterprise-scale software solutions and leading engineering transformation initiatives.
  • Strong experience with Agile delivery, CI/CD, DevSecOps, engineering governance, and secure software development.
  • Hands-on experience with AI engineering tools such as GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, Cursor, or similar platforms.
  • Strong understanding of RAG, retrieval, embeddings/vector search, agents and agentic workflows, MCP/tool integration, prompt/context engineering, model orchestration and AI evaluation.
  • Strong software engineering background across modern programming languages, cloud platforms, APIs, containers, automation, and observability.
  • Ability to balance innovation with risk management, governance, and regulatory requirements.

Experience within Asset Management, Investment Management, or Financial Services environments is preferred.

Technical Skills

Experience with many of the following technologies and practices:

  • Java, Python, C#, TypeScript or similar modern programming languages
  • Cloud platforms (AWS, Azure or GCP)
  • Containerisation technologies including Docker and Kubernetes
  • Git-based source control and collaborative development workflows
  • REST APIs and event-driven architectures
  • CI/CD tooling
  • Test automation frameworks
  • Infrastructure as Code
  • Observability and monitoring platforms
  • Enterprise architecture principles

Personal Attributes

  • Strategic thinker with strong technical depth.
  • Passionate about engineering excellence and emerging technologies.
  • Strong coaching, influencing, and stakeholder management skills.
  • Collaborative, pragmatic, and delivery focused.
  • Comfortable operating across both business and technology domains

Feel rewarded

For starters, we’ll offer you a comprehensive benefits package. We’ll value your wellbeing and support your development. And we’ll be as flexible as we can about where and when you work – finding a balance that works for all of us. It’s all part of our commitment to making you feel motivated by the work you do and happy to be part of our team. For more about our work, our approach to dynamic working and how you could build your future here, visit careers.fidelityinternational.com.

Position: Data Compliance Specialist

Location: Limerick

Company Description

We are a leading engineering services company with a proven track record of high quality, customer focused project delivery for over 130 years. Our core divisions include Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Sprinkler and Fire Protection. Some of the other services we provide include Waste to Energy (BioEnergy), Specialist Lift, Off Site Fabrication, Technical Support Services, Maintenance, Asset Management, BIM (Building Information Modelling) and Geo-Surveying. We offer competitive salaries, financial support for further training, Continuous Professional Development (CPD) leading to chartered status, performance incentives and the ability to progress your career with a world class engineering contractor. 

Job Description

The Data Compliance Specialist provides day-to-day quality and data integrity oversight for maintenance and project records in the site maintenance management system (CMMS) and related controlled documentation. The role reviews and approves completed work orders, supports technicians with work order and technical queries, and checks project handover packs before they are presented to the client for acceptance. Acting as the client’s quality and data integrity representative, the Specialist helps ensure records are complete, accurate, traceable and compliant with site procedures and applicable GxP requirements.

Your responsibilities will include:

  • Work order review and approval: Review completed work orders for technical accuracy, clear evidence of work performed, appropriate materials and readings, required checks, supporting documents and complete approvals. Approve or return records in accordance with delegated authority and site procedures. Record deficiencies and follow them through to resolution before approval.
  • Technician support: Respond to technician queries on work order completion, record requirements, data entry and technical documentation.
  • Project handover packs: Review project handover documentation for completeness, consistency and traceability before submission for client acceptance.
  • Client quality and data integrity representation: Represent the client’s requirements in quality compliance and data integrity matters.
  • CMMS and controlled data: Support consistent asset master data, work order data and maintenance history records within GMARS and associated systems.
  • Issues, trends and improvement: Raise recurring record-quality issues, deviations or potential data integrity concerns through the site process. Support deviation investigations, CAPA development and effectiveness reviews related to documentation and data integrity issues.
  • Communication and reporting: Maintain clear communication and monitor/report KPIs relating to documentation quality, review cycle times, recurring deficiencies, data integrity trends and right-first-time completion rates.
  • Quality and compliance expectations: Apply site procedures and ALCOA+ principles and work in a manner consistent with GxP requirements.
  • Authority and working relationships: The Specialist may approve completed work orders and quality records only within formally delegated authority, following completion of approved training and qualification requirements, and in accordance with applicable site procedures. The role works closely with Maintenance Technicians, Shift Leads/Chargehands, Planners, Engineers, Project Managers, Quality Assurance and Client Representatives.

Skills and Requirements :

  • Experience reviewing maintenance work orders or controlled records in a regulated manufacturing, pharmaceutical or similar environment.
  • Working knowledge of GMP/GxP expectations and data integrity principles, including ALCOA+.
  • Ability to understand maintenance and project documentation and identify missing, inconsistent or technically unclear records.
  • Experience with a CMMS such as SPA/Maximo.
  • Strong attention to detail, sound judgement and confidence to raise concerns constructively.
  • Clear written and verbal communication skills.

Desirable, but not required:

  • Relevant qualifications in Engineering, Science, Quality Assurance, Validation, Maintenance Management or a related discipline, or equivalent industry experience.
  • A technical trade qualification or engineering background is desirable.
  • Experience in a maintenance planning function is advantageous.
  • Working knowledge of GMP documentation standards, change control processes, deviation management and data integrity expectations within regulated manufacturing environments.

Benefits

We offer a competitive salary package commensurate with experience and qualifications. In addition, you will have the opportunity to work in a dynamic and supportive environment, collaborating with industry leaders and contributing to a sustainable future. Our company values work-life balance and encourages professional growth through training and development programs.

If you are ready to make a difference and be part of a growing industry, please submit your CV, along with a cover letter highlighting your relevant experience and why you are interested in this role. Recognising the contributions and respecting our people is core to our culture and values. We are an equal opportunities employer, and we encourage candidates from all backgrounds to apply for roles.

Job Description

At Honeywell Technologies, you can work on technology that helps make the world safer, smarter and more efficient. We are a global automation company helping customers run critical operations safely, reliably and efficiently, and we are moving from automation toward autonomy by combining AI, controls, connected data and domain expertise.

Are you interested in AI, Machine Learning or Generative AI, and looking for an opportunity to develop and grow in a global company? We are looking for motivated students to join our EMEA Innovation Hub in Dublin, Ireland. The hub delivers new AI capabilities into the Honeywell Forge product portfolio, from machine learning and time-series analytics to LLM-based and agentic AI, and develops them into industry-grade services deployed globally in mission-critical environments. Over the summer, you will apply AI to real-world challenges such as energy efficiency, sustainability and net-zero commitments.

Responsibilities

  • Build, test and evaluate AI/ML and Generative AI solutions, including LLM-based and agentic applications, for Honeywell Forge products.
  • Work with industrial IoT and time-series data to develop algorithms that improve energy efficiency, comfort, asset performance and predictive maintenance.
  • Write high-quality Python code using modern engineering practices such as version control, testing, code review and CI/CD.
  • Collaborate with an international team of AI, ML and data engineers and product owners to turn business requirements into working prototypes.
  • Research emerging AI techniques, document your results and present progress to team leadership and stakeholders.

Qualifications

  • Currently pursuing a master’s degree in Computer Science, AI/ML, Data Science, Software Engineering or a related field.
  • Strong Python programming skills, with experience using libraries such as NumPy, Pandas, scikit-learn, PyTorch or TensorFlow.
  • Completed modules or projects in areas such as machine learning, deep learning, time-series analytics, NLP or Generative AI.
  • Exposure to LLMs, prompt engineering, RAG or agent frameworks (e.g. LangChain/LangGraph), Git and cloud platforms such as Azure or GCP is a strong plus.
  • Curious, creative and collaborative, with strong problem-solving skills and good written and spoken English.

We Offer

  • Hands-on work on industry-first AI projects that contribute to products used by some of the world’s biggest brands.
  • Mentoring from experienced AI engineers and researchers in our Dublin EMEA Innovation Hub.
  • Training on software development methodologies and best practices in Python, data science and AI engineering.
  • Access to all required IT equipment, cloud services and AI platforms for your projects.
  • A collaborative, inclusive culture that values continuous learning, diverse perspectives and celebrating achievement.

Equal Opportunities

We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform crucial job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation.

Join a team recognized for leadership, innovation, and diversity!

About Us

Honeywell Technologies is a global, pure-play automation company with a legacy of innovating to help solve the world’s most mission-critical challenges, enhancing the quality of life for people and communities around the world. We serve the building, industrial and process sectors with a broad portfolio of services, solutions and products, underpinned by our Honeywell Technologies Accelerator operating system and Honeywell Technologies Forge intelligence layer. By combining the deep domain expertise of our more than 50,000 employees with decades of data from our global installed base, we are uniquely positioned to lead the industrial sector’s transition from automation to autonomy.

Job Category

Career Program

All Job Posting Locations:

Job Description

About the Role

Johnson & Johnson Innovative Medicine is recruiting a Postdoctoral Researcher, AI Safety to join our Data, Data Science & AI organization. This is a fixed-term research appointment of two years reporting directly to the Scientific Fellow, AI Safety.

The role can be based at one of our sites in Belgium, The Netherlands, UK or Ireland

Agentic AI is becoming central to pharmaceutical R&D—from discovery and translational science to development and regulatory work—where evidence standards are rigorous and errors can ultimately affect patient safety and outcomes. Our GenAI Platform supports that shift across a rapidly expanding population of autonomous workflows. Safety at this scale cannot be retrofitted through checks written into individual applications; it must be a property of how these systems are built.

As a Postdoctoral Fellow, You Will Lead a Focused, Publishable Research Program On How Agentic AI In Pharmaceutical R&D Can Be Governed Through Provable Controls, Continuously Tested Through Adversarial Assurance, And Made Safe By Construction. Your Research Agenda Will Sit Within One Or More Of The Team's Three Connected Mandates

  • Provable controls. Develop deterministic, explainable controls that persist throughout agentic workflows, and methods to verify that they hold.
  • Adversarial assurance. Advance continuous red-teaming and evaluation methods that test safeguards against credible failure scenarios and produce defensible evidence.
  • Safety-native architecture. Investigate pre- and post-training safety alignment and defense-in-depth techniques that make agentic AI safe by construction for regulated pharmaceutical R&D.

This is a hands-on research role with real systems as the testbed. You will formulate research questions, build the prototypes and experiments that answer them, publish the results, and work with our engineering partners to carry validated methods into the platform.

Key Responsibilities

Research Program

  • Execute an independent research agenda (agreed with the Scientific Fellow/mentor) on controls, adversarial assurance, or safety-native architecture for agentic AI in regulated scientific settings.
  • Design rigorous, reproducible experiments—including baselines, ablations, and uncertainty estimates—that test whether a safety property genuinely holds.
  • Evaluate pre-training data interventions and post-training methods—including supervised fine-tuning, preference optimization, and safety tuning—for regulated scientific use cases, including whether safety properties persist under domain adaptation.
  • Prototype layered architectures that constrain agent behavior, and translate scientific, quality, privacy, and regulatory requirements into testable system specifications.
  • Work with platform engineering to move validated methods from prototype into the GenAI Platform, with documentation that makes results reproducible and auditable.
  • Present your work to scientific, engineering, and leadership audiences, and represent the team at conferences, workshops, and standards activities.

What This Role Is Not

  • Not frontier model development. We are not pre-training foundation models at scale. The research question is how alignment and architecture should be adapted so that the models and platforms available to us are safe for pharmaceutical R&D.
  • Not a guardrail-prompt role. Safety here is architectural and enforcement is deterministic. A system prompt asking a model to behave is not a control.
  • Not research in isolation. Your research questions come from real agentic workflows, and success includes evidence that the methods work on them—not only a publication.
  • Not a production engineering or operations role. You prototype and validate; platform teams own production deployment, on-call support, and long-term maintenance.

Key Qualifications

PhD in computer science, AI/ML, applied mathematics, or a closely related technical field, preferably completed before the start date.

  • A record of first-author research, evidenced by peer-reviewed publications or preprints, in AI safety/alignment, AI/ML for cybersecurity, formal methods, or a closely related area.
  • Hands-on experience with foundation models and agentic AI, such as retrieval-augmented generation, tool use, planning, or multi-agent frameworks, and their failure modes.
  • Strong programming skills (for example, Python and modern ML frameworks) and experience building reproducible experiments.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication in English, with the ability to present technically defensible arguments to scientific and engineering audiences.
  • Scientific rigor in characterizing model and agent behavior, including uncertainty, limitations, failure conditions, and the strength of supporting evidence.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with policy engines, authorization languages (for example, OPA/Rego or Cedar), or formal verification tools.
  • Experience fine-tuning or evaluating foundation models for scientific or biomedical domains.
  • Exposure to privacy-preserving ML, data de-identification, or data provenance, including their limitations.
  • Interest in life sciences or another regulated, high-stakes domain
  • Open-source contributions to AI safety, evaluation, or security tooling.

Location

This position will be located at one of our offices in: Beerse, Belgium; Spring House, Pennsylvania, United States; Raritan, New Jersey, United States. Hybrid work arrangements apply.
